bhavadārādhanaṃ viṣṇo kathaṃ kāraṃ karomy ahaṃ /
tvatkarma kriyate cet tu karmalopo bhaven mama* /
ity ukto bhagavān āha muninā tattvavedinā // [ĀS 4.44]
śrībhagavān uvāca: vikhanas tvaṃ muniśreṣṭha madārādhanakarmaṇi* //
tava karmāṇy anūnāni saṃtu nityaṃ madājñayā // [ĀS 4.46]
yajñāś ca viṃśatir dvau ca dharmaṃ vaiṣṇavam uttamaṃ // [Ā.S 4.48]
vede vaikhānase sūtre yo dharmaḥ parikīrtitaḥ /
sarvais sa dharmo 'nuṣṭheyo nātra kāryā vicāraṇā* //
taddharmaniratā ye tu te vai bhāgavatāḥ smṛtāḥ // [Ā.S 4.68]
tisraḥ koṭyo munīnām tu karma kurvanti me sadā* //
jñātvā yajūṃṣi sāṅgāni manmatās sarva eva te /
! ĀS: tvatkarma kriyate ced vā; so auch DHN[T] 108; vgl. ĀS 16.24: bhavad ārādhanaṃ viṣṇo kathaṃ bhūmyāṃ karomy ahaṃ / tvat karma kriyate yat tat karmalopo bhaved dhruvaṃ.
! ĀS mit DHN[T] 108: vikhanas tvaṃ sammaniśreṣṭha.

! Dieser Vers ist als "Bhṛgu" zitiert in DHN[D] 83.21-22, ferner als "Purātantra" in DHN[D] 35.2-3. ĀS 4.50-4.67ab ist nicht in DHN[D] zitiert, wohl aber in DHN[T] 108-111: [108: ĀS 4.50:] kṛtamallāñchanānāṃ ca garbhavaiṣṇavajanmanāṃ / matputrāṇāṃ na cihnāni dāsāś cihnasamanvitāḥ // [Ā.S 4.51:] vaikhānasā mama sutā garbhavaiṣṇavajātakāḥ / teṣāṃ pṛthañ na cihnāni cakrādīnāṃ gurur na hi // [109: ĀS 4.52:] vaikhānasānāṃ sarveṣāṃ madarcāhetujanmanāṃ / śrautasmārtakriyārhāṇāṃ matprasādaikajīvināṃ // [Ā.S 4.53:] mama vākyabale naiva te vai cakrāṅkitāmatāḥ / sālagrāmeṣu sarveṣu garbhe cakrasya dhāraṇaṃ / vaikhānasānāṃ sarveṣāṃ garbhe cakrasya dhāraṇaṃ // [Ā.S 4.54:] uttamo garbhacakraś ca madhyamo nyāsacakrakaḥ / adhamo bāhyacakraś ca cakrahīno dhamādhamaḥ // [Ā.S 4.55:] garbhe māsy aṣṭame viṣṇubaliṃ kuryād yathāvidhiḥ / tenāgninaiva taptena cakreṇaivāṅkayed dhaviḥ // [Ā.S 4.56:] tad dhaviḥ prāśayet patnīṃ tanmantreṇaiva cātvaraḥ / vaikhānasena sūtreṇa yasyo 'yaṃ garbhavaiṣṇavaḥ // [Ā.S 4.57:] jāte putre pitā viṣṇubaliṃ kuryād yathāvidhi / tenāgnitaptacakrāṅkahaviṣā prāśayec chiśuṃ // [110: ĀS 4.58:] yadā kadā vāpi bhavet sarveṣām api sūtraṇāṃ // [Ā.S 4.59:] svaśākhāṃ samparityajya paraśākhānusārataḥ / śākhāraṇḍas sa vijñeyas sarvakarmabahiṣkṛtaḥ // [Ā.S 4.60:] ajñānād arthalobhād vā mohād vā parapīḍanāt / taptamudrā bhaved yasya prāyaścittaṃ vidhīyate // [Ā.S 4.61:] śrīvaikhānasasūtrasthas taptamudro bhaved yadi / ālayaṃ na viśet paścāt pūjanaṃ naiva kārayet // [Ā.S 4.62:] sarveṣāṃ viṣṇubhaktānāṃ taptamudrāvidhikramaṃ / vaikhānasena kartavyaṃ sarveṣām anyasūtriṇāṃ // [Ā.S 4.63:] śrīvaikhānasahastena taptacakrāṅkito yadi / trisaptakulam uddhṛtya naro viṣṇupuraṃ vrajet // [Ā.S 4.64:] vaikhānasasya hastena śaṅkhacakrāṅkito yadi / pāpair eva viśuddhātmā kalpakoṭiśatodbhavaiḥ // [Ā.S 4.65:] vaikhānasakareṇaiva śaṅkhacakrāṅkito yadi / [111:] mocayitvā tu pāpebhyaś caturvargaṃ dadāmy ahaṃ // [Ā.S 4.66:] svādhyāyābhyasane nityaṃ yatphalaṃ labhate naraḥ / tatphalaṃ samavāpnoti vaikhānasakareṇa ca // [Ā.S 4.67ab:] aṅkitaś śaṅkhacakrābhyām atra vaikhānasetaraḥ /.
! ĀS mit DHN[T] 111: tisraḥ koṭya ṛṣiśreṣṭhāḥ.
sarvadhā "ye nakhās te vaikhānasā" iti vedataḥ* //
tataḥ prāha muniśreṣṭhas tam evaṃ vādinaṃ harim* //
śrīvikhanāḥ: bhagavaṃs tvatprasādena karma sāṅgaṃ yathoditaṃ /
sarveṣāṃ matkulīnānāṃ bhavaty eva na saṃśayaḥ // [Ā.S 4.76]
ato 'tra śrutyuktamārgeṇa vaikhānasānāṃ sṛṣṭyādikaṃ, advārakabhagavadyajanenaiteṣāṃ nityakarmānuṣṭhānapūrṇatvaṃ ca pratipāditam*
atha pañcamavedatvena prasiddhe mahābhārate ānuśāsanikaparvaṇi 85tame adhyāye bhṛgvādimaharṣīṇāṃ vaikhānasānāñ cotpattiḥ nirūpitā*
vasiṣṭha: "api cedaṃ purā rāma śrutaṃ me brahmadarśanam /
devasya mahatas tāta vāruṇīṃ bibhratas tanum /
aiśvarye vāruṇe rāma rudrasyeśasya vai prabhoḥ*
yajñāṅgāni ca sarvāṇi vaṣaṭkāraś ca mūrtimān // [MBh 13.85.3]
mūrtimanti ca sāmāni yajūṃṣi ca sahasraśaḥ /
bhūtaṃ bhavyaṃ bhaviṣyac ca dadhāra śirasā*
! DHN[T] 112: atha pañcamavedatvena prasiddhe bhārate cānuśāsanike pañcāṣītatamādhyāye vaikhānasādīnām utpattiś ca nirūpitā.
! MBh: lakṣaṇāni svarāḥ stobhā niruktaṃ svarabhaktayaḥ / oṅkāraś cāvasan netre nigrahapragrahau tathā; DHN[T] 113: (oṅkāraś cāvasannetre).
! MBh: tathā vedāś ca sopaniṣado vidyā; DHN[T] 113: tathā vedāś ca sopaniṣado vidyās.
! MBh: juhvac cātmany athātmānaṃ tadā prabho.
eṣa brahmā śivo rudro varuṇo 'gniḥ prajāpatiḥ / [MBh 13.3954]
tasya yajñaḥ paśupates tapaḥ kratava eva ca / [MBh 13.3956]
dīkṣā dīptavratā devī diśaś ca sadigīśvarāḥ* //
devapatnyaś ca kanyāś ca devānāṃ caiva mātaraḥ /
svayaṃbhuvas tu tā dṛṣṭvā retaḥ samapatad bhuvi / [MBh 13.85.8]
prāsyat pūṣā karābhyāṃ vai tasminn eva hutāśane // [MBh 13.85.9]
brahmaṇo juhvatas tatra prādurbhāvo babhūva ha // [MB.h 13.85.10]
skannamātraṃ ca tac chukraṃ sruveṇa pratigṛhya saḥ /
tamasas tāmasā bhāvā vyāpi sattvaṃ tathobhayam /
sa guṇas tejaso nityas tasya cākāśam*
sarvabhūteṣu ca*{187}* tathā sattvaṃ tejas tv athottamam*{188}* /
children.translated_text: And in all beings, <s>sattva</s> (goodness) is likewise; but <s>tejas</s> (luminous energy) is supreme.

children.text: śukre hute 'gnau tasmiṃs tu prādurāsaṃs trayaḥ prabho // [MB.h 13.85.14]
children.translated_text: When the semen was offered into that fire, three [sages] appeared, O lord. // [MBh 13.85.14]

children.text: puruṣā vapuṣā yuktā tais taiḥ*{189}* prasavajair*{190}* guṇaiḥ /
children.translated_text: Persons endowed with bodies and with those respective qualities born of generation;
from roasting (<s>bharjana</s>), <s>Bhṛgu</s> [received his name] thus; from the embers (<s>aṅgāra</s>), <s>Aṅgiras</s> came into being. // [MBh 13.85.15]

children.text: ! DHN[T] 114: dyaur nabhaḥ pṛthivīṃ; MBh: dyaur.
! bis ist in MBh als "After 6, N (except D6.7; D3 missing) ins.:" in der Fußnote angeführt.
! MBh: tathā tamaḥ; DHN[T] 115: tathottamam (sa sattvas tejasas tamaḥ).
! MBh: bhṛg ity eva bhṛguḥ pūrvam aṅgārebhyo 'ṅgirābhavat.

children.translated_text: (From '<s>bhṛg</s>' indeed, <s>Bhṛgu</s> [was named] formerly; from the embers, <s>Aṅgiras</s> came into being. // [MBh 13.85.15cd]
And from taking refuge in the embers, another called <s>Kavi</s> came into being;

children.text: saha jvālābhir utpanno bhṛgus tasmād bhṛguḥ smṛtaḥ // [MB.h 13.85.16]
children.translated_text: born together with the flames, <s>Bhṛgu</s> is therefore known as <s>Bhṛgu</s>. // [MBh 13.85.16]

children.text: marīcibhyo marīcis tu mārīcaḥ kaśyapo hy abhūt /
children.translated_text: From the rays (<s>marīci</s>), <s>Marīci</s> [arose]; <s>Mārīca Kaśyapa</s> indeed came into being;
from the embers, <s>Aṅgiras</s>, O dear one; the <s>Vālakhilya</s>s from the heap of stones;

children.text: atraivātreti ca vibho jātam atriṃ vadanty api // [MBh 13.85.17]
children.translated_text: and here, by 'here indeed' (<s>atraiva</s>), they say <s>Atri</s> was born, O lord. // [MBh 13.85.17]
Then, from the ashes of that fire, approved by the assembly of <s>Brahmarṣi</s>s (brahman-sages),
the <s>Vaikhānasa</s>s arose, seekers of the virtues of austerity and learning;
and from his hearing arose the two <s>Aśvin</s>s, renowned in the world. // [MBh 13.85.18]

children.text: śeṣāḥ prajānāṃ patayaḥ srotobhyas tasya jajñire /
children.translated_text: The remaining lords of creatures were born from his streams;
the <s>Ṛṣi</s>s from the hair-pores, the Vedic meters from sweat, the mind from strength. // [MBh 13.85.19]

children.text: etasmāt kāraṇād āhur agniḥ sarvāś caab hier telugu devatāḥ*{197}* /
children.translated_text: For this reason they say: '<s>Agni</s> (fire) is all the gods';
the <s>Ṛṣi</s>s, endowed with learning, from seeing the authority of the <s>Veda</s>s. // [MBh 13.85.20]

children.text: yāni dārūṇi te māsā niryāsāḥ pakṣasaṃjñitāḥ /
children.translated_text: Those [sacrificial] woods are the months; the resins are called the fortnights;

children.text: ahorātrā muhūrtās tu pittaṃ jyotiś ca vāruṇam // [MBh 13.85.21]
children.translated_text: the days and nights are the <s>muhūrta</s>s; bile, light, and the watery [element]. // [MBh 13.85.21]

children.text: raudraṃ lohitam ity āhur lohitāt kanakaṃ smṛtam /
children.translated_text: The <s>Raudra</s> (fierce) is called red; from red, gold is known;

children.text: tan maitram iti vijñeyaṃ dhūmāc ca vasavaḥ smṛtāḥ // [MB.h 13.85.22]
children.translated_text: that is to be understood as <s>Maitra</s> (belonging to <s>Mitra</s>); from smoke, the <s>Vasu</s>s are known. // [MBh 13.85.22]

children.text: arciṣo yāś ca te rudrās tathādityā mahāprabhāḥ /
children.translated_text: Those which are the flames are the <s>Rudra</s>s; likewise the <s>Āditya</s>s of great splendor;

children.text: uddiṣṭās te tathāṅgārā ye dhiṣṇyeṣu divi sthitāḥ // [MB.h 13.85.23]
children.translated_text: the embers are designated as those who are stationed in the <s>dhiṣṇya</s> (sacred fire-places) in heaven. // [MBh 13.85.23]

children.text: ādikartā*{198}* ca lokasya tat paraṃ brahma tad dhruvam /
children.translated_text: And the first creator of the world — that is the supreme <s>Brahman</s>, that is the eternal;

children.text: sarvakāmadam ity āhus tadrahasyam uvāca ca* //{199}* [MBh 13.85.24]
children.translated_text: they call it the giver of all desires, and he spoke that secret. // [MBh 13.85.24]
Then the great god <s>Varuṇa</s>, of the nature of wind, spoke:

children.text: [varuṇa] mama satram idaṃ divyam ahaṃ gṛhapatis tv iha // [MBh 13.85.25]
children.translated_text: [<s>Varuṇa</s>:] 'This divine <s>sattra</s> (sacrificial session) is mine; I am the householder here.' // [MBh 13.85.25]

children.text: trīṇi pūrvāṇy apatyāni mama tāni na saṃśayaḥ /
children.translated_text: 'The three former offspring are mine, there is no doubt;

children.text: ! MBh: tathā bhasmavyapohebhyo brahmarṣigaṇasaṃmitāḥ; DHN[T] 166; bhasma vyapohebhyo (tathāgnes tasya bhasnabhyo) brahmarṣigaṇasaṃnitāḥ.
! Diese beiden Vershälften sind als "Mahābhārata" auch in DHN[D] 21.15-16 zitiert.
! MBh: ṛṣayo lomakūpebhyaḥ svedāc chando malātmakam.
! MBh: agniṃ sarvās tu devatāḥ; DHN[T] 116: sarvāś ca(bhi).

children.translated_text: [Footnote 192: DHN[T] 116: <s>kuśoccayāt</s>.]

children.text: iti jānīta khagamā mama yajñaphalaṃ hi tat // [MB.h 13.85.26]
children.translated_text: know this, O birds, for that is the fruit of my sacrifice.' // [MBh 13.85.26]
<s>Agni</s>: 'Born from my limbs and created through my agency,

children.text: mamaiva tāny apatyāni varuṇo hy avaśātmakaḥ // [MB.h 13.85.27]
children.translated_text: those offspring are indeed mine; <s>Varuṇa</s> is powerless.' // [MBh 13.85.27]
<s>Brahmā</s>: Then the teacher of the world, <s>Brahmā</s>, the grandfather of the world, spoke:

children.text: mamaiva tāny apatyāni mama śukraṃ hutaṃ hi tat // [MB.h 13.85.28]
children.translated_text: 'Those offspring are indeed mine, for that semen was my offering.' // [MBh 13.85.28]

children.text: īśvara: ahaṃ kartā hi satrasya hotā śukrasya caiva hi*{201}* /
children.translated_text: <s>Īśvara</s>: 'I am the performer of the <s>sattra</s> and the offerer of the semen;

children.text: yasya bījaṃ phalaṃ tasya śukraṃ cet kāraṇaṃ matam // [MB.h 13.85.29]
children.translated_text: to whom the seed belongs, to that one belongs the fruit — if the semen is considered the cause.' // [MBh 13.85.29]
Then the hosts of gods, having approached the Grandfather,
all with hands joined in reverence, bowing with their heads, [spoke]: // [MBh 13.85.30]

children.text: vayaṃ ca bhagavan sarve jagat etac carācaram*{203}* /
children.translated_text: 'We, O Blessed One, and all this world, moving and unmoving,

children.text: tavaiva prasavaṃ sarvaṃ*{204}* tasmād agnir vibhāvasuḥ /
children.translated_text: all are your progeny; therefore let <s>Agni Vibhāvasu</s>,

children.text: varuṇaś ceśvaro devo labhatāṃ kāmam īpsitam // [MB.h 13.85.31]
children.translated_text: <s>Varuṇa</s>, and the lord god obtain the desired wish.' // [MBh 13.85.31]

children.text: nisargād varuṇaś cāpi brahmaṇo yādasāṃ patiḥ /
children.translated_text: And by nature, <s>Varuṇa</s>, lord of waters, [son] of <s>Brahmā</s>,

children.text: jagrāha vai bhṛguṃ pūrvam apatyaṃ sūryavarcasam // [MBh 13.85.32]
children.translated_text: first took <s>Bhṛgu</s> as his offspring, radiant as the sun. // [MBh 13.85.32]
<s>Īśvara</s> assigned <s>Aṅgiras</s> as offspring from <s>Agni</s>;

children.text: pitāmahas tv apatyaṃ vai kaviṃ jagrāha dharmataḥ*{206}* // [MB.h 13.85.33]
children.translated_text: and the Grandfather took <s>Kavi</s> as his offspring, in accordance with <s>dharma</s>. // [MBh 13.85.33]

children.text: tadā sa vāruṇiḥ*{207}* khyāto bhṛguḥ prasavakarmakṛt /
children.translated_text: Then that <s>Bhṛgu</s> became known as <s>Vāruṇi</s> (son of <s>Varuṇa</s>), the performer of generative acts;

children.text: āgneyas tv aṅgirāḥ śrīmān kavir brāhyo mahāyāśāḥ* /{208}*
children.translated_text: <s>Aṅgiras</s>, the illustrious, was <s>Āgneya</s> (son of <s>Agni</s>); <s>Kavi</s> was <s>Brāhma</s> (son of <s>Brahmā</s>), of great fame;
the <s>Bhārgava</s>s and <s>Āṅgirasa</s>s in the world are characterized as the continuation of the world. // [MBh 13.85.34]

children.text: ete hi prasavās*{209}* sarve prajānāṃ patayas trayaḥ /
children.translated_text: These are all the progenitors, the three lords of creatures;

children.text: sarvaṃ saṃtānam eteṣām idam ity avadhāraya* //{210}* [MBh 13.85.35]
children.translated_text: understand that all this lineage is theirs. // [MBh 13.85.35]
Thus, by these and other [passages], the origin and related matters of the <s>Vaikhānasa</s>s have been specially established.
In another <s>Purāṇa</s>:

children.text: yajñe devasya vitate mahato varuṇasya ha /
children.translated_text: 'At the extended sacrifice of the great god <s>Varuṇa</s>,
seeing the <s>Apsaras</s> of <s>Brahmā</s>, his semen once fell forth.' //

children.text: !{201}! MBh: ahaṃ vaktā ca mantrasya hotā śukrasya caiva ha.
children.translated_text: [Footnote 201: MBh: 'I am the speaker of the <s>mantra</s> and the offerer of the semen.']

children.text: tat pratīkṣya sa parṇena saṃjuhāva vibhāv asau /
children.translated_text: Having collected that with a leaf, he offered it into the fire, <s>Vibhāvasu</s>;
from the flames arose the blessed <s>Bhṛgu</s>; from the embers, <s>Aṅgiras</s>. //
From 'here indeed' (<s>atraiva</s>), by searching (<s>anveṣaṇa</s>), [came] <s>Atri</s>; from digging (<s>khanana</s>), the sage <s>Vikhanā</s>;

children.text: khananaṃ tattvamīmāṃsety bis hier teluguāhuḥ kecana sūrayaḥ //
children.translated_text: 'Digging' means 'investigation of truth' (<s>tattvamīmāṃsā</s>) — thus say certain learned ones. //
Others say: 'We have heard that it is from digging [into] the meanings of the <s>Nigama</s>s (Vedas)';
from them, the <s>Brāhmaṇa</s>s of that lineage, knowers of the <s>Veda</s>s and <s>Vedāṅga</s>s." Thus.

children.text: "ye vālāḥ te vālakhilyāḥ" ity atra bakārasthāne vakāra*{211}*. jñānātiśayavaibhavāt kāmādidoṣarāhityena ca bālā ucyante. śrūyate hi*{212}*: "tasmād brāhmaṇaḥ pāṇḍityaṃ nirvidya bālyena tiṣṭhāset*{213}* bālyañ ca pāṇdityañ ca nirvidyātha muniḥ" iti.
children.translated_text: In '<s>ye vālāḥ te vālakhilyāḥ</s>' — here the letter 'ba' is used in place of 'va'. They are called '<s>bāla</s>' (childlike) because of the eminence of their knowledge and the absence of faults such as desire. For it is heard [in the <s>Śruti</s>]: 'Therefore a <s>Brāhmaṇa</s>, having transcended learning, should abide in childlikeness; having transcended both childlikeness and learning, then [he becomes] a <s>muni</s> (sage).'

children.text: atra kecid evam ūcuḥ: brahmaṇaḥ vidhūtāc charīrāt yanmāṃsaṃ vikīrṇam abhavat tato ketavo vātaraśanā ṛṣaya udatiṣṭhann iti. tad asat. evam arthasvīkāre sṛṣṭikāraṇabhūtasya brahmaśarīrasya śaithilyam uktaṃ syād iti.
children.translated_text: Here some have said: 'From the shaken body of <s>Brahmā</s>, whatever flesh was scattered, from that arose the <s>Ketava</s>s, the wind-fed <s>Ṛṣi</s>s.' That is incorrect. If such a meaning were accepted, it would imply weakness of the body of <s>Brahmā</s>, which is the cause of creation — [which is absurd].

children.text: kiñ ca "tasyāntarmanasi kāmas samavartata" ityādinā "kāmas tadagre samavartatādhi" ity antena sopapattikaṃ vartamānaṃ saṅkalparūpaṃ mananavyāpāram uktvā "manaso retaḥ prathamaṃ yad āsīd" ity atra tatra vidyamānasya vyāpārasya prajāpateḥ sṛṣṭikāraṇatvaṃ retaś śabdebis hier telugunoktvā "sato bandhum asati niravindann" ity ārabhya "ya evaṃ veda" ity antena brahmaṇas tatkālavidyamānamānasaśaktimāab hier telugutreṇa vyaṣṭisṛṣṭer aniṣpannatvam uktvā manaso vyaṣṭikāraṇalābhāya "sa tapo 'tapyata" iti bhagavadupāsanam akarod" ity uktam. ayam evārthaḥ "oṃ ity ekākṣaraṃ brahme"tyādinā brahmāṇḍe 'py uktam.*{214}*
children.translated_text: Moreover, having stated by 'In his inner mind, desire arose' and so forth, up to 'Desire first arose upon it,' the deliberation that is a function of the mind, in the form of volition, occurring with reason, and having said by 'That which was the first seed of the mind' that the agency of creation belongs to <s>Prajāpati</s> through the word 'seed' (<s>retas</s>) for the function existing therein, and having stated from 'They found the bond of being in non-being' up to 'He who knows this thus' the non-accomplishment of individual creation through the measure of the mental power of <s>Brahmā</s> existing at that time, it is stated: 'He performed austerity (<s>tapas</s>)' — meaning he performed worship of the Lord for the purpose of obtaining the individual cause from the mind. This very meaning is also stated in the <s>Brahmāṇḍa</s> [Purāṇa] beginning with '<s>Oṃ</s>, the one-syllabled <s>Brahman</s>.'
The mind-born sonship of <s>Bhṛgu</s> and others to the Lord
That <s>Bhṛgu</s> and others are mind-born sons of the Lord is stated by the Lord himself:
'The seven great <s>Ṛṣi</s>s, and likewise the four <s>Manu</s>s,

children.text: madbhāvā mānasā jātā yeṣāṃ loka imāḥ prajāḥ //" [MBh 6.32.6]
children.translated_text: born from My mind, of My nature — from them are these creatures of the world.' // [MBh 6.32.6 = BhG 10.6]
<s>Bhṛgu</s> and others as founders of the <s>Vaikhānasa</s> lineage

children.text: bhṛgvādaya eva vaikhānasānāṃ vaṃśakartāraḥ iti bhārate 'py uktam.
children.translated_text: That <s>Bhṛgu</s> and others are the founders of the lineage of the <s>Vaikhānasa</s>s is also stated in the <s>Bhārata</s>.
[Footnote 211: DHN[T] 120: 'va' in place of the letter 'ba'.]
As in the <s>Śāntiparvan</s>:
'<s>Bhṛgu</s>, <s>Aṅgiras</s>, <s>Marīci</s>, <s>Atri</s>, <s>Pulastya</s>, <s>Pulaha</s>, <s>Kratu</s>, // [MBh 13, App. 7.49]

children.text: tathā vasiṣṭho dakṣaś ca nava svāyambhuvā dvijāḥ* //{216}*
children.translated_text: and <s>Vasiṣṭha</s> and <s>Dakṣa</s> — these are the nine <s>Svāyambhuva</s> twice-born ones. //
These are called the founders of the lineage
of the <s>Vaikhānasa</s> <s>Ṛṣi</s>s of purified souls, who eat <s>sāttvika</s> (pure) food.' Thus. [MBh]

children.text: tasmād bhagavatā nārāyaṇena brahmaṇā ca sṛṣṭānāṃ bhṛgvādīnām ṛṣīṇāṃ tadvaṃśajānāṃ ca niṣekādikriyāvatām advārakabhagavadyajanādhikāravatām eva loke vaikhānasā iti prasiddhiḥ.
children.translated_text: Therefore, the well-known designation '<s>Vaikhānasa</s>' in the world belongs only to the <s>Ṛṣi</s>s <s>Bhṛgu</s> and others, created by the Lord <s>Nārāyaṇa</s> and <s>Brahmā</s>, and to their descendants who undergo the sacraments beginning with <s>niṣeka</s> (impregnation rite) and who possess the qualification for direct worship of the Lord without intermediary. It does not belong to others.

children.text: caturmukhasṛṣṭānāṃ sarveṣāṃ manuṣyāṇāṃ vaikhānasatvaṃ samānam ity ākṣepasya parihāraḥ
children.translated_text: Refutation of the objection that all humans created by <s>Brahmā</s> are equally <s>Vaikhānasa</s>

children.text: nanu brahmaṇā sṛṣṭānāṃ sarveṣām api manuṣyānāṃ vaikhānasatvaṃ samānam.
children.translated_text: Objection: Since all human beings are created by <s>Brahmā</s>, the status of being <s>Vaikhānasa</s> should be the same for all.

children.text: katham eteṣv eva vyavahriyate iti cet satyam. nāmarūbis hier telugupakṛtyavibhāgādikaṃ vedaśabdebhya eva brahmaṇā kṛtam iti śrūyate. "vedena nāmarūpe vyākarot satāsatī*{217}* prajāpatir" iti.
children.translated_text: If asked: 'How is it applied only to these?' — True. [But] it is heard [in the <s>Śruti</s>] that the differentiation of names, forms, and functions was made by <s>Brahmā</s> from the words of the <s>Veda</s> alone: '<s>Prajāpati</s> differentiated names and forms by means of the <s>Veda</s>, both being and non-being.'

children.text: tathā bhārate: "anādinidhanā hy eṣā vāgudsṛṣṭā svayambhuvā* //{218}* [MBh 12.224.55cd]
children.translated_text: And in the <s>Bhārata</s>: 'This speech, without beginning or end, emitted by the Self-existent One, // [MBh 12.224.55cd]

children.text: ādau vedamayī divyā yatas sarvāḥ prasūtayaḥ* //{219}*" iti [MBh 12.671.1]
children.translated_text: consisting of the <s>Veda</s>s at the beginning, divine — from it all creations [proceed].' // [MBh 12.671.1]

children.text: śrīviṣṇupurāṇe: "nāma rupañ ca bhūtānāṃ kṛtyānāñ ca praab hier telugupañcanam /
children.translated_text: In the <s>Śrī Viṣṇu Purāṇa</s>: 'The names, forms, and the fivefold activities of beings,

children.text: vedaśabdebhya evādau devādīnāṃ cakāra saḥ //" iti. [ViṣṇuP 1.5.63]
children.translated_text: of <s>Deva</s>s and others — He created from the words of the <s>Veda</s> at the very beginning.' // [ViṣṇuP 1.5.63]

children.text: manu: "sarveṣāñ ca sa nāmāni karmāṇi ca pṛthak pṛthak /
children.translated_text: <s>Manu</s>: 'The names of all, and their functions, separately,

children.text: vedaśabdebhya evādau pṛthak saṃsthāś ca nirmame //" [ManuDhŚ 1.21]
children.translated_text: and their separate forms — He created from the words of the <s>Veda</s> at the very beginning.' // [ManuDhŚ 1.21]

children.text: iti ca nāmarūpavibhāgasya śrutismṛtiṣu pratipāditatvāt brahmaṇā tādṛśaśrutismṛtyanusāreṇa sṛṣṭānām eva vaikhānasatvavyavahāraḥ. Nānyeṣām.
children.translated_text: And since the differentiation of names and forms is established in <s>Śruti</s> and <s>Smṛti</s>, the designation '<s>Vaikhānasa</s>' applies only to those created by <s>Brahmā</s> in accordance with such <s>Śruti</s> and <s>Smṛti</s>. Not to others.

children.text: kiñca ekasmin paramapuruṣe mukhādiṣu jātānāṃ yathā brāhmaṇādivyavahāraḥ yathā viśvāmitra bhāradvājādi gotreṣūtpannānām ekasūtraniṣṭhatvaṃ vinā anekasūtrānusāritvaṃ, yathā ca kumudakahlārādiṣu "paṅke jāyata" iti vyutpattyā paṅkajatve samāno 'pi yogarūḍhibhyāṃ paṅkajatvaṃ tāmarasa eva vartate tathaiva vaikhānasatvam api. tathoktam:
children.translated_text: Furthermore, just as among those born from the mouth and other [limbs] of the one Supreme Person there is the designation <s>Brāhmaṇa</s> and so forth; just as among those born in the <s>gotra</s>s (lineages) of <s>Viśvāmitra</s>, <s>Bhāradvāja</s>, and others, without adherence to a single <s>sūtra</s>, there is following of multiple <s>sūtra</s>s; and just as among lotuses (<s>kumuda</s>, <s>kahlāra</s>, etc.), although the status of being 'born in mud' (<s>paṅkaja</s>) is common according to the etymology 'born in mud,' the term <s>paṅkaja</s> applies by conventional usage (<s>yogarūḍhi</s>) only to the <s>tāmarasa</s> (lotus proper) — even so is the status of being <s>Vaikhānasa</s>. As stated:
'In each <s>kalpa</s> (cosmic cycle), through dissolution and creation, <s>Brahmā</s>, <s>Viṣṇu</s>, and <s>Maheśvara</s>
are always the determiners of <s>Śruti</s>, <s>Smṛti</s>, and right conduct. //

children.text: ! Dieser Vers ist ähnlich als "Purātantra" in DHN[D] 33.24-34.1 zitiert.
! MBh: yataḥ sarvāḥ pravṛttayaḥ; diese Vershälfte wird in einigen Manuskripten eingefügt.

children.translated_text: [Footnote 215: MBh: 'O king, <s>Pulastya</s>, <s>Pulaha</s>, and others [are sons] of the Grandfather.']
There is no creator of the <s>Veda</s>; the speaker of the <s>Veda</s> is the four-faced [<s>Brahmā</s>];
likewise, <s>Manu</s> remembers the <s>dharma</s> at the transition between <s>kalpa</s>s.' //
Those established in the third <s>āśrama</s> do not have natural <s>Vaikhānasa</s> status

children.text: nanu: "brahmacārī gṛhasthaś ca bhikṣur vaikhānasas tathā"*{220}* iti tatra tatra tṛtīyāśramaniṣṭhānām eva vaikhānasatvāvagamāt ta eva vaikhānasaśabdavācyāḥ kiṃ na syur iti cet na. śrutismṛtipurāṇādiṣu uktaprakāreṇa brahmaṇā sṛṣṭānām eva vaikhānasatvāvagamāt teṣām eva tatra tatrotkṛṣṭatvapratipādanāc ca.*{221}*
children.translated_text: Objection: In '<s>brahmacārī gṛhasthaś ca bhikṣur vaikhānasas tathā</s>' ('a celibate student, a householder, a mendicant, and likewise a forest-dweller'), since the understanding of <s>Vaikhānasa</s> status pertains to those established in the third <s>āśrama</s> (stage of life), why should they alone not be denoted by the word <s>Vaikhānasa</s>? Answer: No. Because the understanding of <s>Vaikhānasa</s> status belongs only to those created by <s>Brahmā</s> in the manner stated in <s>Śruti</s>, <s>Smṛti</s>, and <s>Purāṇa</s>s, and because their eminence is established in each of those [texts].
The entry of the <s>Vaikhānasa</s>s into the assembly of <s>Brahman</s>

children.text: tathā hi: śrutāv eva vaikhānasānām utpattiḥ śrūyate. "ye nakhāḥ te vaikhānasāḥ"*{222}* iti. chandogyabrāhmaṇe: "vaikhānasā vā ṛṣaya indrasya priyā āsan*{223}*"
children.translated_text: For indeed, the origin of the <s>Vaikhānasa</s>s is heard in the <s>Śruti</s> (revealed scripture) itself. 'Those who are the nails, they are the <s>Vaikhānasa</s>s.' In the <s>Chāndogya Brāhmaṇa</s>: 'The <s>Vaikhānasa</s> sages were dear to <s>Indra</s>.'

children.text: "pauruhan mahaṃ bhavati. puruhānnādo vā etena vaikhānaso 'ñjasā svargaṃ lokam apaśyat" iti. atra indraśabdena paramātmā nārāyaṇa ucyate. "sa brahmā sa śivassendrasso 'kṣaraḥ paramas svarāṭ" ityādi śrutibhyaḥ.*{224}*
children.translated_text: 'He becomes great among men. The eater of abundant food — by this the <s>Vaikhānasa</s> directly perceived the heavenly world.' Here, by the word '<s>Indra</s>,' the Supreme Self <s>Nārāyaṇa</s> is referred to. This is from <s>Śruti</s> passages such as 'He is <s>Brahmā</s>, He is <s>Śiva</s>, He is <s>Indra</s>, He is the Imperishable, the Supreme, the Self-ruler.'
'The <s>Aśvattha</s> tree, tawny cows, <s>Tulasī</s>, and <s>Vikhanas</s> likewise,

children.text: catvāro matpriyā rājaṃs teṣāṃ vaikhānaso varaḥ* //{226}*" [ĀS 19.10]
children.translated_text: these four are dear to Me, O king; among them, the <s>Vaikhānasa</s> is the best.' [<s>ĀS</s> 19.10]

children.text: ity upabrahmaṇāt. brahmasūtre indraprāṇādhikaraṇe tathā nirṇayāc ca.*{227}*
children.translated_text: Thus from this corroborating statement. And from the determination in the <s>Brahmasūtra</s>, in the <s>Indra-Prāṇa</s> section.
In the <s>Ānuśāsanika</s> (parva): 'Then from the ashes of that fire, esteemed by hosts of <s>Brahma</s>-sages,
the <s>Vaikhānasa</s>s were born, seekers of the qualities of austerity and learning.' [<s>MBh</s> 13.85.18]
Thus the origin is declared by the very name '<s>Vaikhānasa</s>.'
Likewise in the <s>Kiṣkindhā Kāṇḍa</s>:
'There is a peak called <s>Saumanasa</s>, made of gold, eternal. [<s>Rām</s> 4.39.51cd]

children.text: tatra pūrvaṃ padaṃ kṛtvā purā viṣṇus trivikrame /
children.translated_text: There formerly <s>Viṣṇu</s> placed His first step in the <s>Trivikrama</s> (three strides),
and made His second on the terrible peak — that <s>Puruṣottama</s> (Supreme Person). [<s>Rām</s> 4.39.52]
Passing beyond to the north of that, on <s>Jambudvīpa</s>, the sun

children.text: dṛśyo bhavati bhūyiṣṭhaṃ śikharaṃ tan mahocchrayam // [Rā.m 4.39.53]
children.translated_text: becomes visible for the most part — that peak of great height. [<s>Rām</s> 4.39.53]
There <s>Vaikhānasa</s>s by name, the <s>Vālakhilya</s> great sages,
are seen shining, ascetics of the color of the sun.' [<s>Rām</s> 4.39.54]

children.text: !{220}! Dieser Halbvers ist ähnlich in DHN[D] 53.3 zitiert.
! DHN[T] 135 statt DHN[D] 21.2-6: iti kutaḥ: tṛtīyāśramaniṣṭhaparatvenāvagamyamānatvāt tatra tatrotkṛṣṭatvapratipādanāc ca tṛtīyāśramaniṣṭā eveti cet tat asat.
! ChāndogyaBr 2.23.1; ebenfalls zitiert in DHN[D] 41.8, 61.13-15 und 118.4.
! DHN[T] 136: vikhanos tathā; der erste Halbvers ist auch als "Purātantra" in DHN[D] 37.3 zitiert.

! Dieser Vers ist ähnlich als "Varāhapurāṇa" zitiert in DHN[D] 41.10-11 und in DHN[D] 118.6-7; vgl. KrA 36.37: aśvatthaḥ kapilā gāvaḥ tulasī vikhano dvijaḥ / haripriyās tu catvāraḥ teṣu vaikhānaso varaḥ.
! MBh: tathā bhasmavyapohebhyo; die Lesart des DHN[D] ist v.l.
! Dieser Vers ist auch als "Mahābhārata" in DHN[D] 17.7-8 zitiert.

children.translated_text: [Footnote: This half-verse is similarly cited in DHN[D] 53.3.]
And in the same (text), in the fortieth chapter:
'<s>Maināka</s> too must be searched, with its ridges, slopes, and caves;

children.text: strīṇām aśvamukhīnāñ ca niketās tatra tatra tu // [Rā.m 4.42.30]
children.translated_text: and the dwellings of the horse-faced women, here and there. [<s>Rām</s> 4.42.30]
Passing beyond that region, to the hermitage frequented by the perfected ones,

children.text: siddhā vaikhānasās tatra vālakhilyāś ca tāpasāḥ // [Rā.m 4.42.31]
children.translated_text: there are the perfected <s>Vaikhānasa</s>s, the <s>Vālakhilya</s> ascetics. [<s>Rām</s> 4.42.31]

children.text: vandyās te tu tapassiddhās tapasā vītakalmaṣāḥ /
children.translated_text: They are to be venerated — accomplished through austerity, purified of sin by their austerity;
and they should also be asked, with humility, about the whereabouts of <s>Sītā</s>. [<s>Rām</s> 4.42.32]
There is the <s>Vaikhānasa</s> lake, covered with golden lotuses.' [<s>Rām</s> 4.42.33ab]

children.text: iti ca vānaprasthaparatvaṃ vinā "vaikhānasā vālakhilyā" iti vālakhilyasamānatayā pṛthag vaṃśatvena kīrtanāt.
children.translated_text: And thus, without implying the primacy of the <s>vānaprastha</s> (forest-dweller) stage, the <s>Vaikhānasa</s>s are celebrated as a separate lineage, on a par with the <s>Vālakhilya</s>s, as stated: '<s>Vaikhānasa</s>s and <s>Vālakhilya</s>s.'
Likewise in the <s>Śrī Viṣṇu Purāṇa</s>, in the ninth chapter of the second section:
'Then the <s>Bhagavān</s> proceeds, guarded by <s>Brāhmaṇa</s>s,
and by <s>Vālakhilya</s>s and also by <s>Vaikhānasa</s>s, the Lord, [<s>ViṣṇuP</s> 2.8.58]

children.text: mahātmābhir mahātmā vai jagatāṃ pālanodyataḥ //" iti [ViṣṇuP ]
children.translated_text: the great-souled one by great-souled ones, intent upon the protection of the world.'
Likewise in the <s>Sabhā Parvan</s>:
'And they went to the abode of the Grandfather, filled with compassion. [<s>MBh</s> 1.203.2cd]

children.text: tato dadṛśur ātmānaṃ saha devaiḥ pitāmaham /
children.translated_text: Then they beheld the Grandfather himself, together with the gods,
surrounded on all sides by the perfected ones and great sages. [<s>MBh</s> 1.203.3]

children.text: tatra viṣṇur mahādevas tatrāgnir vāyunā saha /
children.translated_text: There was <s>Viṣṇu</s>, <s>Mahādeva</s>, there was <s>Agni</s> together with <s>Vāyu</s>,

children.text: candrādityau ca dharmaś ca parameṣṭhī tathā budhāḥ* //{238}* [MBh 1.203.4]
children.translated_text: the sun and moon, <s>Dharma</s>, <s>Parameṣṭhin</s>, and the wise ones. [<s>MBh</s> 1.203.4]
<s>Vaikhānasa</s>s and <s>Vālakhilya</s>s, <s>Soma</s>-drinkers and <s>Marīci</s>-drinkers,
<s>Aja</s>s and <s>Ajamīḍha</s>s, those whose essence is radiance, ascetics,
all the sages — they attend upon the Grandfather.' [<s>MBh</s> 1.203.5]

children.text: iti ca vaikhānasānāṃ brahmasabhāpraveśavarṇanāt. tasya ca tṛtīyāśramaniṣṭheṣv asambhavāt.
children.translated_text: Thus from the description of the <s>Vaikhānasa</s>s' entry into the assembly of <s>Brahmā</s>. And because such (attendance) is impossible for those committed to the third stage of life (<s>vānaprastha</s>).

children.text: ! Rām: praṣṭavyāś cāpi sītāyāḥ pravṛttaṃ vinayānvitaiḥ.
! MBh: pitāmahasya bhavanaṃ jagataḥ kṛpayā tadā.
! MBh: tato dadṛśur āsīnaṃ saha devaiḥ pitāmaham / siddhair brahmarṣibhiś caiva samantāt parivāritam.
! MBh: tatra devo mahādevas tatrāgnir vāyunā saha / candrādityau ca dharmaś ca parameṣṭhī tathā budhaḥ.
! MBh: vaikhānasā vālakhilyā vānaprasthā marīcipāḥ / ajāś caivāvimūḍhāś ca tejogarbhās tapasvinaḥ / ṛṣayaḥ sarva evaite pitāmaham upāsate.

children.translated_text: [Footnote: <s>Rām</s> reads: <s>Mainākas tu</s>.]
Prohibition of <s>Śrauta</s> rites for <s>Vānaprastha</s>s
In the <s>Ānuśāsanika</s> (parva):
'Hear, O king, the chief rite of the illustrious <s>Vasiṣṭha</s>: [<s>MBh</s> 13.140.15cd]
Having resorted to the bank of the <s>Gaṅgā</s> according to the <s>Vaikhānasa</s> procedure, [<s>MBh</s> 13.140.647*.1]

children.text: ādityās satramīhanti saro vaikhānasaṃ prati*{240}* //" iti [MBh 13.140.16]
children.translated_text: the <s>Āditya</s>s perform a <s>satra</s> (sacrificial session) at the <s>Vaikhānasa</s> lake.' [<s>MBh</s> 13.140.16]

children.text: atra vānaprasthavidhau satrayāgakramavidhānābhāvāt vānaprasthāśramapraviṣṭhānāṃ tena śārīreṇa punar api devatvayogyatā 'sambhavāc ca vaikhānasavidhāneneti vaikhānasapadena vānaprasthānāṃ gṛhītum aśakyatvāt.
children.translated_text: Here, since there is no prescribing of the procedure for a <s>satra</s>-sacrifice in the <s>vānaprastha</s> ordinances, and since it is impossible for those who have entered the <s>vānaprastha</s> stage of life to be eligible for godhood again with that very body, the word '<s>Vaikhānasa</s>' in '<s>Vaikhānasa</s> procedure' cannot be taken to refer to <s>vānaprastha</s>s.
Furthermore, in the <s>Śrī Bhāgavata</s>, in the eleventh book:
'With forest produce, <s>caru</s> (oblation) and <s>puroḍāśa</s> (rice cake), he should perform the seasonal offering;

children.text: na tu śrautena vidhinā māṃ yajeta vanāśramī* //{241}*" [BhāgavataP 11.18.7]
children.translated_text: but one dwelling in the forest should not worship Me by the <s>Śrauta</s> procedure.' [<s>BhāgavataP</s> 11.18.7]
Thus from the declaration of the prohibition of the <s>Śrauta</s> procedure for <s>vānaprastha</s>s.
Procedure for worshipping the Lord
Likewise in the <s>Vṛddha Manu</s>: 'By <s>Brāhmaṇa</s>s who know the <s>Vedānta</s>, those who follow the <s>Vaikhānasa Sūtra</s>,

children.text: yājayed yajñapuruṣaṃ viṣṇuṃ rājā jagaddhitaḥ //" iti
children.translated_text: the king, acting for the welfare of the world, should have <s>Viṣṇu</s>, the Lord of sacrifices, worshipped.'
Difference in the naming of the four forms between the <s>Vaikhānasa</s>s and the <s>Pāñcarātrika</s>s
Likewise in the <s>Āśvamedhika</s> (parva):

children.text: yudhiṣṭhirah: "kathaṃ tvaṃ arcanīyo 'si mūrtayaḥ kīdṛśāś ca te*{242}* / [MBh 14, App. 4.1652]
children.translated_text: <s>Yudhiṣṭhira</s>: 'How are You to be worshipped, and what are Your forms? [<s>MBh</s> 14, App. 4.1652]

children.text: vaikhānasāḥ kathaṃ brūyuḥ kathaṃ vā pāñcarātrikāḥ // [MB.h 14, App. 4.1653]
children.translated_text: How would the <s>Vaikhānasa</s>s declare it, and how the <s>Pāñcarātrika</s>s? [<s>MBh</s> 14, App. 4.1653]

children.text: śrībhagavān: "śṛṇu pāṇḍava tatsarvam arcanākramam ātmanaḥ / [MBh 14, App. 4.1654]
children.translated_text: The <s>Bhagavān</s> said: 'Hear, O <s>Pāṇḍava</s>, all about My own procedure of worship: [<s>MBh</s> 14, App. 4.1654]

children.text: sthaṇḍile padmakaṃ kṛtvā sāṣṭapatraṃ*{243}* sakarṇikam // [MB.h 14, App. 4.1655]
children.translated_text: Having made a lotus on the ground, with eight petals and a pericarp, [<s>MBh</s> 14, App. 4.1655]
by the procedure of the eight-syllable (mantra), or else with twelve syllables, [<s>MBh</s> 14, App. 4.1656]

children.text: vaidikair athavā mantrair mama sūktena vā punaḥ // [MB.h 14, App. 4.1657]
children.translated_text: or with Vedic <s>mantra</s>s, or again with My own <s>Sūkta</s> (hymn), [<s>MBh</s> 14, App. 4.1657]

children.text: sthitaṃ māṃ mantratas tasmin arcayet susamahitaḥ*{245}* / [MBh 14, App. 4.1658]
children.translated_text: one should worship Me established there through <s>mantra</s>s, with a well-concentrated mind. [<s>MBh</s> 14, App. 4.1658]

children.text: viṣṇuñ ca puruṣaṃ satyam*{246}* acyutañ ca yudhiṣṭhira*{247}* // [MB.h 14, App. 4.1659]
children.translated_text: <s>Viṣṇu</s>, <s>Puruṣa</s>, <s>Satya</s>, and <s>Acyuta</s>, O <s>Yudhiṣṭhira</s>, [<s>MBh</s> 14, App. 4.1659]

children.text: aniruddhañ ca māṃ prāhur vaikhānasavido janāḥ / [MBh 14, App. 4.1660]
children.translated_text: and <s>Aniruddha</s> — thus those who know the <s>Vaikhānasa</s> (tradition) call Me. [<s>MBh</s> 14, App. 4.1660]

children.text: anye tv evaṃ vijānānti māṃ rājan pāñcarātrikāḥ*{248}* // [MB.h 14, App. 4.1661]
children.translated_text: Others, however, the <s>Pāñcarātrika</s>s, know Me thus, O king: [<s>MBh</s> 14, App. 4.1661]

children.text: !{240}! MBh: ādityāḥ satramāsanta saro vai mānasaṃ prati; DHN[D] ist v.l.
! BhāgavataP: vanyaiś carupuroḍāśair nirvapet kālacoditān / na tu śrautena paśunā māṃ yajeta vanāśramī.
! MBh: sthāpitaṃ māṃ tatas tasminn arcayitvā vicakṣaṇaḥ.
! Dieser Halbvers ist auch als "Purātantra" zitiert in DHN[D] 36.9.
! MBh: puruṣaṃ ca tataḥ satyam acyutañ ca yudhiṣṭhira; so auch zitiert in DHN[D] 44.22.

children.translated_text: [Footnote: <s>MBh</s> reads: the <s>Āditya</s>s performed a <s>satra</s> at the <s>Mānasa</s> lake; DHN[D] gives a variant reading.]

children.text: vāsudevañ ca rājendra saṅkarṣaṇam athāpi vā / [MBh 14, App. 4.1662]
children.translated_text: <s>Vāsudeva</s>, and O lord of kings, <s>Saṅkarṣaṇa</s> as well, [<s>MBh</s> 14, App. 4.1662]

children.text: pradyumnañ cāniruddhañ ca caturmūrtiṃ pracakṣate* //{249}* [MBh 14, App. 4.1663]
children.translated_text: <s>Pradyumna</s> and <s>Aniruddha</s> — they declare the four forms.' [<s>MBh</s> 14, App. 4.1663]

children.text: etāś cānyāś ca rājendra saṃjñābhedena mūrtayaḥ / [MBh 14, App. 4.1664]
children.translated_text: 'These and other forms, O lord of kings, differing in name, [<s>MBh</s> 14, App. 4.1664]

children.text: viddhy anarthāntarā eva mām evañ cārcayed budhaḥ* //{250}*" iti [MBh 14, App. 4.1665]
children.translated_text: know them to be none other than Me — thus should a wise one worship Me.' [<s>MBh</s> 14, App. 4.1665]
Likewise in the <s>Pāñcarātra</s>, in the <s>Pauṣkara Saṃhitā</s>:

children.text: "viprā vaikhānasākhyā ye te bhaktās tattvam ucyate* //{251}* [PauṣkaraS 36.260cd]
children.translated_text: 'Those <s>Brāhmaṇa</s>s who are known as <s>Vaikhānasa</s>s — they are devotees; the truth is declared: [<s>PauṣkaraS</s> 36.260cd]
Single-pointed, established in pure <s>sattva</s> (goodness), until death they worship no other;

children.text: kartavyam iti deveśaṃ saṃyajante phalaṃ vinā //"*{253}* iti [PauṣkaraS 36.261]
children.translated_text: with the thought "this is to be done," they worship the Lord of gods, without (seeking) fruit.' [<s>PauṣkaraS</s> 36.261]
The threefold division of worship: pure, Vedic, and <s>Tāntrika</s>
Likewise in the same (text), in the determination of the distinction of <s>Tantra</s>s:

children.text: "śuddhañ ca vaidikañ ceti tāntrikañ ca tridhā bhavet /
children.translated_text: 'Pure, Vedic, and <s>Tāntrika</s> — thus it is threefold.

children.text: pāñcarātreṇa pūjā tu śuddhaṃ viṣṇor iti smṛtam // [PauṣkaraS ]
children.translated_text: Worship by the <s>Pāñcarātra</s> method is called "pure" for <s>Viṣṇu</s>. [<s>PauṣkaraS</s>]
The Vedic nature of <s>Vaikhānasa</s> worship
One should worship <s>Viṣṇu</s>, the Imperishable, by the <s>Vaikhānasa Sūtra</s>;

children.text: vaidikaṃ tad iti proktaṃ dvijātīnāṃ praśasyate //" iti [PauṣkaraS ]
children.translated_text: that is declared to be "Vedic" — it is praised for the twice-born.' [<s>PauṣkaraS</s>]
Likewise in the <s>Viṣṇu Smṛti</s>:
'Those excellent twice-born who worship by recourse to the <s>Puruṣa Sūkta</s>,

children.text: saṃhitājapamāsthāya te māṃ prāpsyanti vai dvijāḥ //
children.translated_text: by recourse to the recitation of the <s>Saṃhitā</s> — those twice-born will attain Me.
In the absence of Vedic <s>mantra</s>s, (one may worship) by the method taught in the <s>Pāñcarātra</s> as well.'
Likewise in the <s>Saṅkarṣaṇa Saṃhitā</s>:
'One should worship with <s>Pañcarātra</s> <s>mantra</s>s, which bestow the fruit of <s>mokṣa</s> (liberation),

children.text: vaikhānasoktair divyair vā mantrais sarvārthasiddhaye //" iti [Saṅkarṣaṇasaṃhitā]
children.translated_text: or with divine <s>mantra</s>s taught by the <s>Vaikhānasa</s> (tradition), for the accomplishment of all purposes.' [<s>Saṅkarṣaṇasaṃhitā</s>]
Likewise in the <s>Śilpa</s> (architecture treatise), in the determination of the placement of <s>Harihara</s> and others:
'In settlements of a thousand <s>Brāhmaṇa</s>s, with more than a hundred <s>Brāhmaṇa</s>s,
one should install and worship <s>Viṣṇu</s> by the procedure of the five forms.
In the subsidiary shrine within that precinct, one should not worship <s>Viṣṇu</s> by the <s>Tāntrika</s> method;
one should worship by the Vedic method, according to the <s>Vaikhānasa</s> procedure.'

children.text: ! PauṣkaraS: viprā ekāyanākhyā ye te bhaktās tattvato 'cyute; dieser Halbvers ist als "Pauṣkarasaṃhitā" ähnlich zitiert in DHN[D] 42.25, 48.18, 1118.12, als "Purātantra" ähnlich in DHN[D] 36.24.

! PauṣkaraS: kartavyatvena ye viṣṇuṃ saṃyajanti phalaṃ vinā; der erste Halbvers ist auch als "Pauṣkarasaṃhitā" zitiert in DHN[D] 48.18, ähnlich als "Purātantra" in DHN[D] 37.1; der ganze Vers als "Pauṣkarasaṃhitā" in DHN[D] 42.26-43.1 und 118.13-14.

children.translated_text: [Footnote: Also cited thus in DHN[D] 44.25-45.1.]
The threefold division of the <s>Vaiṣṇava</s> tradition
Likewise in the <s>Jyotiṣa</s> (astronomy/astrology), in the <s>Hayagrīva Saṃhitā</s>:
'Worship in a village temple should be performed according to the <s>Śrīśāstra</s> (auspicious scripture) alone;
one should not perform it by the <s>Pāñcarātra</s> procedure — such is the teaching.' [<s>Hayagrīvasaṃhitā</s>]
Likewise in the <s>Śaiva</s> text, the <s>Suprabheda</s>:
'In a village of more than a thousand <s>Brāhmaṇa</s>s, and also in a <s>Brahma</s>-precinct,
by those who are well-consecrated from the <s>niṣeka</s> (rite of insemination) onward, according to the <s>Vaikhānasa Sūtra</s>, [<s>SuprabhedĀ</s>]
who are skilled in the distinctions of the <s>mantra</s>s of the great <s>Tantra</s>s of the <s>Bhārgava</s>s and others,
with groups of <s>mantra</s>s that are not extracted, born from the <s>Veda</s> and <s>Vedānta</s>, [<s>SuprabhedĀ</s>]
who are accomplished in the sequential study, and consecrated with all limbs and subsidiary parts,
one should install and worship <s>Hari</s> by the method of the five forms. [<s>SuprabhedĀ</s>]

children.text: vaidikaṃ tad iti proktaṃ rājarāṣṭravivardhanam* //{256}*" iti. [SuprabedhĀ ]
children.translated_text: That is declared to be "Vedic" — it promotes the prosperity of king and kingdom.' [<s>SuprabhedĀ</s>]
Likewise in the <s>Kāraṇa</s> (Āgama), in the procedure for village planning:
'Having made the <s>Brahmā</s> portion into four parts, from the northwest direction,
one should install and worship <s>Viṣṇu</s> by the procedure of the five forms.'
Likewise in the <s>Bhīma Saṃhitā</s>, on the occasion of presenting the distinctions of traditions:
'The <s>Śaiva</s> has been thus declared; now the <s>Vaiṣṇava</s> is stated.

children.text: vaiṣṇavañ ca tridhā proktaṃ tathā samayabhedavat // [Bhīmasaṃhitā]
children.translated_text: The <s>Vaiṣṇava</s> is said to be threefold, according to the distinction of traditions: [<s>Bhīmasaṃhitā</s>]
<s>Pāñcarātra</s>, <s>Bhāgavata</s>, and the <s>Vaikhānasa</s> system —

children.text: śuddhaṃ miśraṃ tathā saumyaṃ yathā saṃkhyakrameṇa tu // [Bhīmasaṃhitā]
children.translated_text: pure, mixed, and gentle respectively, in that numerical order. [<s>Bhīmasaṃhitā</s>]
That which is outside the Vedic practice is declared to be "<s>Raudra</s>" (fierce);
that connected with Vedic practice is called "<s>Saumya</s>" (gentle) and is declared the best. [<s>Bhīmasaṃhitā</s>]

children.text: grāmādīnāṃ samīpe tu miśroktaṃ sthāpayed budhaḥ /
children.translated_text: Near villages and the like, the wise one should install what is prescribed as "mixed";
on the banks of oceans, rivers, and the like, one should install what is prescribed as "pure." [<s>Bhīmasaṃhitā</s>]
In all the settlements of <s>brāhmaṇas</s>, one should have [worship] performed only with gentle speech." Thus [says the <s>Bhīmasaṃhitā</s>].

children.text: ! Vgl. SuprabhedĀ, kriyāpāda 23.65: sahasrabhūsurād ūrdhve brahmeśo vāyudeśake / pañcamūrtividhānena sthāpayed vaijanādmanaṃ,

children.translated_text: Variant reading: DHN[T] 145: 'by those consecrated with <s>saṃskāras</s> beginning from <s>niṣeka</s> (conception rite) onward.'

children.text: tathā gāruḍe: "adhvaryubhir vipravarair mate vikhanasas sthitaiḥ /
children.translated_text: Likewise in the <s>Gāruḍa</s> [Purāṇa]: "By <s>adhvaryus</s> (priests), the best of <s>brāhmaṇas</s>, who are established in the doctrine of <s>Vikhanasa</s>,
strive there for the worship of <s>Viṣṇu</s> of immeasurable splendor." Thus [says the <s>GaruḍaPurāṇa</s>].
<s>Vaikhānasa</s> worship at <s>Śrīraṅga</s>
Likewise, in the <s>Śrīraṅgamāhātmya</s> therein:
"<s>Brahmā</s> too, with a divine swan, resembling a white cloud,
followed <s>Viṣṇu</s> from behind, covering his face with a cloth. [<s>GaruḍaPurāṇa</s>]
There the most fortunate <s>Bhagavān Vikhanasa</s> was the priest,
and he distributed the <s>prasāda</s> (grace-offering) of the gods by the permission of <s>Raṅganātha</s>." Thus [says the <s>GaruḍaPurāṇa</s>].
Likewise in the account of <s>Uparicaravasu</s>:
"By the words of the <s>Vaikhānasas</s>, with <s>japa</s> (recitation), <s>homa</s> (fire-offering), worship, and the like,

children.text: yajed dhariṃ surapatiṃ bhūmer vivarago 'pi san //" iti [GaruḍaP ]
children.translated_text: one should worship <s>Hari</s>, the lord of gods, even while being free from attachment to the earth." Thus [says the <s>GaruḍaPurāṇa</s>].
<s>Vaikhānasa</s> worship at <s>Vṛṣagiri</s>
Likewise in the <s>Vṛṣagirimāhātmya</s>:
"Having entered within, the sages together with the <s>Vaikhānasa</s> <s>brāhmaṇas</s>

children.text: praṇamanty anvahaṃ devaṃ nārāyaṇam anāmayam //" iti [GaruḍaP ]
children.translated_text: bow daily to the god <s>Nārāyaṇa</s>, the immaculate one." Thus [says the <s>GaruḍaPurāṇa</s>].
Likewise in the <s>Phullāraṇyamāhātmya</s> of the <s>ĀgneyaPurāṇa</s>:

children.text: "phullaśiṣyās tu yakṣās te pūjayanti yuge yuge /
children.translated_text: "The <s>yakṣas</s> who are disciples of <s>Phulla</s> worship age after age
according to the <s>Vaikhānasa</s> rite, as it was transmitted from the mouth of <s>Phulla</s>. [<s>AgniPurāṇa</s>]
Humans too worship here, established in the <s>Vaikhānasa</s> doctrine." Thus [says the <s>AgniPurāṇa</s>].
Likewise in the description of the glory of the <s>Puṣkara</s> pilgrimage site in the <s>Brahmakaivartta</s> [Purāṇa]:
"Just as <s>Gaṅgā</s> among rivers, and <s>Bhagavān Hari</s> among gods,

children.text: varṇānāṃ brāhmaṇāś śreṣṭhā āśramāṇāṃ yatir yathā // [BrahmakaivartaP ]
children.translated_text: and <s>brāhmaṇas</s> are the best among the <s>varṇas</s> (classes), and <s>yati</s> (renunciant) among the <s>āśramas</s> (life-stages), [<s>BrahmakaivarttaPurāṇa</s>]
just as among the primordial <s>śrutis</s> (revelations), the <s>Ekāyanī</s> is the first,

children.text: vyūhānām ādibhūtas tu vāsudevo yathā varaḥ /
children.translated_text: and among the <s>vyūhas</s> (emanations), <s>Vāsudeva</s> is the foremost and the best,

children.text: trimūrtīnāṃ yathā viṣṇuś śivānān tu sadāśivaḥ* //{261}* [BrahmakaivartaP ]
children.translated_text: and among the <s>Trimūrtis</s> (three forms), <s>Viṣṇu</s>, and among the <s>Śivas</s>, <s>Sadāśiva</s> — [<s>BrahmakaivarttaPurāṇa</s>]

children.text: vipreṣu vaikhānasānāṃ, sūtreṣu vaikhānasasūtrasya ca śreṣṭhyam
children.translated_text: The supremacy of the <s>Vaikhānasas</s> among <s>brāhmaṇas</s>, and of the <s>Vaikhānasasūtra</s> among <s>sūtras</s>

children.text: dharmāṇāṃ vaiṣṇavo dharmaḥ smṛtīnāṃ mānavī smṛtiḥ /
children.translated_text: among <s>dharmas</s>, the <s>Vaiṣṇava dharma</s>; among <s>smṛtis</s>, the <s>Smṛti</s> of <s>Manu</s>;
among <s>brāhmaṇas</s> learned in the <s>Vedas</s>, the <s>Vaikhānasa</s> is the best — [<s>BrahmakaivarttaPurāṇa</s>]

children.text: ! Diese Verse sind ähnlich auch als "Brahmakaivartapurāṇa" in DHN[D] 42.1-6 zitiert.
! Dieser Vers ist auch als "Brahmakaivartapurāṇa" zitiert in DHN[D] 42.7-8.

children.translated_text: Variant reading: DHN[D] 7.26: 'covering with a cloth.'

children.text: sūtrāṇāṃ tatpraṇītan tu yathā śreṣṭhatamaṃ smṛtam /
children.translated_text: and among <s>sūtras</s>, the one composed by him is remembered as the most excellent,
so too, O king, <s>Puṣkara</s> is the highest of the highest among pilgrimage sites." [<s>BrahmakaivarttaPurāṇa</s>]

children.text: iti ca pratipādanāt īdṛśānāṃ vaikhānasānām eva śrutismṛtītihāsapurāṇādiṣu caturmukhāt sāmānyatvena vinā sarvotkṛṣṭatvenotpattiśravaṇāt brahmasabhāpraveśasūryapathādyāśrayaṇādipratipādanāc ca vaikhānasā na tṛtīyāśramaniṣṭhāḥ, na vā brahmaṇā sāmānyataḥ sṛṣṭā bhavitum arhanti.
children.translated_text: Because of such teachings, and because in the <s>Śruti</s>, <s>Smṛti</s>, <s>Itihāsa</s>, <s>Purāṇa</s>, and other [texts], the origin of these <s>Vaikhānasas</s> is heard of as supremely exalted — not merely in a general way from the four-faced [<s>Brahmā</s>] — and because of the teaching of their entry into <s>Brahmā</s>'s assembly, their following the solar path, and similar [distinctions], the <s>Vaikhānasas</s> are not [merely] adherents of the third <s>āśrama</s> (forest-dwelling stage), nor can they be [regarded as] created by <s>Brahmā</s> in a general manner.
The supremacy of <s>Bhāratavarṣa</s> in <s>Jambudvīpa</s>
In the <s>ŚrīViṣṇuPurāṇa</s>: "Here too, <s>Bhārata</s> is the best in <s>Jambudvīpa</s>, O great sage,

children.text: yato hi karmabhūr eṣā hy ato 'nyā bhogabhūmayaḥ // [Viṣṇu.P 2.2.22]
children.translated_text: for this is the land of <s>karma</s> (action), while the others are lands of enjoyment. [<s>ViṣṇuPurāṇa</s> 2.2.22]

children.text: kṛtaṃ tretā dvāparañ ca kaliścānyatra na kvacit /
children.translated_text: The <s>Kṛta</s>, <s>Tretā</s>, <s>Dvāpara</s>, and <s>Kali</s> [<s>yugas</s>] exist nowhere else;

children.text: tapas tapyanti yatayo juhvate cātra yajvanaḥ // [ViṣṇuP ]
children.translated_text: ascetics perform austerities and sacrificers offer oblations here. [<s>ViṣṇuPurāṇa</s>]
Gifts are given here with care for the sake of the next world,
and in <s>Jambudvīpa</s>, the <s>Yajñapuruṣa</s> (Sacrifice-Person) is always worshipped by men. [<s>ViṣṇuPurāṇa</s>]
<s>Viṣṇu</s>, who is the embodiment of sacrifice, is [worshipped] through sacrifices; in other continents it is otherwise. [<s>ViṣṇuPurāṇa</s>]
Here, O best of beings, through the accumulation of merit, over thousands
of thousands of births, a being occasionally obtains human birth." [<s>ViṣṇuPurāṇa</s> 2.2.23]

children.text: iti bhāratakhaṇḍavyatiriktasthaleṣu brahmacaryādyāśramādivyavasthāvyavahārādyabhavāt pāñcarātraśilpajyautiṣādiṣu eṣām advārakabhagavadyajanādhikāritvaparamavaidikaparamaikāntitvādeḥ pratipādanāṅ ca eṣv eva vaikhānasatvaṃ naisargikam. vānaprastheṣu vaikhānasatvaṃ na naisargikam.
children.translated_text: Because in places other than the <s>Bhārata</s> region there is no arrangement or practice of <s>āśramas</s> (life-stages) such as <s>brahmacarya</s> (celibate studentship), and because in the <s>Pāñcarātra</s>, <s>Śilpa</s> (architecture), <s>Jyotiṣa</s> (astrology), and other [texts] there is teaching of their qualification for the worship of the <s>Bhagavān</s> as non-intermediary, and of their being supremely Vedic and exclusively devoted — therefore, <s>Vaikhānasa</s>-hood is innate only among these [<s>brāhmaṇas</s>]. Among <s>vānaprasthas</s> (forest-dwellers), <s>Vaikhānasa</s>-hood is not innate.

children.text: kintu teṣāṃ sūtrāntareṣv anuktānāṃ vānaprasthāśramasvīkāraprayogaśrāmaṇakāgnikuṇḍavidhānādīnāṃ vikhanas sūtre pratipāditānāṃ tatsūtroktaprakāreṇa vānaprasthāśramasvīkārādinaiva vaikhānasatvasiddhir iti.
children.translated_text: Rather, since the adoption of the <s>vānaprastha</s> <s>āśrama</s>, the <s>śrāmaṇaka</s> (ascetic) fire-pit ritual, and other procedures not mentioned in other <s>sūtras</s> are taught in the <s>Vikhanasa Sūtra</s>, the establishment of <s>Vaikhānasa</s>-hood is only through the adoption of the <s>vānaprastha āśrama</s> and other rites in the manner stated in that <s>sūtra</s>.
This very thing is stated by <s>Baudhāyana</s>:
The non-applicability of the term <s>Vaikhānasa</s> to <s>vānaprasthas</s> in the primary sense

children.text: "vānaprastho vaikhānasaśāstrasamudācāro vane mūlaphalāśī tapaśśīlas savaneṣūdakam upaspṛśan śrāmaṇakenāgnim ādhāyāgrāmyabhojī devapitṛmanuṣyabhūtarṣipūjakaḥ sarvātithiḥ pratiṣiddhavarjaṃ bhaikṣam apy upayuñjīta. na phālakṛṣṭam adhitiṣṭhet grāmaṃ vā na praviśet"*{264}* iti.
children.translated_text: "A <s>vānaprastha</s> (forest-dweller), practicing according to the <s>Vaikhānasa śāstra</s>, eating roots and fruits in the forest, devoted to austerity, touching water at the <s>savana</s> (pressing) times, having established the fire with the <s>śrāmaṇaka</s> [rite], not eating village food, worshipping gods, ancestors, humans, spirits, and sages, receiving all guests, may also eat alms-food excepting what is forbidden. He should not tread on ploughed land nor enter a village." Thus [says <s>Baudhāyana</s>].

children.text: !{263}! Dieser Vers ist auch als "Brahmakaivartapurāṇa" zitiert in DHN[D] 42.10-11.
children.translated_text: Note: This verse is also cited as '<s>Brahmakaivarttapurāṇa</s>' in DHN[D] 42.10-11.

children.text: manuḥ: "ataḥ paraṃ pravakṣyāmi dharmaṃ vaikhānasāśrayam //"*{265}* ity ārabhya
children.translated_text: <s>Manu</s>: "Henceforth I shall declare the <s>dharma</s> based on <s>Vaikhānasa</s> [practice]." Beginning from this [verse],
"With flowers, roots, and fruits alone one should always subsist,

children.text: kālapakvais svayaṃ śīrṇair vaikhānasamate sthitaḥ //"*{266}* iti [ManuDhŚ 6.21]
children.translated_text: established in the <s>Vaikhānasa</s> doctrine, with [food] ripened by time and fallen of its own accord." Thus [says <s>ManuDharmaśāstra</s> 6.21].

children.text: hārīta: "vānaprastho grāmyā oṣadhīḥ parivarjayet. tretāgnīnāṃ sthāne śrāmaṇakaṃ vāgnim ādhāya valkalaśāṇacarmakuśamuñjādivalkalaṃ vā vasāno vaikhānasaproktena vidhinā vānaprastho bhavati. anujñāyiko 'nuprasthāyika" iti.
children.translated_text: <s>Hārīta</s>: "A <s>vānaprastha</s> should avoid village herbs. In place of the three fires, having established the <s>śrāmaṇaka</s> fire, wearing bark, hemp, skin, <s>kuśa</s>-grass, <s>muñja</s>-grass, or bark garments, he becomes a <s>vānaprastha</s> by the rite prescribed by the <s>Vaikhānasas</s>. He is either <s>anujñāyika</s> (permitted) or <s>anuprasthāyika</s> (one who follows)." Thus [says <s>Hārīta</s>].

children.text: yama: "śrāmaṇakena vidhānena sāyaṃ prātar upaspṛśed" iti.
children.translated_text: <s>Yama</s>: "By the <s>śrāmaṇaka</s> procedure, one should perform ablution at evening and morning." Thus [says <s>Yama</s>].

children.text: śaṅkhalikhitau: "śrāmaṇakenāgnim ādhāya kāle kuruvindaveṇuśyāmākanīvārādibhir vartayed"*{267}* iti.
children.translated_text: <s>Śaṅkhalikhita</s>: "Having established the fire with the <s>śrāmaṇaka</s> [rite], one should subsist at the proper time on <s>kuravinda</s>, bamboo, <s>śyāmāka</s>, <s>nīvāra</s>, and the like." Thus [says <s>Śaṅkhalikhita</s>].
<s>Vasiṣṭha</s> also: "Having established the fire with the <s>śrāmaṇaka</s> [rite], one who has established the fire becomes a dweller at the root of a tree." Thus [says <s>Vasiṣṭha</s>].
In the commentary of <s>Yajñasvāmin</s> on this:

children.text: "śrāmaṇakaṃ nāma vaikhānasaśāstram. taduktena vidhināgnim ādhāya" iti.
children.translated_text: "<s>Śrāmaṇaka</s> means the <s>Vaikhānasa śāstra</s>. Having established the fire by the rite stated therein." Thus [says the commentary].
<s>Vyāsa</s> also, in the <s>Śukānuśāsana</s>:

children.text: "mūlair eke phalair eke puṣpair eke dṛḍhavratāḥ / [MBh 12.236.13cd]
children.translated_text: "Some with roots, some with fruits, some with flowers, those of firm vows, [<s>Mahābhārata</s> 12.236.13cd]
subsist in the proper manner, established in the <s>Vaikhānasa</s> doctrine." Thus [<s>Mahābhārata</s> 12.236.14ab].

children.text: smṛtyantaram api: "yasminn eva tu samproktaṃ sūtre vikhanasā param /
children.translated_text: Another <s>smṛti</s> also: "In whichever <s>sūtra</s> it was declared as supreme by <s>Vikhanasa</s>,
for all forest-dwellers, the rite called <s>śrāmaṇaka</s> —

children.text: vānaprasthās tatas sarve ye dvijās tv anyasūtriṇaḥ /
children.translated_text: therefore all <s>vānaprasthas</s>, those <s>brāhmaṇas</s> belonging to other <s>sūtras</s>,

children.text: tatsūtravidhyanuṣṭhānāt smṛtā vaikhānasās tu te* //{270}*" iti ca varṇayanti.*{271}* [ĀS 11.4]
children.translated_text: are called <s>Vaikhānasas</s> by virtue of their performance of the rites of that <s>sūtra</s>." Thus they describe. [<s>ĀpastambaSūtra</s> 11.4]

children.text: ataś ca vānaprasthā mukhyatvena vaikhānasaśabdavācyā na bhavanti.*{272}*
children.translated_text: Therefore, <s>vānaprasthas</s> are not in the primary sense designated by the term <s>Vaikhānasa</s>.
And in the <s>Ānuśāsanika</s> [<s>Parvan</s>]:

children.text: "taṃ patantam abhiprekṣya*{273}* prekṣya ca rṣigaṇānatha / [MBh 13, App. 1A.313]
children.translated_text: "Beholding him falling, and looking upon the hosts of sages, [<s>Mahābhārata</s> 13, App. 1A.313]

children.text: āsīnāna*{274}* vasubhis sārdhaṃ satreṇa jagatīpateḥ // [MBh 13, App. 1A.314]
children.translated_text: seated together with the <s>Vasus</s> at the sacrificial session of the lord of the earth — [<s>Mahābhārata</s> 13, App. 1A.314]

children.text: !{265}! ManuDhŚ 6.1ab v.l. Dieser Halbvers ist ähnlich als "Manu" zitiert in DHN[D] 92.5.
! Dieser Vers ist auch als "Manu" zitiert in DHN[D] 92.6-7.
! Dieser Vers ist auch als "Purātantra" in DHN[D] 34.21-22 zitiert.
! ĀS: smārtā vaikhānasās smṛtāḥ; dieser Vers ist auch als "Purātantra" in DHN[D] 34.22-23 zitiert.
! DHN[T] 157 umgestellt: ata eva mukhyatvena vaikhānasaśabdavācyā vānaprasthā na bhavanti.

children.translated_text: Note: <s>ManuDharmaśāstra</s> 6.1ab variant reading. This half-verse is cited similarly as '<s>Manu</s>' in DHN[D] 92.5.
of these <s>Vaikhānasas</s> and the hosts of <s>Vālakhilyas</s> — [<s>Mahābhārata</s> 13, App. 1A.315]
his fear entered there, O <s>Bhārata</s>, of that lord of birds — [<s>Mahābhārata</s> 13, App. 1A.316]

children.text: tuṇḍena gṛhya tāṃ śākhām utpapāta khageśvaraḥ //" iti [MBh 13, App. 1A.318]
children.translated_text: grasping that branch with his beak, the lord of birds flew up." Thus [says the <s>Mahābhārata</s> 13, App. 1A.318].
In the same [text], in the dialogue between <s>Umā</s> and <s>Maheśvara</s>:

children.text: "vaikhānasānāṃ vai dharmaṃ śrotum icchāmi dharmataḥ* //{276}* ity ārabhya
children.translated_text: "I wish to hear the <s>dharma</s> of the <s>Vaikhānasas</s> according to <s>dharma</s>." Beginning from this [verse],

children.text: teṣu vaikhānasā nāma vānaprasthāś śubhekṣaṇe / [MBh 13, App. 15.702]
children.translated_text: "Among those, the ones named <s>Vaikhānasa</s>, the <s>vānaprasthas</s>, O beautiful-eyed one, [<s>Mahābhārata</s> 13, App. 15.702]

children.text: tīvreṇa tapasā yuktā*{277}* dīptimantas sutejasaḥ //" iti [MBh 13, App. 15.703]
children.translated_text: endowed with intense austerity, radiant and brilliant." Thus [says the <s>Mahābhārata</s> 13, App. 15.703].
And in the <s>Harivaṃśa</s>, at the time of <s>Akrūra</s>'s arrival:
"[With] sparrow-[like sounds], in joy, at dusk, near at hand — [<s>Harivaṃśa</s> 68.4]

children.text: kiñcid abhyudite some śātiteṣu tamas su ca* //{280}* [Hariv 68.9]
children.translated_text: when the moon had somewhat risen and the darkness had abated — [<s>Harivaṃśa</s> 68.9]

children.text: vanyair vaikhānasair mantraiḥ hūyamāne hutāśane //" iti. [HariV 68.5cd]
children.translated_text: when oblations were being offered to the fire with forest <s>Vaikhānasa mantras</s>." Thus [says the <s>Harivaṃśa</s> 68.5cd].

children.text: pādme ca: "brāhmaṇaṃ vṛddhahārītaṃ vaikhānasamate sthitam //" iti ca varṇanāt*{281}* [PadmaP ]
children.translated_text: And in the <s>Padma</s> [Purāṇa]: "A <s>brāhmaṇa</s>, the aged <s>Hārīta</s>, established in the <s>Vaikhānasa</s> doctrine." Thus from the description. [<s>PadmaPurāṇa</s>]

children.text: vānaprasthasya śrautaviṣaye pṛthaktvena mantrapratipādanābhāvāc ca bodhāyanādibhir uktaprakāreṇa*{282}* vānaprasthasya vaikhānasatvaṃ vaikhānasasūtroktavānaprasthāśramasvīkārād evety avagantavyam.*{283}* etāvatā vikhanaś śabdārtho nirṇītaḥ.*{284}*
children.translated_text: And because there is no separate teaching of <s>mantras</s> for the <s>vānaprastha</s> in the domain of <s>śrauta</s> (Vedic) ritual, it should be understood that the <s>Vaikhānasa</s>-hood of the <s>vānaprastha</s>, as stated by <s>Baudhāyana</s> and others, is solely through the adoption of the <s>vānaprastha āśrama</s> as prescribed in the <s>Vaikhānasa Sūtra</s>. With this, the meaning of the word <s>Vikhanasa</s> has been determined.
(The manner of establishing the first reason)
The authorship of the <s>Vaikhānasa Sūtra</s> and <s>Śāstra</s> by <s>Vikhanasa</s>
Now, the fact that the <s>Vaikhānasa Sūtra</s> and <s>Śāstra</s> were composed by <s>Vikhanasa</s>, who is the cause of the entire universe, is being established.
In the <s>Viṣṇudharma</s>: "I shall tell what was formerly told to me by my father;

children.text: tasyāpi kila tatpitrā tasmai cāha kilośanāḥ* //{287}* [ViṣṇuDh 1.38]
children.translated_text: to him too, indeed, it was told by his father; and to him it was told by <s>Uśanā</s> (Śukra). [<s>Viṣṇudharma</s> 1.38]

children.text: ! MBh 13, App. 15.701: śrotum icchāmi ahaṃ prabho; DHN[T] 157: maheśvaraḥ.
! HariV: śakragopāhvayāmode pradoṣe 'bhyāśatas kare / saṃdhyām mayīm iva guhāṃ saṃpraviṣṭe divākare //. V.l. zu a: śakragotrāhvayāmode, śakragopāhvayābhāse, cakragotrāhvayāmode, cakragotrāhvayā goṣu.
! HariV: kiñcid abhyutthite some mandaraśmau virājati; v.l. zu a: kiñcid abhyudite, abhyudyate; b nicht im Harivaṃśa.
! DHN[T] 158 om. etāvatā vikhanaś śabdārtho nirṇītaḥ.

! Anmerkung des Herausgebers: vikhanovaikhānasādiśabdānāṃ (1) nārāyaṇe (2) tannābhinalina saṃbhūte caturānane (3) maharṣipravare, (4) tannāmasu mantradraṣṭṛṣu, (5) bhrgvādiṣu vaikhānasavaṃśakartṛṣu bhagavanmānasaputreṣu, (6) vaikhānasasūtreṇa aṣṭādaśasaṃskāravatsu bhagavatpriyatameṣv arcakeṣu, (7) tatsūtroktadharmānuṣṭhātṛṣu kalpasūtrāntarasaṃskṛteṣu hārītādiṣu, (8) tatsūtroktavidhinā tṛtīyāśramadharmānuṣṭhātṛṣu saubharyādiṣu, (9) vikhanasā sṛṣṭe samaste jagati, ca yathāyathaṃ mukhyayā vṛtyyā upacāreṇa vā prakṛtir bhavatīti iyatā ganthena pratipāditaṃ bhavati.
! DHN[T] 160 ins. sūtrasya praṇetā vikhanā akhilajagatkāraṇabhūtaḥ.

children.translated_text: Note: <s>Mahābhārata</s> reading: '<s>Vaikhānasa</s> ascetics by name.'

children.text: tenāpi bhṛgum ārādhya prāptam*{288}* ārādhanaṃ hareḥ /
children.translated_text: He too, having propitiated <s>Bhṛgu</s>, obtained the worship of <s>Hari</s>;
and <s>Bhṛgu</s>, the great-souled one, obtained it from <s>Brahmā</s>. [<s>Viṣṇudharma</s> 1.39]
It was obtained from the god <s>Brahmā</s>, whose birth is the Unmanifest." Thus [says the <s>Viṣṇudharma</s> 1.40ab].
The chain of transmission of the <s>Vaikhānasa</s> path

children.text: hārītasmṛtau: "pūrvaṃ vikhanaso*{290}* viṣṇuḥ proktavān svayam acyutaḥ /
children.translated_text: In the <s>HārītaSmṛti</s>: "First, <s>Viṣṇu</s>, the unchanging <s>Acyuta</s>, himself taught <s>Vikhanasa</s>;

children.text: bhṛgoḥ proktaṃ vikhanasā bhṛguṇā ca mameritam //" iti
children.translated_text: <s>Vikhanasa</s> taught it to <s>Bhṛgu</s>, and <s>Bhṛgu</s> communicated it to me." Thus [says the <s>HārītaSmṛti</s>].
The manner of origin of the <s>Pāñcarātra Āgama</s>
In the <s>GāruḍaPurāṇa</s>: "In ancient times, by the command of the four-faced [<s>Brahmā</s>], four pure sages

children.text: praṇīya vaiṣṇavaṃ śāstraṃ bhūmāv abhyarcayan nṛpa // [GaruḍaP ]
children.translated_text: composed the <s>Vaiṣṇava śāstra</s> and worshipped [<s>Viṣṇu</s>] on earth, O king. [<s>GaruḍaPurāṇa</s>]
<s>Marīci</s> worshipped <s>Viṣṇu</s> <s>Keśava</s> on <s>Mandara</s>;
by the command of <s>Brahmā</s>, <s>Atri</s> worshipped <s>Viṣṇu</s> at <s>Śrīnivāsa</s>; [<s>GaruḍaPurāṇa</s>]
<s>Kaśyapa</s> at the seat of <s>Viṣṇu</s>; the sage <s>Bhṛgu</s> in the auspicious field,

children.text: gaṅgāyā dakṣiṇe tīre sīmni tasyāntike 'pi ca* //{291}* [GaruḍaP ]
children.translated_text: on the southern bank of the <s>Gaṅgā</s>, at its border and in its vicinity; [<s>GaruḍaPurāṇa</s>]

children.text: tatsandhau śuciṣaṇṇāmā*{292}* bhṛguṇā sthāpito hariḥ //" iti coktam [GaruḍaP ]
children.translated_text: at that junction, <s>Hari</s> was installed by <s>Bhṛgu</s> under the name <s>Śuciṣaṇ</s>." Thus it is stated. [<s>GaruḍaPurāṇa</s>]

children.text: pāñcarātre: "ādye kaliyuge prāpte somakena hṛtā trayī /
children.translated_text: In the <s>Pāñcarātra</s>: "At the onset of the first <s>Kali</s> age, the threefold <s>Veda</s> was stolen by <s>Somaka</s>;
in the un-Vedic worlds, among the deities and sages,
Having approached the <s>Bhagavān</s> <s>Nārāyaṇa</s>, the faultless one,
<s>Ananta</s>, <s>Garuḍa</s>, <s>Viṣvaksena</s>, the Grandfather (<s>Brahmā</s>),
and <s>Śaṅkara</s> — these five, having taken refuge, asked:

children.text: śaṅkaraś caiva pañcaite papracchuḥ śaraṇaṃ gatāḥ /

children.translated_text: 'We are unable to abandon the worship of <s>Acyuta</s> even for a moment.

children.text: kṣaṇam apy acyutasyārcāṃ tyaktum eva na śaknumaḥ //

children.translated_text: In worlds that are non-Vedic, what shall we do, wavering in mind?
Therefore, O Lord of <s>Lakṣmī</s>, tell us a means, O Ancient One.'
Thus addressed, <s>Hari</s> taught them the <s>Pañcarātra</s> procedure in order,

children.text: ity uktas sa haris tebhyaḥ*{294}* pañcarātravidhiṃ kramāt /

children.translated_text: one <s>tantra</s> to each one during one night each.
'The <s>Pañcarātra</s> was elaborated in the measure of five <s>lakṣa</s>s [500,000 verses]
.' Beginning thus,
'The first was the night of <s>Brahmā</s>, the second the night of <s>Rudra</s>,
the third that which was the night of <s>Indra</s>, the fourth the night of the planets.

children.text: ! DHN[T] 161: nandāyā (gaṅgāyā) dakṣiṇe sīmni tasyottare 'pi ca.

children.translated_text: [Textual note:] DHN[T] 160: prokta (prāpta)m.
The fifth, the night of the Sage — thus is the <s>Pañcarātra</s> ordained.
Spoken in five nights, heard by five disciples.'

children.text: rātribhiḥ pañcabhiḥ proktaṃ śrutaṃ śiṣyaiś ca pañcabhiḥ //

children.translated_text: Therefore it obtained the name <s>Pañcarātra</s> (Five Nights) and abides on earth.'

children.text: tasmāt tat pañcarātrākhyāṃ labdhvā tiṣṭhati bhūtale //"

children.translated_text: With this ending, having established the origin and other matters of the <s>Pañcarātra</s>, the origin and other matters of the supremely Vedic <s>Śrīvaikhānasa</s> [tradition]

children.text: ity antena*{296}* pāñcarātrasyotpattyādikaṃ nirūpya paramavaidikasya śrīvaikhānasasyotpattyādikaṃ pratipādyate.*{297}*
children.translated_text: are set forth.
The manner of the origin of the <s>Vaikhānasa</s> scripture
Then the Lord of <s>Śrī</s>, having assumed the form of a fish (<s>Matsyāvatāra</s>), entering the midst of the ocean,
having churned [and defeated]
<s>Somaka</s>, gave the <s>Veda</s>s to the Lotus-born (<s>Brahmā</s>).
Having pleased that Lotus-eyed One with hymns, the Lotus-born (<s>Brahmā</s>)
spoke a word with love, prostrating like a staff:

children.text: uvāca vacanaṃ premṇā daṇḍavat praṇipatya ca //

children.translated_text: 'The worship of You that You taught by the <s>Tāntrika</s> path

children.text: tāntrikeṇa tvayā proktaṃ mārgeṇa bhavad arcanam*{298}* /

children.translated_text: does not satisfy our mind, O Lotus-eyed One.
Tell me Your worship by the Vedic [path]

children.text: vaidikena tvad arcāṃ me yathāpūrvaṃ vadācyuta /
children.translated_text: as of old, O <s>Acyuta</s>.'
Thus addressed, the divine <s>Bhagavān</s> [taught]

children.text: ity ukto bhagavān devaḥ śāstraṃ śrutipathāgatam //
children.translated_text: a scripture belonging to the path of <s>Śruti</s>,
measured in a thousand <s>koṭi</s>s of verses, very extensive,
having <s>sūtra</s> as its root, without beginning or end, resorted to in every <s>kalpa</s>.
He spoke it for the delight of the worlds and for the fulfillment of sacrifices,

children.text: uvāca jagatāṃ prītyai yajñānāṃ pūraṇāya ca /

children.translated_text: the root of all <s>Āgama</s>s and of the <s>Purāṇa</s>s as well,

children.text: mūlaṃ sarvāgamānāñ ca purāṇānāṃ tathaiva ca //

children.translated_text: of the <s>Smṛti</s>s, of all <s>Sūtra</s>s adorned with their subsidiary and ancillary [texts]
'The <s>Veda</s>s and the <s>Vikhanasa</s> scripture are the authority' — thus they declare.

children.text: vedāś ca vikhanaśśāstraṃ pramāṇam iti cerayan //

children.translated_text: As it is said: 'The <s>Vaikhānasa</s> [was given]
first; the morning is of the <s>Sāman</s>,'
'Those nails that were born on the earth — they are the <s>Vaikhānasa</s>s.'

children.text: ye nakhā bhuvi sañjātās te vai vaikhānasā iti //

children.translated_text: This scripture declared in <s>Śruti</s> is the great ocean of <s>Vaikhānasa</s>.
Having spoken thus, the primal <s>Bhagavān</s> vanished right there.
Thereafter the four-faced one (<s>Brahmā</s>), bearing matted locks, bark-garments, and staff,
having arrived at <s>Naimiśāraṇya</s>, resorted to by assemblies of twice-born,

children.text: ! DHN[T] 163: tāntrikeṇa mayā proktaṃ mārgeṇābhavad arcanam.

children.translated_text: [Textual note:] DHN[T] 162: (iddham).
having performed austerities for a long time, meditating on the <s>Vaiṣṇava</s> radiance,

children.text: tapas taptvā ciraṃ kālaṃ dhyāyaṃs tejas tu vaiṣṇavam /

children.translated_text: afterwards perceived in full the <s>Āgama</s> spoken by <s>Viṣṇu</s> —

children.text: paścād apaśyad viṣṇūktam āgamaṃ vistarāt tadā //

children.translated_text: with <s>Śrauta</s> and <s>Gṛhya</s> [portions]

children.text: saśrautañ ca sagṛhyañ*{301}* ca vedamantrair abhiṣṭutam /
children.translated_text: , celebrated with Vedic mantras.
Having condensed it, extracting the essence, like a gem polished on a whetstone,
<s>Dhātā</s> (<s>Brahmā</s>), known as <s>Vikhanasa</s>, the sages who are sons of <s>Marīci</s> and others —
he instructed them in this scripture, measured in one and a half <s>koṭi</s>s [of verses]
In every <s>kalpa</s>, <s>Viṣṇu</s> arose formerly, always as before.

children.text: kalpe kalpe purā viṣṇur udbhūtaḥ pūrvavat sadā /

children.translated_text: Therefore, for one who desires to perform Vedic observance on earth,

children.text: tasmād vaidikam ācāraṃ yaḥ kartuṃ bhuvi vāñchati //

children.translated_text: 'This scripture is for him' — it is said; it is not proclaimed for others.
The greatness of the <s>Vaikhānasa</s> <s>Sūtra</s> and its adherents

The sages said: 'What is the greatness of the <s>Vaikhānasa</s> <s>Sūtra</s>, O great sage,

<s>Sūtra</s>s, you follow it? [<s>Purātantra</s>.]

Let all the sages hear the supreme greatness of the <s>Sūtra</s>.' [<s>Purātantra</s>.]

all the <s>Veda</s>s established in his heart had been forgotten.' [<s>Purātantra</s>.]

children.translated_text: 'in the middle of the lotus of his heart, with supreme <s>samādhi</s>,

vedam ekaṃ subahudhā karoti jagatāṃ hitaḥ*
vīryaṃ tejo balañ cālpaṃ manuṣyāṇām avekṣya ca /
"eka āsīd yajurvedas taṃ caturdhā hy akalpayat /
cāturhotram abhūd yasmiṃs*{346}* tena yajñam athākarot // [Viṣṇu.P 3.4.11]
children.translated_text: The fourfold priesthood existed in which*{346}* — with that he then performed the sacrifice. // [Viṣṇu.P 3.4.11]

children.text: ārdhvaryavaṃ yajurbhis tu ṛgbhir hautraṃ tathā muniḥ*{347}* /
children.translated_text: The <s>Adhvaryu</s>-ship (office of the Adhvaryu priest) through the <s>Yajus</s> verses, and the <s>Hautra</s> (office of the Hotṛ priest) through the <s>Ṛc</s> verses — thus did the sage,*{347}*

children.text: audgātraṃ sāmabhiś cakre*{348}* brahmatvañ cāpy atharvabhiḥ // [Viṣṇu.P 3.4.12]
children.translated_text: perform the <s>Audgātra</s> (office of the Udgātṛ priest) through the <s>Sāman</s> chants,*{348}* and the <s>Brahmatva</s> (office of the Brahman priest) through the <s>Atharva</s> verses. // [Viṣṇu.P 3.4.12]

children.text: tatas sa ṛca uddhṛtya ṛgvedaṃ kṛtavān muniḥ /
children.translated_text: Then that sage, having extracted the <s>Ṛc</s> verses, composed the <s>Ṛgveda</s>,

children.text: yajurbhiś ca yajurvedaṃ*{349}* sāmavedañ ca sāmābhiḥ // [Viṣṇu.P 3.4.13]
children.translated_text: and through the <s>Yajus</s> verses the <s>Yajurveda</s>,*{349}* and through the <s>Sāman</s> chants the <s>Sāmaveda</s>. // [Viṣṇu.P 3.4.13]
With the <s>Atharvaveda</s>,*{350}* that lord caused all rites to be performed
for the king, O <s>Maitreya</s>, and the <s>Brahmatva</s> (office of the Brahman priest) as was proper. /// [ViṣṇuP 3.4.14]

children.text: so 'yam eko mahān vedatarus tena pṛthakkṛtaḥ*{351}* /
children.translated_text: This single great tree of the <s>Veda</s> was divided by him*{351}*
into four parts, and thus from it arose a forest of <s>Veda</s>-trees." // [ViṣṇuP 3.4.15]

children.text: ity antena spaṣṭaṃ pratipāditatvāt yajurveda eka eva prathamāsītity avagamyate.
children.translated_text: By the passage ending thus, it is clearly established that the <s>Yajurveda</s> alone was the original one — this is understood.

children.text: !{341}! Dieser Vers ist ähnlich als "Skandapurāṇa" zitiert in DHN[D] 71.10-11; als "Purātantra" in DHN[D] 34.9-10.
! Dieser Halbvers ist auch als "Skandapurāṇa" zitiert in DHN[D] 71.12.
! ViṣṇuP: vedam ekaṃ sa bahudhā karoti (subahudhā kurute) jagatī (jagato) hitaḥ.
! ViṣṇuP: ādhvaryyavaṃ yajurbhis tu ṛgbhir hotraṃ tathā muniḥ.
! ViṣṇuP: so 'yam eko mahāvedatarus tena pṛthakkṛtaḥ.

children.translated_text: !{341}! This verse is similarly cited as "<s>Skandapurāṇa</s>" in DHN[D] 71.10-11; as "<s>Purātantra</s>" in DHN[D] 34.9-10.
The establishment of the <s>Vaikhānasa</s> branch belonging to the <s>Yajurveda</s>

children.text: sa ca yajurvedaḥ: "bahuśṛṅgaś catus sānuḥ pṛthulo vedaparvataḥ" ity ārabhyoktarītyā vedavyāsarupiṇā bhagavatā yadā vyastaḥ, tataḥ pūrvam ekarūpeṇāvasthitasya tasya vedaparvatasya vaikhānasaśākhātvaprasiddhir āsīd iti pūrvam eva pratipāditam.
children.translated_text: And that <s>Yajurveda</s>: beginning from "The <s>Veda</s>-mountain, having many peaks and four summits, is vast" — when it was divided by the <s>Bhagavān</s> in the form of <s>Vedavyāsa</s> in the manner described, then the establishment of the <s>Vaikhānasa</s> branch of that <s>Veda</s>-mountain, which previously existed in a single form, was already demonstrated earlier.
The preeminence of the <s>Vaikhānasas</s>
The preeminence of the <s>Vaikhānasas</s> and their devotion to the five daily observances (<s>pañcakāla</s>)

children.text: *{352}*prasaṅgāt vaikhānasaśākhāmūlakatvena*{353}* praṇītasūtrānuṣṭhātṝṇāṃ śreṣṭhatvam acchidrapañcakālaparāyaṇatvādikañ ca pratipādyate.
children.translated_text: *{352}*Incidentally, the preeminence of those who practice the <s>sūtras</s> composed on the basis of the <s>Vaikhānasa</s> branch,*{353}* and their unbroken devotion to the five daily observances (<s>pañcakālaparāyaṇatva</s>), etc., are now demonstrated.
As in the <s>Sāmabrahmaṇa</s> (Chāndogya Brāhmaṇa):

children.text: "vaikhānasā vā ṛṣaya indrasya priyā āsan"*{354}* iti [ChāndogyaBr 2.23.1]
children.translated_text: "The <s>Vaikhānasa</s> sages were indeed dear to <s>Indra</s>."*{354}* [ChāndogyaBr 2.23.1]
The <s>Vaikhānasas</s> being most beloved of the <s>Bhagavān</s>
In the <s>Vārāha</s> [Purāṇa]:
"The <s>Aśvattha</s> (sacred fig tree), tawny cows, <s>Tulasī</s>, and <s>Vikhanas</s> likewise* /{355}*

children.text: catvāro matpriyā rājaṃs teṣāṃ vaikhānaso varaḥ* //{356}*" iti [VarāhaP]
children.translated_text: — these four are dear to me, O king, and among them the <s>Vaikhānasa</s> is the best.* //{356}*" [VarāhaP]
The fruit of seeing a <s>Vaikhānasa</s>
In <s>Vṛddhayājñavalkya</s>:
"A <s>Vaikhānasa</s> among the Vedic [practitioners] should follow what is prescribed by <s>Brahman</s>,

children.text: taṃ brāhmaṇan tu dṛṣṭvaiva sarvaṃ pāpaṃ vyapohati // [Vṛddhayājñavalkya.]
children.translated_text: and by merely seeing such a <s>Brāhmaṇa</s>, all sin is dispelled. // [Vṛddhayājñavalkya]

children.text: vaiṣṇavīṃ pratimāṃ loke vipraṃ vaikhānasaṃ tathā /
children.translated_text: By seeing the image of <s>Viṣṇu</s> in the world, a <s>Brāhmaṇa</s> who is a <s>Vaikhānasa</s>,

children.text: gaṅgāṃ viṣṇupadīṃ dṛṣṭvā sarvapāpaiḥ pramucyate* //{357}*" iti [Vṛddhayājñavalkya]
children.translated_text: and the <s>Gaṅgā</s>, called <s>Viṣṇupadī</s> (Born from Viṣṇu's foot) — one is freed from all sins.* //{357}*" [Vṛddhayājñavalkya]
The preeminence of the <s>Vaikhānasa</s> among devotees of <s>Viṣṇu</s>
In the <s>Śāntiparvan</s> (Book of Peace):
*{358}*Among a thousand reciters of mantras, the <s>brahmacārin</s> (celibate student) is superior,
among a thousand <s>brahmacārins</s>, the one who performs daily sacrifice is superior. // [MBh]
Among a thousand daily sacrificers, the <s>Soma</s>-sacrificer is superior,
among a thousand <s>Soma</s>-sacrificers, one who has mastered the <s>Veda</s> and <s>Vedānta</s> [is superior]. // [MBh]
Among a thousand who have mastered <s>Vedānta</s>, a devotee of <s>Viṣṇu</s> is superior,
among a thousand devotees of <s>Viṣṇu</s>, a <s>Brāhmaṇa</s> who is a <s>Vaikhānasa</s> is the best." // [MBh]

children.text: !{352}! DHN[T] 180 ins. vaikhānasānāṃ śraiṣṭhyaṃ acchidrapañcakālaparāyaṇatvañ ca.
! DHN[T] 180: vaikhānasas tathā; dieser Halbvers ist auch als "Purātantra" in DHN[D] 37.3 zitiert.

! ĀS 19.10; dieser Vers ist ohne Herkunftsangabe in DHN[D] 21.12-13 zitiert, als "Varāhapurāṇa" in DHN[D] 118.6-7, vgl. KrA 36.37: aśvatthaḥ kapilā gāvaḥ tulasī vikhano dvijaḥ / haripriyās tu catvāraḥ teṣu vaikhānaso varaḥ.
! Dieser Vers ist auch als "Purātantra" in DHN[D] 37.6-7 zitiert.
! Anm. des Herausgebers: mantriṇāṃ - adhītinām ity arthaḥ.

children.translated_text: !{352}! DHN[T] 180 inserts: The preeminence of the <s>Vaikhānasas</s> and unbroken devotion to the five daily observances.
The greatness of the <s>Puṣkara</s> pilgrimage site
The exclusive devotion (<s>ekāntitvam</s>) of the <s>Vaikhānasas</s>

children.text: brahmakaivarte: "nimnagānāṃ yathā gaṅgā devānāṃ bhagavān hariḥ /
children.translated_text: In the <s>Brahmakaivarta</s> [Purāṇa]: "Just as the <s>Gaṅgā</s> is [foremost] among rivers, and the <s>Bhagavān Hari</s> among the gods,

children.text: varṇānāṃ brāhmaṇaṃ śreṣṭhaḥ āśramāṇāṃ yatir yathā // [Brahmakaivarta.P ]
children.translated_text: as the <s>Brāhmaṇa</s> is foremost among the <s>varṇas</s> (classes), and the <s>yati</s> (renunciant) among the <s>āśramas</s> (stages of life), // [Brahmakaivarta.P]
as among the primordial <s>śrutis</s> (revealed scriptures), the <s>Ekāyanī śruti</s> is [foremost],

children.text: tasyāṃ niṣadyātha yasyāṃ niṣaṇṇo bhagavān hariḥ // [BrahmakaivartaP ]
children.translated_text: upon which the <s>Bhagavān Hari</s> is seated — // [BrahmakaivartaP]

children.text: vyūhānām ādibhūtas tu vāsudevo yathā paraḥ /
children.translated_text: as <s>Vāsudeva</s> is the supreme and primordial among the <s>vyūhas</s> (emanations),

children.text: trimūrtīnāṃ yathā viṣṇuḥ śivānān tu sadāśivaḥ // [Brahmakaivarta.P ]
