In that same [text] — in the dialogue of <s>Yajñadhvaja</s> and <s>Vītihotra</s>:
The fruit of placing a lamp and other acts in the temple
'He, once blinded by lust, desiring to sport with another's wife,

children.text: śūnyaṃ pūjādibhir viṣṇor mandiraṃ prāptavān niśi //
children.translated_text: came at night to the temple of <s>Viṣṇu</s>, empty of worship and the like.' //
'There, for the purpose of enjoying sensual pleasure, in order to lie down, by that lustful one,
O <s>Brāhmaṇa</s>, the cleaning of that area was performed with the edge of his own garment.' //
'As many dust particles as were swept by him at that time,

children.text: tāvaj janmakṛtaṃ pāpaṃ tadaiva kṣayam āgatam //
children.translated_text: that much sin accumulated over lifetimes was destroyed at that very moment.' //
'A lamp was placed there for the purpose of lovemaking, O best of twice-born,

children.text: tenāpi tasya duṣkarma niśśeṣaṃ kṣayam āgatam //
children.translated_text: by that [act] too, his evil deeds were completely destroyed.' //
'If by such an action done involuntarily he attained this perfection,

children.text: bhaktimadbhiḥ praśāntaiś ca kiṃ punas samyagarcanāt //
children.translated_text: then what more [can be said] of those devoted and tranquil ones who worship properly?' //
The fruit of circumambulating the temple
'Therefore, hear, O lords of <s>Brāhmaṇas</s>! The imperishable God <s>Nārāyaṇa</s>
grants liberation to worshippers, whether [their worship is performed] knowingly or unknowingly.' //
Likewise, in that same [text] — in the dialogue of <s>Indra</s> and <s>Sudharma</s>:
'I was formerly, O <s>Śakra</s>, a vulture, due to the residue of sin,
staying on the ground, eating impure flesh.' //
'Once, while perched on the enclosure wall of a temple of <s>Viṣṇu</s>,
I was struck down by the weapon of a hunter at the evening hour, having entered [the area of] the temple of <s>Viṣṇu</s>.' //
'While my life-breath was in my throat, a certain dog, greedy for flesh,

children.text: jagraha māṃ svavaktreṇa śvabhir anyair abhidrutaḥ //
children.translated_text: seized me in its mouth, chased by other dogs.' //
'It went in a circumambulatory path around that temple of the Lord <s>Viṣṇu</s>.',
'By that alone, the Inner Self, who pervades the world, was pleased.' //

children.text: mama cāpi śunaś cāpi dattavān paramaṃ padam /
children.translated_text: 'And to me as well as to the dog, he granted the supreme state.',

children.text: pradakṣiṇākāratabis hier noch Telugu vergleichenyā gatasya sadṛśaṃ phalam //
children.translated_text: 'The fruit equivalent to one who has gone in circumambulation' //

children.text: samprāptaṃ tu mayā śakra*{512}* kiṃ punas samyag arcanāt /
children.translated_text: 'was obtained by me, O <s>Śakra</s>! How much more then from proper worship?'
'Those who always worship with devotion the imperishable <s>Nārāyaṇa</s>,

children.text: tān arcayanti vibudhā brahmādyā devatāgaṇāḥ //"*{513}* iti
children.translated_text: them the gods, the hosts of deities beginning with <s>Brahmā</s>, worship.' // Thus.
The five impure things

children.text: evam āśvamedhike: "loke trīṇy apavitrāṇi pañcāmedhyāni bhārata / [MBh 13, App. 4.3249]
children.translated_text: Similarly, in the <s>Āśvamedhika</s> [Parvan]: 'In the world there are three impure things and five unclean things, O <s>Bhārata</s>.' [MBh 13, App. 4.3249]

children.text: śvā ca śūdraś śvapākaś ca tryapavitrāṇi pāṇḍava* /{514}* [MBh 13, App. 4.3250]
children.translated_text: 'A dog, a <s>Śūdra</s>, and a <s>Śvapāka</s> (dog-cooker) — these are the three impure things, O <s>Pāṇḍava</s>.' [MBh 13, App. 4.3250]

children.text: devalaḥ kukkuṭo yūpaḥ udakyā vṛṣalīpatiḥ //" [MBh 13, App. 4.3251]
children.translated_text: 'A <s>Devalaka</s> (temple attendant), a rooster, a sacrificial post, a menstruating woman, and the husband of a <s>Śūdra</s> woman.' // [MBh 13, App. 4.3251]
These are the five unclean things. Thus.
Those who are not qualified for the worship of the Lord and other rites
In the <s>Śrīvaikhānasa</s> [text]: '<s>Sūtas</s> and other mixed-caste persons, heretics, and the fallen,
atheists, those who transgress boundaries, and also those who denigrate the <s>Vedas</s>,
those afflicted with sinful diseases, and likewise those who disparage the <s>guru</s> —
are not fit to witness the worship of the God of gods nor the offering of oblations.

children.text: ! MBh: śvā ca śūdraś śvapākaś cety apavitrāṇi pāṇḍava.

children.translated_text: [Textual variant note:] DHN[T] 253: 'samprāptaṃ vibudhaśreṣṭha' (O best of the wise).
Therefore, one should make a doorway covered with a curtain.' //

children.text: iti pratipādanāt bhagavadarcanadarśanādiṣu yogyatārahitānāṃ nikṛṣṭānāṃ (devalakānāṃ) autkṛṣṭyaṃ na sambhavati.*{516}*
children.translated_text: From this statement, the superiority of the lowly ones — <s>devalakas</s> (temple attendants) — who are devoid of qualification for such things as the worship and viewing of the Lord, is impossible.
The superiority of those who worship the Lord without a doorkeeper (<s>advāraka</s>)

children.text: śrutismṛtipurāṇādiṣūktaprakāreṇa kalpasūtre*{517}* yeṣām advārakabhagavadyajanādhikāro vidhīyate te utkṛṣṭā jñeyāḥ*{518}*. yathā śrutiḥ: "yathā kratur asmin loke bhavati tathetaḥ pretya bhavati"*{519}* iti.
children.translated_text: Those for whom the qualification for the worship of the Lord without a doorkeeper (<s>advāraka</s>) is prescribed in the <s>Kalpasūtra</s>, in the manner stated in <s>Śruti</s>, <s>Smṛti</s>, <s>Purāṇas</s>, and other texts — they should be known as superior. As the <s>Śruti</s> [says]: 'As one's sacrificial rite is in this world, so it is after departing from here.' //
And the <s>Smṛti</s> [says]: 'Those devotees who worship Me who dwell in the hearts of all beings,

children.text: mām arcayanti ye bhaktās*{522}* sāyujyaṃ yānti te mama //
children.translated_text: through the method prescribed by the <s>Veda</s> as taught by <s>Bhārgava</s> (<s>Bhṛgu</s>) — they attain union (<s>sāyujya</s>) with Me.' //

children.text: tasmād yāvaj jano jīvet tāvat sampūjayed dharim /
children.translated_text: 'Therefore, as long as a person lives, so long should he worship <s>Hari</s>.',

children.text: pāpair na lipyate martyo*{523}* harimandiram āpnuyāt //
children.translated_text: 'A mortal is not stained by sins and attains the abode of <s>Hari</s>.' //

children.text: jagat pavitrās te nityaṃ viṣṇum abhyarcayanti ye /
children.translated_text: 'Those who always worship <s>Viṣṇu</s> are the purifiers of the world.',

children.text: durvṛttā vā suvṛttā vā pūjanīyā viśeṣataḥ //"
children.translated_text: 'Whether of bad conduct or good conduct, they are especially to be honored.' //
The <s>Vaikhānasas</s> being objects of the Lord's love

children.text: vyāsenapi*{524}* ānuśāsanike (90. adhyāye) pātrakathanāvasare*{525}* devalakānām apātratāṃ satkarmaniṣṭhānāṃ pātratāñ ca pratipādya svavacanadṛḍhīkaraṇārthaṃ "vaikhānasā vā ṛṣaya indrasya priyā āsan"*{526}* iti bhagavatprītiviṣayāṇāṃ*{527}* vaikhānasānāṃ vacanam api śrūyate iti pratipāditam. yathā:
children.translated_text: <s>Vyāsa</s> also, in the <s>Anuśāsana</s> [Parvan] (chapter 90), on the occasion of discussing worthy recipients, having established the unworthiness of <s>devalakas</s> and the worthiness of those devoted to righteous deeds, and in order to strengthen his own statement, has established that the saying of the <s>Vaikhānasas</s> is also heard — 'The <s>Vaikhānasa</s> sages were dear to <s>Indra</s>' — [referring to] the <s>Vaikhānasas</s> who are objects of the Lord's love. As follows:
'Those <s>Brāhmaṇas</s> who always observe the code of the sages, O <s>Yudhiṣṭhira</s>,

children.text: niścitāḥ sarvadharmajñās tān devā brāhmaṇān viduḥ // [MB.h 13.9.42]
children.translated_text: who are resolute, knowers of all <s>dharmas</s> — the gods know them as [true] <s>Brāhmaṇas</s>.' // [MBh 13.9.42]
'Sages devoted to self-study, those devoted to knowledge,

children.text: taponiṣṭhāś ca boddhavyāḥ karmaniṣṭhāś ca bhārata // [MBh 13.9.43]
children.translated_text: those devoted to austerity, and those devoted to [ritual] action — these should be understood, O <s>Bhārata</s>.' // [MBh 13.9.43]
'The funerary offerings should be established among those devoted to knowledge, O <s>Bhārata</s>.',

children.text: tatra ye brāhmaṇān ke cin na ca nindanti te varāḥ* //{531}* [MBh 13.9.44]
children.translated_text: 'And among them, those <s>Brāhmaṇas</s> who do not disparage [others] — they are the best.' // [MBh 13.9.44]

children.text: ye tu nindanti jalpeṣu na tāñ śrāddheṣu bhojayet /
children.translated_text: 'But those who disparage [others] in disputes should not be fed at <s>śrāddha</s> ceremonies.',

children.text: brāhmaṇā ninditā rājan hanyus tripuruṣaṃ kulam* //{532}* [MBh 13.9.45]
children.translated_text: '<s>Brāhmaṇas</s> who are disparaged, O king, destroy a family to three generations.' // [MBh 13.9.45]

children.text: !{516}! DHN[T] 254 statt DHN[D] 61.2-3: (iti) bhagavaddarśanādiṣu yogyatārahitānāṃ nikṛṣṭānāṃ utkṛṣṭatvādikaṃ na sambhavati. bhagavadarcakānām autkṛṣṭyaṃ.
! Vgl. ŚatapathaBr 10.6.3.[1]: yāvat kratur ayam asmāl lokāt praity evaṃ kratur hāmuṃ lokam pretyābhisambhavati.
! ChāndogyaBr 2.23.1; ebenfalls zitiert in DHN[D] 21.8, 41.8 und 118.4.
! MBh: tatra ye brāhmaṇāḥ ke cin na nindati hi te varāḥ.

children.translated_text: [Textual variant note:] DHN[T] 254, instead of DHN[D] 61.2-3: 'The superiority and so forth of the lowly ones who are devoid of qualification for the viewing and other [activities] of the Lord is impossible. The superiority of the worshippers of the Lord.'
'The saying of the <s>Vaikhānasa</s> sages is heard, O king.',
'One should examine from afar <s>Brāhmaṇas</s> who have mastered the <s>Vedas</s>.',

children.text: priyo vā yadi vā dveṣyaḥ teṣu tac chrāddham āvapet* //{533}* [MBh 13.9.46]
children.translated_text: 'Whether dear or hateful, one should bestow the <s>śrāddha</s> offering upon them.' // [MBh 13.9.46]

children.text: yaḥ sahasraṃ sahasrāṇāṃ bhojayed anṛcāṃ naraḥ /
children.translated_text: 'A man who would feed a thousand of thousands of those who do not know the <s>Ṛc</s> (Vedic hymns),

children.text: ekas tān mantravit pūtaḥ sarvān arhati bhārata* //{534}*" [MBh 13.9.47]
children.translated_text: a single knower of <s>mantras</s>, purified, is worthy of [the merit of feeding] all of them, O <s>Bhārata</s>.' // [MBh 13.9.47]
The greatness of those devoted to the recitation of the <s>Aṣṭākṣara</s> (eight-syllable) and other <s>mantras</s>

children.text: evaṃ aṣṭākṣara dvādaśākṣara puruṣasūktādimantrajapaniṣṭhānāṃ darśanena brahmahā 'pi śuddhyatīti purāṇoktam. yathā*{535}*:
children.translated_text: Thus, it is stated in the <s>Purāṇas</s> that even by seeing those who are devoted to the recitation of the <s>Aṣṭākṣara</s> (eight-syllable), <s>Dvādaśākṣara</s> (twelve-syllable), <s>Puruṣasūkta</s>, and other <s>mantras</s>, even a slayer of a <s>Brāhmaṇa</s> is purified. As follows:
In the <s>Padma Purāṇa</s>: 'With its limbs, with its <s>mantras</s>, with its renunciation, with its sages, meters, and presiding deities,
with its initiation-ritual, with its meditation, with its <s>yantra</s> (mystical diagram) — the twelve-syllable [<s>mantra</s>], // [<s>Padma Purāṇa</s>]

children.text: sāṣṭākṣarañ ca mantreśaṃ ye japanti narottamāḥ /
children.translated_text: together with the eight-syllable [<s>mantra</s>], the lord of <s>mantras</s> — those best of men who recite these,

children.text: tān dṛṣṭvā brahmahā śuddhyet kiṃ punar vaiṣṇavas svayam //" iti [PadmaP ]
children.translated_text: by merely seeing them, even a slayer of a <s>Brāhmaṇa</s> is purified — how much more then a <s>Vaiṣṇava</s> himself!' // Thus. [<s>Padma Purāṇa</s>]

children.text: śruyate 'pi. "yo ha vai nārāyaṇasyāṣṭākṣaraṃ padam adhyeti anupabravas sarvam āyur eti vindate prājāpatyaṃ rāyaspoṣaṃ gaupatyaṃ tato 'mṛtatvam aśnute tato 'mṛtatvam aśnuta iti".
children.translated_text: It is also heard [in <s>Śruti</s>]: 'He who recites the eight-syllable <s>pada</s> (word/verse) of <s>Nārāyaṇa</s>, with <s>anupravas</s> (proper instruction), lives the full span of life, obtains the blessing of <s>Prajāpati</s>, prosperity of wealth, lordship over cattle, and thereafter attains immortality — thereafter attains immortality.'
In the <s>Śrīpāñcarātra</s>, in the <s>Kapiñjala Saṃhitā</s>:
'Engaged in performing sacrifices and teaching, bestowing grace upon disciples,
he should be known as an <s>ācārya</s> (teacher), devoted to <s>mantras</s> and <s>tantras</s>. // [<s>Kapiñjala Saṃhitā</s>]

children.text: āśrame vā vane vā 'pi sa vaikhānasa ucyate* /{538}*
children.translated_text: Whether in an <s>āśrama</s> (hermitage) or in the forest, he is called a <s>Vaikhānasa</s>.',
'A forest-dweller should abandon all village customs.' // Thus. [<s>Kapiñjala Saṃhitā</s>]
In the <s>Yama Smṛti</s>: 'A mortal who has slain a learned twice-born person out of greed for wealth,

children.text: sa vadet pauruṣaṃ sūktaṃ jalasthaś cintayed dharim* //{541}*"
children.translated_text: should recite the <s>Puruṣasūkta</s> and, while standing in water, meditate on <s>Hari</s>.' //

children.text: iti kevalāṣṭākṣaramantrajapaniṣṭhānām apy evaṃ vidhāḥ prabhāvāḥ śrūyanta iti cet śrutismṛtivihitais tair eva mantraiḥ advārakabhagavadarcane mukhyādikāriṇāṃ vaikhānasānāṃ kaimutikanyāyasiddham autkṛṣṭyaṃ kenāpodituṃ śakyam.*{542}*
children.translated_text: If it is objected that such powers are heard even for those devoted merely to the recitation of the <s>Aṣṭākṣara mantra</s>, [the response is:] who can deny the superiority, established by the a fortiori argument (<s>kaimutika-nyāya</s>), of the <s>Vaikhānasas</s>, who are the primary qualified persons for the direct worship of the Lord with those very <s>mantras</s> prescribed by <s>Śruti</s> and <s>Smṛti</s>?

children.text: !{533}! MBh: priyān vā yadi vā dveṣyāṃs.
! MBh: ekas tān mantravit prītaḥ; DHN[T] 257: ekas tān mantravit putas sarvam arhati bhārateti (10 adhyāye).

! DHN[T] 258-259 verschiebt das Padmapurāṇa-Zitat weiter nach hinten und liest somit statt DHN[D] 62.8-19: śruyate hi. "yo ha vai nārāyaṇasyāṣṭākṣaraṃ padam adhyeti anapabruvas sarvam āyur eti vindate prājāpatyaṃ rāyaspoṣaṃ gaupatyaṃ tato 'mṛtatvam aśnute tato 'mṛtatvam aśnuta iti". aṣṭākṣaraparā vaikhānasāḥ. kapiñjalasaṃhitāyām: yājanādhyāpanayutaḥ śiṣyān ugrahakārakaḥ / ācārya iti vijñeyo mantratantraparāyaṇaḥ // āśram.e vā vane vā 'pi sa vaikhānasa ucyate / grāmyadharmāṇi sarvāṇi varjayed vanavāsaka // iti. padmapurāṇe: sāṅgaṃ samantraṃ sanyāsaṃ sarṣicchandadaivatam / sadīkṣāvidhi sadhyānaṃ sayajñaṃ (yantraṃ?) dvādaśākṣaram // aṣṭākṣarañ ca mantreśaṃ ye japanti narottamāḥ / tān dṛṣṭvā brahmahā śuddhyet kiṃ punar vaiṣṇavas svayam // iti.
! Vgl. das Zitat aus "Kapiñjalasaṃhitā" in DHN[D] 93.6-7: āśrame vā vane vā 'pi putradārasamāhitaḥ / aṣṭākṣaraparo nityaṃ sa vaikhānasa ucyate //.

! DHN[T] 261-263 statt DHN[D] 62.22-24: kevalāṣṭākṣarādimantrajapaniṣṭhānām evaṃvidhāḥ prabhā hiś śrūyante (iti) cet śrutismṛtisūtravihitais tair eva mantraiḥ advārakabhagavadarcane mukhyādikāriṇāṃ kaimutikanyāya siddham utkṛṣṭatvādikaṃ neti. śrutismṛtisūtrapurāṇādyarthatattvān abhijñād aprāmāṇikodanākalitapūrvottarān mahāsāhasikodunmattādanyaḥ vā brūyāt? punardevalakatvādivicāraḥ.

children.translated_text: [Textual variant note:] MBh reads: 'priyān vā yadi vā dveṣyāṃs' (whether dear or hateful).
Determination regarding <s>devalakas</s> (temple attendants)

children.text: kiñca - yathā vaikhānasānām utpattyādikaṃ śrutismṛtipurāṇādiṣu viśeṣeṇa pratipāditaṃ tathā itareṣāṃ viśeṣeṇa pratipāditañ cet tadā vaikhānasasāmyam itareṣāṃ syāt. tathā na dṛśyate hi.
children.translated_text: Moreover — if the origin and other aspects of others were specifically established in <s>Śruti</s>, <s>Smṛti</s>, <s>Purāṇas</s>, and other texts just as the origin and other aspects of the <s>Vaikhānasas</s> are specifically established therein, then there would be equality of others with the <s>Vaikhānasas</s>. But this is not seen to be the case.
Now, the <s>devalakas</s> are examined as they truly are.
In the <s>Vaikhānasa</s> [text]: 'A non-<s>Vaikhānasa</s> <s>Brāhmaṇa</s> who would worship <s>Hari</s> in the temple
He is indeed called a <s>devalaka</s> (temple-keeper), excluded from <s>havya</s> (oblations to gods) and <s>kavya</s> (oblations to ancestors);
born in a <s>Vaikhānasa</s> family, but initiated into the <s>Pāñcarātra</s> —

children.text: na dīkṣito na sañjāto (?) lobhān mohān madarcanam* /{545}*
children.translated_text: one who is neither initiated nor born [in the proper lineage], who out of greed, delusion, and pride performs worship,

children.text: kuryāc cet tu viśeṣeṇa bhaved devalakas to saḥ //"*{546}*
children.translated_text: if he does so, he especially becomes that <s>devalaka</s>."
The threefold classification of <s>devalaka</s>s
In the <s>Pāñcarātra</s>, <s>Saṃkarṣaṇasaṃhitā</s>: "Some are <s>karmadevalaka</s>s (ritual-devalakas), others are <s>kalpadevalaka</s>s (procedural-devalakas);
yet others are <s>śuddhadevalaka</s>s (pure-devalakas) — <s>devalaka</s>s are remembered as being of three kinds. // [<s>Saṃkarṣaṇasaṃhitā</s>]
Definition of <s>karmadevalaka</s>

children.text: arthārthī kālanirdeśī yo devaṃ pūjayet sa hi /
children.translated_text: One who worships the deity seeking wealth and prescribing times —
he is called a <s>karmadevalaka</s>, excluded from all [sacred] rites. // [<s>Saṃkarṣaṇasaṃhitā</s>]
One who knows the procedures of the <s>Pāñcarātra</s>, a worshipper devoid of <s>dīkṣā</s> (initiation),
even though qualified in the four <s>Veda</s>s, is known as a <s>kalpadevalaka</s>. // [<s>Saṃkarṣaṇasaṃhitā</s>]
One who knows the procedures stated in the <s>Āgama</s>s, who subsists by [worshipping] <s>Bhadrakālī</s>,
is declared a <s>śuddhadevalaka</s>, excluded from all [sacred] rites. // [<s>Saṃkarṣaṇasaṃhitā</s>]
By the procedure stated by the <s>Ṛṣi</s>s, the status of <s>devalaka</s> does not exist;
therefore, with every effort, one should worship only by the Vedic [method]." Thus. [<s>Saṃkarṣaṇasaṃhitā</s>]
In the <s>Śivaśekharatantra</s> — <s>Rudra</s> [speaks]:
"Now I shall speak of <s>devalaka</s>s; listen, O goddess, with attention.
Some are <s>karmadevalaka</s>s, others are <s>kalpadevalaka</s>s; // [<s>Śivaśekharatantra</s>]
yet others are <s>śuddhadevalaka</s>s — <s>devalaka</s>s are known as being of three kinds.
One who worships for a year by the method prescribed in another <s>sūtra</s> — //

children.text: !{543}! DHN[T] 263-4 statt DHN[D] 63.1-4: punar devalakatvādivicāraḥ. kiñca - yathā vaikhānasānām utpattyādikaṃ śrutismṛtipurāṇādiṣu viśeṣeṇa pratipāditaṃ evam itareṣāṃ brāhmaṇasāmānyatvena vinā viśeṣeṇa pratipāditaṃ cet tadānīmetādṛguṇaviśiṣṭā vayam iti. tair vaktum ucitam anyathā asaṃtaṃ? nindyām ātmastutiṃ mūḍhetarāḥ svaparagataviśeṣajñāḥ ke vā brūyaḥ? devalakalakṣaṇaṃ nirūpyate yathā.
! Dieser Vers ist ähnlich als "Purātantra" zitiert in DHN[D] 38.12-13.
! Vgl. ĀS 19.15: vaikhānasakule jātaḥ pañcarātreṇa dīkṣitaḥ / na dīkṣito na jāto vai sa vai devalakas smṛtaḥ.

children.translated_text: [Footnote 543: DHN[T] 263-4 instead of DHN[D] 63.1-4: 'Further investigation of the <s>devalaka</s> status and related matters. Moreover — just as the origin and other matters of the <s>Vaikhānasa</s>s have been specially established in <s>Śruti</s>, <s>Smṛti</s>, <s>Purāṇa</s>s, etc., if the same for others is established only generically as <s>Brāhmaṇa</s>s without special distinction, then it is proper for them to say: "We possess such special qualities." Otherwise, would the ignorant, who claim unfounded [superiority], engage in reprehensible self-praise? Who that knows the distinctions of self and others would say so? The definition of <s>devalaka</s> is being determined as follows.']
<s>Śivaśekharatantra</s>
Definition of <s>kalpadevalaka</s>

children.text: adīkṣitaḥ svayaṃ tantre karmadevalakas tu saḥ /
children.translated_text: one who is uninitiated in the <s>tantra</s> himself — he is a <s>karmadevalaka</s>;
in this very manner, one who worships for three years,

children.text: kalpadevalakaḥ proktaḥ sa vai śailasute dhruvam // [Śivaśekharatantra]
children.translated_text: is declared a <s>kalpadevalaka</s> — that is certain, O daughter of the Mountain. // [<s>Śivaśekharatantra</s>]
Definition of <s>śuddhadevalaka</s>

children.text: ananujñātam ācāryāt āgamaṃ śuśruve ca yaḥ /
children.translated_text: One who has heard an <s>Āgama</s> without authorization from a teacher,

children.text: śīlataḥ tasya śiṣyaś ca śuddhadevalakāv ubhau // [Śivaśekharatantra]
children.translated_text: and his pupil by conduct — both are <s>śuddhadevalaka</s>s. // [<s>Śivaśekharatantra</s>]
The threefold <s>devalaka</s> status pertains only to the domain of <s>Rudra</s> and others

children.text: tridhā devalakatvaṃ tu na viṣṇuviṣaye kvacit /
children.translated_text: The threefold <s>devalaka</s> status never applies in the domain of <s>Viṣṇu</s>;
it pertains to the domain of <s>Rudra</s>, <s>Kālī</s>, and others — this is approved by the <s>Āgama</s>s." Thus. [<s>Śivaśekharatantra</s>]

children.text: smṛtyantare: "śarvaṃ sūryaṃ tathā candraṃ durgādī rudradevatāḥ /
children.translated_text: In another <s>Smṛti</s>: "<s>Śarva</s> (Śiva), <s>Sūrya</s>, <s>Candra</s> (the Moon), <s>Durgā</s> and others — the deities of <s>Rudra</s> —

children.text: yo 'rcayet paṇapūrvaṃ saḥ sadyaḥ patati mānavaḥ //
children.translated_text: whoever worships them for payment, that person immediately falls. //

children.text: durgā ca bhadrakālī ca buddhaś ca kṣetrapālakaḥ /
children.translated_text: <s>Durgā</s>, <s>Bhadrakālī</s>, <s>Buddha</s>, and <s>Kṣetrapālaka</s> (field-guardian) —

children.text: pañcapūjā ca ity ete pañcadevalakāḥ smṛtāḥ //
children.translated_text: the worship of these five: these are known as the five [types of] <s>devalaka</s>s. //
<s>Āditya</s> (the Sun), <s>Ambikā</s>, <s>Viṣṇu</s>, <s>Gaṇanātha</s> (Gaṇeśa), and <s>Maheśvara</s> (Śiva) —

children.text: gṛhe pūjā ca ity ete pañcadevalakāḥ smṛtāḥ (?) //" iti*{548}*
children.translated_text: the worship of these in the home: these are known as the five [types of] <s>devalaka</s>s (?)." Thus.
In the <s>Viṣṇudharmottara</s>: "Those who worship <s>Caṇḍikā</s>, <s>Durgā</s>, <s>Jyeṣṭhā</s>, <s>Bhairava</s>,

children.text: rudrasya pūjakā ye vai te vai devalakāḥ smṛtāḥ //" iti [ViṣṇudharmottaraP ]
children.translated_text: and <s>Rudra</s> — they are indeed known as <s>devalaka</s>s." Thus. [<s>Viṣṇudharmottara Purāṇa</s>]
<s>Viṣṇu</s> [Purāṇa]: "Even one devoted to worshipping the deity, if he does so for another's benefit out of desire for wealth,

children.text: caturvedadharo vipraḥ sa caṇḍālasamo bhaved* //{551}*" iti [ViṣṇuP ]
children.translated_text: even a <s>Brāhmaṇa</s> who upholds the four <s>Veda</s>s becomes equal to a <s>Caṇḍāla</s> (outcaste)." Thus. [<s>Viṣṇu Purāṇa</s>]

children.text: *{552}*evam ebhir vacanaiḥ śāstrānanumatamārgeṇa pūjakānāṃ devatāntarapūjakānām eva ca devalakatvaṃ siddhyatīti sphuṭam avagamyate.
children.translated_text: Thus, from these statements, it is clearly understood that the status of <s>devalaka</s> is established only for those who worship by a method not approved by the <s>śāstra</s>s and for those who worship other deities.

children.text: kiñca: "vṛṣo dharmas samākhyataḥ tasya yaḥ kurute layam /
children.translated_text: Moreover: "<s>Dharma</s> is declared to be the bull (<s>vṛṣa</s>); whoever causes its destruction —

children.text: vṛṣalaṃ taṃ vidur devā nikṛṣṭaṃ śvapacād api //"
children.translated_text: the gods know him as a <s>vṛṣala</s> (degraded one), more debased than even a <s>śvapaca</s> (dog-cooker)."

children.text: !{548}! DHN[T] 275 ins. iti kiñca hārīta: vaikhānasās ti ye viprā haripūjanatatparāḥ. na te devalakā proktā viṣṇupādābjasaṃśrayāḥ iti. smṛtiratnākare atri: vaidikenaiva vidhinā daṃbhalobhavivarjitaḥ pūjayed bhaktito viṣṇuṃ sa hi devalako na vai iti. Zitiert als "Hārīta" in DHN[D] 65.3-4 und als "Smṛtyarthasāra" in DHN[D] 65.5-6.

! DHN[T] zieht hier das Zitat von Hārīta aus DHN[D] 65.3-4 und aus Smṛtyarthasāra aus DHN[D] 65.5-6 vor: hārīta: vaikhānasās ti ye viprā haripūjanatatparāḥ /na te devalakā proktā viṣṇupādābjasaṃśrayāḥ // iti. smṛtiratnākare atri: vaidikenaiva vidhinā daṃbhalobhavivarjitaḥ pūjayed bhaktito viṣṇuṃ sa hi devalako na vai iti.

! DHN[T] 276 statt DHN[D] 64.18-65.7: kiñca devaśabdasya dhātvarthe vicāryamāṇe "div" krīḍāvijigīṣāvyavahāradyutistutimodamadasvapnakāntigatiṣv" iti devaṃ vedaśāstroktamārgaṃ liyata iti devalakaḥ svārthe "ka" pratyayaḥ. "vṛṣo dharmas samākhyataḥ tasya yaḥ kurute layam / vṛṣalaṃ taṃ vidur devā nikṛṣṭaṃ śvapacād api //" iti vṛṣalaśabdavyutpattir darśitā.

children.translated_text: [Footnote 548: DHN[T] 275 inserts: 'Thus, and further, <s>Hārīta</s>: "Those <s>Brāhmaṇa</s>s who are <s>Vaikhānasa</s>s, devoted to the worship of <s>Hari</s> — they are not declared to be <s>devalaka</s>s, since they take refuge at the lotus-feet of <s>Viṣṇu</s>." Thus. In the <s>Smṛtiratnākara</s>, <s>Atri</s>: "One who worships <s>Viṣṇu</s> with devotion, by the Vedic method alone, free from ostentation and greed — he is indeed not a <s>devalaka</s>." Thus. Cited as "<s>Hārīta</s>" in DHN[D] 65.3-4 and as "<s>Smṛtyarthasāra</s>" in DHN[D] 65.5-6.']
Etymology of the word <s>devalaka</s>

children.text: iti vṛṣalaśabdo yathā vedaśāstroktamārgalayakārake vyutpāditaḥ, tathā devalakśabdo 'pi "div krīḍāvijigīṣāvyavahāradyutistutimodamadasvapnakāntigatiṣv" iti dhātvarthānusāreṇa gatyaparaparyāyamārgārthakadivdhātughaṭitassan vedoktamārgalayaprāpake vyutpādayituṃ śakyate iti tatpratīpeṣu vedamārgapratiṣṭhāpakeṣu vaikhānaseṣu na sarvātmanā pravartate. tathā ca:
children.translated_text: Just as the word <s>vṛṣala</s> is etymologically derived for one who causes the destruction of the path prescribed by the <s>Veda</s>s and <s>śāstra</s>s, so too the word <s>devalaka</s>, following the meanings of the root '<s>div</s>' — 'play, desire to conquer, transact, shine, praise, delight, intoxicate, sleep, radiance, go' — being formed from the root <s>div</s> in the sense of 'going' (i.e., 'path'), can be etymologically derived for one who leads to the destruction of the Vedic path. Therefore, it does not apply in any way to the <s>Vaikhānasa</s>s, who are the very establishers of the Vedic path. Accordingly:
<s>Hārīta</s>: "Those <s>Brāhmaṇa</s>s who are <s>Vaikhānasa</s>s, devoted to the worship of <s>Hari</s> —

children.text: na te devalakāḥ proktā viṣṇupādābjasaṃśrayāt* //{553}*" iti [Vṛddhahārīta 8.78]
children.translated_text: they are not declared to be <s>devalaka</s>s, since they take refuge at the lotus-feet of <s>Viṣṇu</s>." Thus. [<s>Vṛddhahārīta</s> 8.78]
The non-applicability of the term <s>devalaka</s> to the <s>Vaikhānasa</s>s
In the <s>Smṛtyarthasāra</s>, <s>Atri</s>: "By the Vedic method alone, free from ostentation and greed,

children.text: pūjayed bhaktito viṣṇuṃ sa hi devalako na vai* //{554}*" iti
children.translated_text: one who worships <s>Viṣṇu</s> with devotion — he is indeed not a <s>devalaka</s>." Thus.

children.text: *{555}*anyathā śrutyuktamārgeṇālayārcakānām api devalakatve tādṛśālayārcanapratipādakānāṃ śrutismṛtipurāṇādivacanānāṃ vyarthatā syāt.
children.translated_text: Otherwise, if even those who worship in temples by the method prescribed in <s>Śruti</s> were [considered] <s>devalaka</s>s, then the statements of <s>Śruti</s>, <s>Smṛti</s>, <s>Purāṇa</s>s, etc. that prescribe such temple worship would be rendered purposeless.

children.text: *{556}*nanu - ajñānataḥ kṛtam api bhagavadārādhanam apavargapradañ cet. vinā śāstraṃ anadhikāriṇāpi kṛtaṃ tatapavargapradaṃ kiṃ na syād iti cet. na. bhagavadājñābhaṅgāpatteḥ.
children.translated_text: Objection: If even worship of the Lord performed in ignorance grants liberation (<s>apavarga</s>), then would not worship performed without <s>śāstra</s>, even by one without qualification, also grant liberation? Answer: No. Because [such conduct] would entail violation of the Lord's command.

children.text: yathoktaṃ bhagavatā: "yaś śāstravidhim utsṛjya vartate kāmakārataḥ /
children.translated_text: As stated by the Lord: "He who abandons the injunction of the <s>śāstra</s>s and acts according to his own desire

children.text: na sa siddhim avāpnoti na sukhaṃ na parāṃ gatim //" iti [MBh 6.38.23]
children.translated_text: does not attain perfection, nor happiness, nor the supreme goal." Thus. [MBh 6.38.23 = BhG 16.23]
"<s>Śruti</s> and <s>Smṛti</s> are My very commands; he who transgresses them and acts [otherwise],

children.text: ājñācchedī mama drohī madbhakto 'pi na vaiṣṇavaḥ* //{557}*" iti
children.translated_text: he is a violator of My command, a traitor to Me — even if he is My devotee, he is not a <s>Vaiṣṇava</s>." Thus.
"And dear to Me and to <s>Viṣṇu</s>, the god of gods, the wielder of <s>Śārṅga</s> —

children.text: mānuṣo vaidikācāraṃ manasā 'pi na laṅghayet //" iti
children.translated_text: a human should not transgress the Vedic conduct even in thought." Thus.

children.text: *{558}*ataḥ anadhikāriṇā kṛtaṃ śāstrāsammatam iti tantroktaprakāreṇa kṛtam api tat nāpavargapradam.*{559}*
children.translated_text: Therefore, [worship] performed by one without qualification, being unapproved by the <s>śāstra</s>s — even though performed in the manner prescribed by the <s>tantra</s>s — does not grant liberation.

children.text: nanu: "brāhmaṇaiḥ kṣatriyaiḥ vaiśyaiḥ śūdraiś ca kṛtalakṣaṇaiḥ /
children.translated_text: Objection: "By <s>Brāhmaṇa</s>s, <s>Kṣatriya</s>s, <s>Vaiśya</s>s, and <s>Śūdra</s>s who bear the [proper] marks,

children.text: arcanīyaś ca sevyaś ca pūjanīyaś ca mādhavaḥ /
children.translated_text: <s>Mādhava</s> (Viṣṇu) is to be worshipped, served, and adored

children.text: sāttvataṃ vidhim āsthāya gītaḥ saṅgarṣaṇena*{560}* yaḥ //"
children.translated_text: in accordance with the <s>Sāttvata</s> procedure, as proclaimed by <s>Saṃkarṣaṇa</s>."
The non-granting of liberation by worship according to the <s>tantra</s> method

children.text: *{561}*iti śūdrādīnām api pāñcarātroktamārgeṇārcane adhikāre siddhe kathaṃ tāntrikoktaprakāreṇārcanaṃ kurvataḥ brāhmaṇādeḥ (anadhikāriṇaḥ) tat apavargapradaṃ na bhavatīty ucyata iti ced ucyate.
children.translated_text: [Objector:] Since the qualification of even <s>Śūdra</s>s and others for worship by the <s>Pāñcarātra</s>-prescribed method is established, how can it be said that worship performed by a <s>Brāhmaṇa</s> (who lacks qualification in that system) in the <s>tantra</s>-prescribed manner does not grant liberation? To this it is replied:

children.text: !{553}! Vṛddhahārīta: na te devalakāḥ jñeyā haripādābjasaṃśrayāt.
! Nach Kane, HD 2.1: Atri in "Smṛtyarthasāra". Vgl. Kane, HD 2.1, und HD 1.2, S. 1156.

! DHN[T] 277 statt DHN[D] 65.7-8: anyathā śrutismṛtipurāṇapañcarātrādiṣu pratipāditānāṃ vacanānāṃ vyarthatā syāt. śarvādyarcanāvidhipratipādakasya bodhāyanasyāpi patitatvaṃ saṃbhavati, tatsūtropajīviṣu tacchiṣyeṣv āpastambādiṣv atyantapātityaṃ kaimutikanyāyasiddhaṃ.

! DHN[T] 277 statt DHN[D] 65.9-10: nanu - ajñānataḥ kṛtam bhagavadārādhanam apavargapradañ ced. anadhikāriṇaś śāstroktamārgeṇa vinā 'py apavargapradaṃ kiṃ na syād iti cen naivaṃ bhagavadājñābhaṅgakṛttvāt.
! Dieser Vers ist auch zitiert in DHN[D] 56.6-7.
! DHN[T] 278 statt DHN[D] 65.17-18: ato 'nadhikāriṇas tāntrikoktaprakāreṇa kurvato 'pavargapradatvaṃ? na saṃbhavati.
! In DHN[D] 69.1-2 wird auf diese Aussage Bezug genommen.
! DHN[T] 278 statt DHN[D] 65.22-24: iti śūdrādīnām api pāñcarātre 'dhikāro vidhīyate kathaṃ vā tāntrikoktena prakāreṇa kurvato 'pavargapradaṃ na bhavatīty ucyata iti ced ucyate.

children.translated_text: [Footnote 553: <s>Vṛddhahārīta</s>: 'They are not to be known as <s>devalaka</s>s, since they take refuge at the lotus-feet of <s>Hari</s>.']
One initiated in one of the four <s>tantra</s>s has no qualification in another
"The first is the <s>Mantrasiddhānta</s>; the second is called <s>Āgama</s>; // [<s>PādmaSaṃhitā</s>, <s>Caryāpāda</s> 19.112cd]
the third is the <s>Tantrasiddhānta</s>; beyond that is <s>Tantrāntara</s>." // [<s>PādmaSaṃhitā</s>, <s>Caryāpāda</s> 19.113ab]
Thus among these four types of <s>siddhānta</s>s:
"One who is initiated in one <s>tantra</s> or <s>siddhānta</s>, O best of the twice-born,

children.text: kriyāṃ na kuryād anyatra karṣaṇādi caturmukha // [Pādma.S caryāpāda 19.131]
children.translated_text: should not perform the rites of another, such as the <s>karṣaṇa</s> and so forth, O four-faced one. // [<s>PādmaSaṃhitā</s>, <s>Caryāpāda</s> 19.131]
The office of <s>ācārya</s> (teacher), the office of <s>ṛtvij</s> (ritual priest), and the worship of the enemy of <s>Madhu</s> (Viṣṇu) —

children.text: mantre deve ca siddhānte tad evāsya hi yujyate* //{564}*" [PādmaS caryāpāda 19.132]
children.translated_text: in the <s>mantra</s>, the deity, and the <s>siddhānta</s>, only that same one is fitting for him." // [<s>PādmaSaṃhitā</s>, <s>Caryāpāda</s> 19.132]

children.text: iti caturvidhatantreṣu ekatra dīkṣitasya tantrāntare praveśayogyatābhāvasya pratipādanāt*{565}*.
children.translated_text: Thus, since it is established that one initiated in one of the four types of <s>tantra</s>s lacks eligibility to enter another <s>tantra</s>,
"Born in a single <s>gotra</s> (lineage), [yet] with five <s>gotra</s>s separately —" beginning from this [verse],

children.text: sūtraṃ kātyāyanaṃ śākhāṃ yājuṣaṃ*{566}* śuklam eva ca //
children.translated_text: "the <s>sūtra</s> of <s>Kātyāyana</s>, the <s>Yajurveda</s> branch, the white (<s>Śukla</s>) [recension], //
<s>Aupagāyana</s>, <s>Śāṇḍilya</s>, <s>Bhāradvāja</s>, and <s>Gautama</s>,
and <s>Mauñjāyani</s> — these five are qualified for the <s>Pāñcarātra</s>."
Because the distinction of qualified persons is being prescribed [thus].
One consecrated by <s>Āpastamba</s> and other <s>sūtra</s>s is not eligible for <s>Pāñcarātra</s> sacraments
"For all four <s>varṇa</s>s and for others born of them,

children.text: dīkṣā samaiva sarveṣām ācāras tantravartmanā //" [PādmaS caryāpāda 21.55]
children.translated_text: the <s>dīkṣā</s> (initiation) is the same for all, [following] the conduct by the <s>tantra</s> path." // [<s>PādmaSaṃhitā</s>, <s>Caryāpāda</s> 21.55]
Only those initiated by the <s>tantra</s>-prescribed method are qualified for <s>tantra</s>-prescribed worship

children.text: ityāpastambādisūtraiḥ*{568}* saṃskṛtasya pāñcarātroktamārgeṇa niṣekādisaṃskārayogyatābhavakathanāt.*{569}* tāntrikoktaprakāreṇa dīkṣitānām eva tantroktārcanāyām adhikāritva sambhavāt.
children.translated_text: Because it is stated that one consecrated by <s>Āpastamba</s> and other <s>sūtra</s>s is not eligible for the sacraments beginning with <s>niṣeka</s> by the method prescribed in the <s>Pāñcarātra</s>, and because qualification for <s>tantra</s>-prescribed worship is possible only for those initiated in the <s>tantra</s>-prescribed manner.
The fallen status of one who follows another's <s>dharma</s>
"While abiding in one's own <s>sūtra</s>, if one follows another's <s>sūtra</s>,

children.text: apramāṇam ṛṣiṃ kṛtvā so 'ndhe tamasi majjati //"
children.translated_text: having rendered the <s>Ṛṣi</s> unauthoritative, he sinks into blind darkness."
"One who abandons one's own <s>dharma</s> and resorts to another's <s>dharma</s>,

children.text: patitas sa bhaved āśu sadya eva na saṃśayaḥ //"
children.translated_text: he becomes fallen immediately, at once — there is no doubt."
"From abandoning one's own <s>sūtra</s> and resorting to another's <s>sūtra</s>,

children.text: sadyaḥ patati vai vipro na vedasya samāśraye //"*{571}*
children.translated_text: a <s>Brāhmaṇa</s> immediately falls — but not if he resorts to the <s>Veda</s>."

children.text: ! DHN[T] 278: tad evāpi na yujyata. PādmaS: ācāryatvam athārtvijyaṃ pūjāyāṃ madhuvidviṣaḥ / tantrabhede ca siddhāntabhede cāpi na yujyate //; v.l.: tantrabhede ca siddhānte tad evāpi na yujyate.
! Vgl. ĪśvaraS 21.519: pañcāyudhāṃśāste pañca śāṇḍilyaś caupagāyanaḥ / mauñjyāyanaḥ kauśikaś ca bhāradvājaś ca yoginaḥ //.
! Dieser Vers ist ähnlich zitiert in DHN[D] 35.4-5.

children.translated_text: [Footnote 562: <s>PādmaSaṃhitā</s>: 'The fourth would be <s>Tantrāntara</s>.']

children.text: "śākhāṃ śikhāṃ tathā puṇḍraṃ samayācāram eva ca /
children.translated_text: "The branch (<s>śākhā</s>), the topknot (<s>śikhā</s>), the sectarian mark (<s>puṇḍra</s>), and the observance of the [sectarian] code —

children.text: pūrvair ācaritaṃ kuryād anyathā patito bhavet //"
children.translated_text: one should practice what was practiced by one's forefathers; otherwise one becomes fallen."
"One who abandons one's own branch (<s>śākhā</s>) and follows other branches,
he is to be known as a <s>śākhāraṇḍa</s> (branch-apostate), excluded from all [sacred] rites." [<s>ĀpastambaSūtra</s> 4.59]
"One who abandons one's own <s>dharma</s> and follows another's <s>dharma</s> —

children.text: pāṣaṇḍinaṃ tam āhur vai nikṛṣṭaṃ śvapacād api //" iti.
children.translated_text: they call him a <s>pāṣaṇḍin</s> (heretic), more debased than even a <s>śvapaca</s> (dog-cooker)." Thus.
The Lord: "Better is one's own <s>dharma</s>, though imperfect, than another's <s>dharma</s> well-performed;

children.text: svadharme nidhanaṃ śreyaḥ paradharmo bhayāvahaḥ* //{573}*" iti. [MBh 6.25.35]
children.translated_text: death in one's own <s>dharma</s> is preferable; another's <s>dharma</s> is fraught with danger." Thus. [MBh 6.25.35 = BhG 3.35]
<s>Vyāsa</s>: "One who abandons one's own <s>dharma</s> and resorts to another's <s>dharma</s>,
when there is no emergency, he is declared by the learned to be fallen."

children.text: *{574}*ityādibhiś ca vacanaiḥ paradharmānuṣṭhātuḥ patitatvādismaraṇāc ca anyasūtroktaprakāreṇa tāntrikoktena mārgeṇa vā bāhmaṇādibhir*{575}* api anadhikāribhiḥ bhagavadārādhanaṃ kartuṃ na śakyate.
children.translated_text: And because of such statements, and because the fallen status of one who performs the <s>dharma</s> of another [<s>varṇa</s>] is taught, it is not possible for <s>brāhmaṇas</s> and others who are unqualified to perform the worship of the <s>Bhagavān</s> by the method stated in other <s>sūtras</s> or by the path taught in <s>Tantras</s>.
The disqualification of the <s>śūdra</s> for worship

children.text: tarhi "brāhmaṇaiḥ kṣatriyair vaiśyaiḥ" ityādi *{576}*bhāratavacanasya kā gatir iti cet - ucyate.
children.translated_text: If it is asked — then what is the import of the <s>Bhārata</s> statement 'By <s>brāhmaṇas</s>, <s>kṣatriyas</s>, and <s>vaiśyas</s>' etc.? — it is answered:

<s>Mādhava</s>s [say]: He (<s>Hari</s>) is to be worshipped (<s>pūjanīya</s>) by <s>brāhmaṇas</s> who have been determined as having the primary, non-intermediary qualification for the worship of the <s>Bhagavān</s>.

children.text: *{578}*itaraiḥ kṣatriyair vaiśyaiś cārcanīyaḥ. śūdraiḥ strībhiś ca yathārham ijyas sevyaś ca iti tasya vacanasyārthaḥ.
children.translated_text: He is to be honored (<s>arcanīya</s>) by the others — <s>kṣatriyas</s> and <s>vaiśyas</s>. By <s>śūdras</s> and women, He is to be served (<s>ijya</s>) and attended (<s>sevya</s>) according to their respective capacity — such is the meaning of that statement.
"... by <s>śūdras</s>, women, and others,

children.text: yathārham ijyas sevyaś ca nityaṃ sarveśvaro hariḥ //"
children.translated_text: <s>Hari</s>, the lord of all, is always to be served and attended according to one's capacity."

children.text: iti bhāradvājavacanāt "arghyāntam arcanaṃ proktaṃ havirantañ ca pūjanam //" ity arcanapūjanayoḥ bhinnārthakatvapratipādanāt, sarvair ekarītyā pūjane 'bhimate ekapadasyaiva paryāptatvāt itarayoḥ padayor vaiyarthyāpātāc ca. anyathā śūdrasyāpi pūjārcanādiṣv adhikārāṅgīkāre śrutismṛtisūtrapurāṇādivirodho bhavet.
children.translated_text: From the statement of <s>Bhāradvāja</s>, and because of the teaching that <s>arcana</s> (ritual worship) and <s>pūjana</s> (ceremonial honoring) have different meanings — as stated: 'Worship (<s>arcana</s>) is said to extend up to the <s>arghya</s> (offering of water), and ceremonial honoring (<s>pūjana</s>) up to the oblation (<s>havis</s>)' — and because if the same mode of worship were intended for all, a single term would suffice, and the other two terms would become redundant. Otherwise, if the qualification of the <s>śūdra</s> for worship, arcana, and the like were accepted, there would be contradiction with <s>Śruti</s>, <s>Smṛti</s>, <s>Sūtra</s>, <s>Purāṇa</s>, and other [authorities].

children.text: śūdrasyānadhikārapratipādakāni vacanāni caitāni. śruti "tasmāc chūdro yajñe 'navakḷptaḥ. sa hi devatā anvasṛjata tasmāc chūdro bahupaśur ayajñīyo daiva" iti.
children.translated_text: The following statements demonstrate the disqualification of the <s>śūdra</s>. The <s>Śruti</s>: 'Therefore the <s>śūdra</s> is not fit for sacrifice. For he did not follow along when the deities [were created]. Therefore the <s>śūdra</s> is one of many cattle, unfit for sacrifice, of divine [origin].'

children.text: !{572}! ĀS: svaśākhāṃ samparityajya paraśākhānusārataḥ / śākhāraṇḍas sa vijñeyas sarvakarmabahiṣkṛtaḥ //.
! Dieser Vers ist auch in DHN[D] 47.10-11 zitiert.
! DHN[T] 280 statt DHN[D] 67.11-12: iti paradharmānuṣṭhātuḥ patitatvādisambhavāc ca anyasūtroktamārgeṇa vā tāntrikoktena mārgeṇa vā bhagavadārādhanaṃ kartuṃ na śakyate.
! DHN[T] 281 om. tarhi "brāhmaṇaiḥ kṣatriyair vaiśyaiḥ" ityādi.

! DHN[T] 281 statt DHN[D] 67.15-25: itaraiḥ kṣatriyair vaiśyaiś cārcanīyaḥ. śūdraiḥ strībhirathetaraiḥ yathārham ijyas sevyaś ca nityam sarveśvaro harir" iti anyathā. śrutismṛtiḥ sūtrapurāṇādīnāṃ virodhaḥ. "arghyāntam arcanaṃ proktaṃ havirantañ ca pūjanam /" ity vacanād ekatarapadavaiyarthyaṃ. śūdrasyārcanādāv anadhikāraḥ kā vā śrutir iti cet "tasmāc chūdro yajñe nānaklīptaḥ. sa hi devatā anvasṛjata tasmāc chūdro bahupaśur ayajñīyā daivaḥ iti.

children.translated_text: Note: <s>ĀpastambaSūtra</s>: 'Having abandoned one's own branch and following another branch, one is to be known as a branch-outcaste, excluded from all rites.'
<s>Smṛti</s>: '<s>Japa</s> (recitation), <s>tapas</s> (austerity), pilgrimage, renunciation, <s>mantra</s>-practice,
and the worship of deities — these six are fallen for women, <s>śūdras</s>, and outcasts.'
The duty of the <s>śūdra</s> is only service to the twice-born
In the <s>ŚrīBhāgavata</s>: 'Service to the twice-born and to cows, and to the gods without deceit,

children.text: tatra labdhena santoṣaḥ śūdraprakṛtayas tv imāḥ* //{580}*" iti [BhāgavataP 11.17.19]
children.translated_text: and contentment with what is obtained therein — these are the innate qualities of a <s>śūdra</s>.' [<s>BhāgavataPurāṇa</s> 11.17.19]

children.text: manau: "brāhmaṇasya tapo jñānaṃ tapaḥ kṣatrasya rakṣaṇam /
children.translated_text: In <s>Manu</s>: 'For a <s>brāhmaṇa</s>, austerity is knowledge; for a <s>kṣatriya</s>, austerity is protection;

children.text: vaiśyasya tu tapo vārtā tapaś śūdrasya sevanam //" iti [ManuDhŚ 11.235]
children.translated_text: for a <s>vaiśya</s>, austerity is trade; for a <s>śūdra</s>, austerity is service.' [<s>ManuDharmaśāstra</s> 11.235]

children.text: anyatra*{581}*: "yadi śūdras tapaḥ kuryād vedadṛṣṭena vartmanā /
children.translated_text: Elsewhere: 'If a <s>śūdra</s> should perform austerity by the path prescribed in the <s>Vedas</s>,

children.text: iha cāsya parikleśaḥ pretya cāsyāśubhā gatiḥ //" iti.
children.translated_text: in this life there will be torment for him, and after death an inauspicious destiny.'

children.text: kimarthaṃ śūdrasya dvijaśuśrūṣā sarvadā abhihiteti cet - ucyate. janmāntarīyakarmavaśāt jananakāle 'pi tamoguṇair abhibhūtasya tasya śūdrasya tamonirasanārthaṃ dvijaśuśrūṣaṇaṃ brahmaṇā prayuktam.*{582}*
children.translated_text: If it is asked — for what reason is service to the twice-born always enjoined for the <s>śūdra</s>? — it is answered: Because of the power of <s>karma</s> from former lives, the <s>śūdra</s>, who at the very time of birth is overwhelmed by the <s>guṇas</s> (qualities) of <s>tamas</s> (darkness), was appointed by <s>Brahmā</s> to service of the twice-born for the purpose of removing that <s>tamas</s>.

children.text: āśvamedhike: "udite savitar yasya kriyāyuktasya dhīmataḥ / [MBh 14, App. 4.1690]
children.translated_text: In the <s>Āśvamedhika</s> [Parvan]: 'When the sun has risen, of the wise one engaged in ritual action, [<s>Mahābhārata</s> 14, App. 4.1690]
even in the body of one who upholds the four <s>Vedas</s>, six <s>vṛṣalas</s> (impurities) are established. [<s>Mahābhārata</s> 14, App. 4.1691]

children.text: kṣatriye sapta vijñeyā vaiśye tv aṣṭau prakīrtitāḥ* /{584}* [MBh 14, App. 4.1692]
children.translated_text: In a <s>kṣatriya</s>, seven are to be known; in a <s>vaiśya</s>, eight are declared. [<s>Mahābhārata</s> 14, App. 4.1692]

children.text: niyatāḥ pāṇḍavaśreṣṭha śūdre 'ṣṭāviṃśatiḥ khalu* //{585}*" ity ārabhya [MBh 14, App. 4.1693]
children.translated_text: In a <s>śūdra</s>, O best of the <s>Pāṇḍavas</s>, twenty-eight indeed are fixed.' Beginning from this, [<s>Mahābhārata</s> 14, App. 4.1693]

children.text: "rāgadveṣau ca mohaś ca pāruṣyañ ca nṛśaṃsatā* /{586}* [MBh 14, App. 4.3340]
children.translated_text: 'Passion and hatred, delusion, harshness, and cruelty, [<s>Mahābhārata</s> 14, App. 4.3340]

children.text: śāṭhyañ ca dīrghavairañ ca atimānamanārjavam* //{587}* [MBh 14, App. 4.3341]
children.translated_text: deceit and long-lasting enmity, excessive pride, and dishonesty, [<s>Mahābhārata</s> 14, App. 4.3341]

children.text: anṛtañ cāpavādaś ca paiśunyam atilobhatā* /{588}* [MBh 14, App. 4.3342]
children.translated_text: falsehood and calumny, slander and excessive greed, [<s>Mahābhārata</s> 14, App. 4.3342]

children.text: hiṃsā steyaṃ mṛṣāvādo vañcanā roṣalobhate* //{589}* [MBh 14, App. 4.3343]
children.translated_text: violence, theft, false speech, deception, anger and greed, [<s>Mahābhārata</s> 14, App. 4.3343]

children.text: abuddhatā ca nāstikyaṃ bhayam ālasyam eva ca* /{590}* [MBh 14, App. 4.3344]
children.translated_text: stupidity and atheism, fear and laziness, [<s>Mahābhārata</s> 14, App. 4.3344]

children.text: aśaucañ cākṛtajñatvaṃ dambhatā stambha eva ca* //{591}* [MBh 14, App. 4.3345]
children.translated_text: impurity and ingratitude, hypocrisy and obstinacy, [<s>Mahābhārata</s> 14, App. 4.3345]

children.text: niṣkṛteś cāpy avijñānaṃ janane śūdram āviśan* /{592}* [MBh 14, App. 4.3346]
children.translated_text: and ignorance of expiation — [these] enter the <s>śūdra</s> at birth. [<s>Mahābhārata</s> 14, App. 4.3346]

children.text: dṛṣṭvā pitāmahaḥ śūdram abhibhūtan tu tāmasaiḥ // [MBh 14, App. 4.3347]
children.translated_text: The Grandfather (<s>Brahmā</s>), seeing the <s>śūdra</s> overwhelmed by <s>tāmasic</s> [qualities], [<s>Mahābhārata</s> 14, App. 4.3347]

children.text: dvijaśuśrūṣaṇaṃ dharmaṃ śūdrāṇān tu prayuktavān / [MBh 14, App. 4.3348]
children.translated_text: appointed service to the twice-born as the <s>dharma</s> of <s>śūdras</s>. [<s>Mahābhārata</s> 14, App. 4.3348]

children.text: naśyanti tāmasā bhāvāḥ śūdrasya dvijabhaktitaḥ //" iti. [MBh 14, App. 4.3349]
children.translated_text: The <s>tāmasic</s> dispositions of the <s>śūdra</s> are destroyed through devotion to the twice-born.' [<s>Mahābhārata</s> 14, App. 4.3349]

children.text: ! BhāgavataP: śuśrūṣaṇaṃ dvijagavāṃ devānāṃ cāpy amāyayā / tatra labdhena santoṣaḥ śūdraprakṛtayas tv imāḥ.

! DHN[T] 283 statt DHN[D] 68.6-11: śūdrasya dvijaśuśrūṣāvidhāne hetuḥ. kimarthaṃ śūdrasya dvijaśuśrūṣā sarvadā abhihiteti cet - janmāntarakarmavaśāt jananakāle 'pi tamoguṇair abhibhūtasya tamoguṇanirasanārthaṃ dvijaśuśrūṣaṇaṃ brahmaṇo prayuktam.
! MBh: caturvedavidaś cāpi dehe ṣaḍvṛṣalāḥ smṛtāḥ.
! DHN[T] 283 mit MBh: kṣatriyāḥ sapta vijñeyā vaiśyās tv aṣṭau prakīrtitāḥ.
! DHN[T] 283 mit MBh: niyatāḥ pāṇḍavaśreṣṭha śūdrāṇām ekaviṃśatiḥ.
! MBh: rāgo dveṣaś ca mohaś ca.
! MBh: śāṭhyañ ca dīrghavairitvam; DHN[T] 283: śārthañ.
! MBh: nikṛtiś cāpi avijñānam jātake śūdram āviśet; DHN[T] 284: aviśat;

children.translated_text: Note: DHN[T] 282: 'The service of the <s>śūdra</s>: in the <s>Bhāgavata</s>.'
The manner of worship of the <s>Bhagavān</s> by those belonging to <s>sūtras</s> other than the <s>Vaikhānasa</s>

children.text: ataḥ tamoguṇābhibhūtasya śūdrasya bhagavadyajanādhikāro nāsty eva.*{593}*
children.translated_text: Therefore, for the <s>śūdra</s>, who is overwhelmed by the <s>guṇa</s> of <s>tamas</s>, there is absolutely no qualification for the worship of the <s>Bhagavān</s>.

children.text: nanv eṣāṃ*{594}* śaunakādyuktaprakāreṇa bhagavadārādhane 'dhikāro bhaved iti cet*{595}* - tad asat. tatra adhikāriviśeṣapratipādanābhavāt; sāmānyenoktatve 'pi śrutismṛtisūtrapurāṇamahābhāratavaikhānasapāñcarātraśaivaśilpajyautiṣādiṣu adhikāriṇāṃ viśiṣya pratipāditatvāt*{596}* sarvaśākhāpratyayanyāyena sāmānyaviśeṣanyāyena "matprakaraṇādhītaṃ sarvaṃ madartham" iti nyāyena prakaraṇasāmyena*{597}*, upāsya devataikyāt guṇopasaṃhāranyāyena ca śaunakādibhir uktārcanāvidher api atraiva paryavasānaṃ yuktam.
children.translated_text: If it is objected that they should have qualification for the worship of the <s>Bhagavān</s> by the method stated by <s>Śaunaka</s> and others — that is not correct. Because there is no teaching of a specific [different] qualified person therein; and although stated in general terms, since in the <s>Śruti</s>, <s>Smṛti</s>, <s>Sūtra</s>, <s>Purāṇa</s>, <s>Mahābhārata</s>, <s>Vaikhānasa</s>, <s>Pāñcarātra</s>, <s>Śaiva</s>, <s>Śilpa</s> (architecture), <s>Jyotiṣa</s> (astrology), and other [texts] the qualified persons have been specifically established — by the principle of coordination of all branches, by the principle of general and particular, by the principle 'everything studied in my context is for my purpose,' by the similarity of context, and by the principle of inclusion of attributes due to the identity of the deity being worshipped — it is fitting that the worship-rite stated by <s>Śaunaka</s> and others also culminates in this very [<s>Vaikhānasa</s> system].

children.text: *{598}* itarasūtriṇām katham iti cet - svāśramadharmācaraṇenaiva bhagavadārādhanaphalam siddhyati. yathocyate:
children.translated_text: If it is asked — how then for those belonging to other <s>sūtras</s>? — The fruit of worshipping the <s>Bhagavān</s> is accomplished through the performance of the <s>dharmas</s> of one's own <s>āśrama</s>. As it is said:

children.text: smṛtiṣu: "bahvalpaṃ vā svagṛhyoktaṃ yasya karma pracoditam /
children.translated_text: In the <s>smṛtis</s>: 'Whether much or little, the action enjoined in one's own <s>Gṛhya</s> [sūtra],

children.text: tasya tāvati śāstrārthe kṛte sarvaṃ kṛtaṃ bhavet //" iti
children.translated_text: when that much of the scriptural teaching is performed, everything is accomplished.'
In the <s>ŚrīViṣṇuPurāṇa</s>: 'By a person observing the conduct of his <s>varṇa</s> and <s>āśrama</s>, the Supreme Person,
<s>Viṣṇu</s>, is worshipped. There is no other path that pleases Him.' [<s>ViṣṇuPurāṇa</s> 2.8.9]
Likewise elsewhere: 'The <s>dharmas</s> prescribed in scripture for the <s>varṇas</s> and <s>āśramas</s>, O best of sages —

children.text: teṣu tiṣṭhan naro viṣṇum ārādhayati nānyathā* //{599}* [ViṣṇuP 3.8.19.1-2?]
children.translated_text: a man standing in those worships <s>Viṣṇu</s>, and not otherwise. [<s>ViṣṇuPurāṇa</s> 3.8.19.1-2?]

children.text: ye yajanti pitṝn devān brāhmaṇāṃś ca hutāśanam /
children.translated_text: Those who sacrifice to the ancestors, the gods, the <s>brāhmaṇas</s>, and the fire,

children.text: sarvabhūtāntarātmānaṃ viṣṇum eva yajanti te //" iti
children.translated_text: they sacrifice to <s>Viṣṇu</s>, the inner Self of all beings.'

children.text: purāṇāntare: "agnikāryaṃ japaṃ snānaṃ tapas svādhyāyam eva ca /
children.translated_text: In another <s>Purāṇa</s>: 'Fire-ritual, <s>japa</s>, bathing, austerity, and self-study —

children.text: tam evoddiśya deveśaṃ kuru nityam atandritaḥ //
children.translated_text: perform these always, without laziness, directing them to that Lord of gods.

children.text: prātar utthāya vidhivat snātvā nityaṃ samāhitaḥ /
children.translated_text: Rising early in the morning, having bathed according to rule, always composed,

children.text: yajet karmabhis tais taiḥ viṣṇuṃ devādisaṃjñitam //"
children.translated_text: one should worship <s>Viṣṇu</s>, designated as the god of gods, with those various rites.'

children.text: ! Anm. des Herausgebers: māstu śūdrāṇām adhikāraḥ, vaikhānasetarabrāhmaṇānāṃ kṣatriyāṇāṃ vaiśyānāṃ ca kena mārgeṇa bhagavadārādhanam iti pṛcchati itarasūtriṇām ityādinā. praśnasyāsya pūrvam eva samādhānam uktam. adhunā prakārāntareṇa samādhānam āha - svāśrametyādinā.

children.translated_text: Note: DHN[T] 285: 'not his alone.'

children.text: śāṇḍilya:"prakṛttaiś ca nivṛttaiś ca svargadair mokṣadair api /
children.translated_text: <s>Śāṇḍilya</s>: 'Through <s>dharmas</s> that are active and abstinent, both heaven-conferring and liberation-conferring,
the <s>Bhagavān</s> alone is to be worshipped through the eternal Vedic <s>dharmas</s>. [<s>Śāṇḍilyasmṛti</s>]
He alone is to be worshipped in all ways; no other is the deliverer from <s>saṃsāra</s>.

children.text: ubhābhyāṃ jñānakarmabhyām ārādhyo bhagavān hariḥ //" iti [Śāṇḍilyasmṛti]
children.translated_text: Through both knowledge and action, the <s>Bhagavān Hari</s> is to be worshipped.' [<s>Śāṇḍilyasmṛti</s>]

children.text: śāntiparvaṇi: "svayambhūvihito*{600}* dharmo yo yasya hi*{601}* nareśvara / [MBh 14, App. 4.222]
children.translated_text: In the <s>Śāntiparvan</s>: 'The <s>dharma</s> ordained by the Self-born (<s>Svayambhū</s>) for each one, O lord of men, [<s>Mahābhārata</s> 14, App. 4.222]

children.text: sa tena kṣapayet pāpaṃ samyag ācaritena hi //" iti [MBh 14, App. 4.223]
children.translated_text: by that, properly practiced, one destroys sin.' [<s>Mahābhārata</s> 14, App. 4.223]

children.text: pādme: "dharmān nijāṃś ca śāstroktān varṇadharmān aśeṣataḥ /
children.translated_text: In the <s>Padma</s> [Purāṇa]: 'Those <s>vaiśyas</s> who observe their own <s>dharmas</s> declared in scripture, and the <s>dharmas</s> of the <s>varṇas</s> in their entirety,

children.text: pālayantīha ye vaiśyā na te yānti yamālayam //" iti [PadmaP ]
children.translated_text: do not go to the abode of <s>Yama</s> (Death) in this world.' [<s>PadmaPurāṇa</s>]
In another <s>smṛti</s>: 'One who always performs the action ordained by <s>Śruti</s>, <s>Smṛti</s>, and right conduct,
one who seeks the highest good should diligently resort to one's own respective <s>dharma</s>.'

children.text: "nānyaḥ panthā vidyate 'yanāye" 'ti "brāhmaṇā vividaśanti yajñena dānena tapasānāśakena" iti ca śrutir imam arthaṃ draḍhayanti.
children.translated_text: The <s>Śruti</s> passages 'There is no other path for going' and '<s>Brāhmaṇas</s> seek to know through sacrifice, gifts, austerity, and fasting' confirm this very meaning.

children.text: ataḥ advārakabhagavadyajanādhikāribhiḥ śrīmadvaikhānasasūtribhis sāmyaṃ keṣāñcid api nopapadyate iti kṛtaṃ pallavitena. etāvatā "akhilajagatkāraṇabhūtena vikhanasā praṇītatvāt" iti prathamo hetuḥ nirūpitaḥ.
children.translated_text: Therefore, the equality of anyone with the blessed <s>Vaikhānasa sūtra</s>-followers, who have the non-intermediary qualification for the worship of the <s>Bhagavān</s>, is not established — enough of this elaboration. With this, the first reason — 'because [the <s>Sūtra</s>] was composed by <s>Vikhanasa</s>, who is the cause of the entire universe' — has been established.
Thus ends the establishment of the first reason.
Note: <s>Mahābhārata</s> reading: 'svayaṃbhuvihito.'
Now the establishment of the second reason.

children.text: athāsya vaikhānasasūtrasya sarvasūtrāṇām āditvaṃ nirūpyate. tathā hi:
children.translated_text: Now the priority of this <s>Vaikhānasa Sūtra</s> over all [other] <s>sūtras</s> is being established. For thus:
The priority of the <s>Vaikhānasa Sūtra</s> over all <s>sūtras</s>

children.text: brahmakaivarte: " yathā munīnāṃ vikhanā ādibhūta udāhṛtaḥ /
children.translated_text: In the <s>Brahmakaivartta</s> [Purāṇa]: 'Just as <s>Vikhanā</s> is declared to be the first-born among sages,

children.text: sūtrāṇāṃ tatpraṇītan tu tathā śreṣṭatamaṃ smṛtam //"*{602}* iti [BrahmakaivartaP ]
children.translated_text: so the [<s>Sūtra</s>] composed by him is remembered as the most excellent among <s>sūtras</s>.' [<s>BrahmakaivarttaPurāṇa</s>]

children.text: purātantre bhṛgu: "vedānāṃ vyāsanād arvāk prāgrūpaṃ militan tu yat /
children.translated_text: In the <s>Purātantra</s>, <s>Bhṛgu</s> [says]: 'Before the division of the <s>Vedas</s>, that which was combined in its original form —

children.text: tān tu vaikhānasīṃ śākhām iti vedavido viduḥ //"*{603}* ity ārabhya [Purātantra]
children.translated_text: that they, the knowers of the <s>Vedas</s>, know as the <s>Vaikhānasī</s> branch.' Beginning from this, [<s>Purātantra</s>]
'This <s>Vaiṣṇava Sūtra</s> is indeed the supreme accomplisher of all <s>siddhis</s> (attainments);

children.text: ādyatvāt sarvasūtrāṇāṃ vaiṣṇavatvāc ca tat tu vai // [Purātantra]
children.translated_text: because of its being the first among all <s>sūtras</s>, and because of its being <s>Vaiṣṇava</s>, [<s>Purātantra</s>]
it was followed by me, and likewise by <s>Kāśyapa</s>, <s>Atri</s>, and <s>Marīci</s>.' [<s>Purātantra</s>]
And in the <s>Skānda</s> [Purāṇa]: 'The Lotus-born, the supreme <s>Dhātā</s>, employed the great <s>Vaikhānasī</s> branch in his own <s>Sūtra</s>,
and therein the threefold worship;
he declared the conduct of the meanings of the <s>Nigamas</s> (Vedas) in separate divisions.' [<s>SkandaPurāṇa</s>]
The originally square shape of the solar disc becoming circular over time

children.text: sūtrārthaparyālocanayāpi sarvasūtrāditvam asyāvagamyate. yathā -"mukhyād indraś cāgniś ce" ti bhagavanmukhād agnisṛṣṭiḥ śrūyate. tathā:
children.translated_text: The priority of this [<s>Sūtra</s>] over all [other] <s>sūtras</s> is also understood through the examination of the meaning of the <s>Sūtra</s>. For instance — 'From the chief [mouth], <s>Indra</s> and <s>Agni</s>' — the creation of fire from the mouth of the <s>Bhagavān</s> is heard [in the <s>Veda</s>]. Likewise:
In the <s>Āśvamedhika</s> [Parvan] — the words of the <s>Bhagavān</s>:

children.text: "prathamaṃ manmukhāt sṛṣṭo lokārthe pacanaḥ prabhuḥ / [MBh 14, App. 4.2572]
children.translated_text: 'First, from my mouth was created the lord, the cooker [<s>Agni</s>], for the sake of the world. [<s>Mahābhārata</s> 14, App. 4.2572]

children.text: sṛṣṭamātro jagatsarvam attum aicchat purā khalu* //{607}* [MBh 14, App. 4.2573]
children.translated_text: As soon as he was created, he desired to devour the entire world in ancient times. [<s>Mahābhārata</s> 14, App. 4.2573]

children.text: tataḥ praśamitas so 'yam upāsīno mayā purā* /{608}* [MBh 14, App. 4.2574]
children.translated_text: Then this one was pacified, having been worshipped by me in former times. [<s>Mahābhārata</s> 14, App. 4.2574]

children.text: satatopāsanāt so 'yam aupāsana iti smṛtaḥ //" iti [MBh 14, App. 4.2575]
children.translated_text: Through constant worship (<s>upāsanā</s>), this one is known as <s>Aupāsana</s> (the one connected with worship).' [<s>Mahābhārata</s> 14, App. 4.2575]

children.text: evaṃ paramapuruṣamukhāj jātasyaupāsanāgneḥ kuṇḍavidhānādikam atraiva sūtre pratipāditam.
children.translated_text: Thus, the fire-pit ritual and other procedures for the <s>Aupāsana</s> fire — which was born from the mouth of the Supreme Person — are taught only in this <s>Sūtra</s>.

children.text: kiñ ca navagrahamakhe savitṛmaṇḍalasya caturaśratvam ucyate "caturaśraṃ vṛttam ityādinā (sūtre). ādau caturaśrasya sato ravimaṇḍalasya kālāntare vṛttatvakalpanaṃ pramāṇair avagamyate. yathā:
children.translated_text: Moreover, in the rite of the nine planets (<s>navagraha</s>), the square shape of the solar disc is stated [in the <s>Sūtra</s>] as 'square, round' etc. That the solar disc, which was originally square, became circular over time, is understood from authoritative sources. For instance:

children.text: !{602}! Dieser Vers ist auch zitiert als "Brahmakaivartapurāṇa" in DHN[D] 42.9-10.
! Dieser Vers ist als "Purātantra" ähnlich zitiert in DHN[D] 33.21-22.
! Diese drei Halbverse sind auch zitiert als "Purātantra" in DHN[D] 35.20-22.
! Dieser Vers ist ähnlich als "Purātantra" zitiert in 34.9-10.
! Diese drei Halbverse sind als "Skandapurāṇa" auch zitiert in DHN[D] 39.25-40.2.
! MBh: tataḥ praśamitaḥ so 'gnir upāsyaiva mayā purā.

children.translated_text: Note: This verse is also cited as '<s>BrahmakaivarttaPurāṇa</s>' in DHN[D] 42.9-10.

children.text: viṣṇupurāṇe: "tejasaś śamanañ cāsya viśvakarmā cakāra ha /
children.translated_text: In the <s>ViṣṇuPurāṇa</s>: '<s>Viśvakarman</s> indeed performed the diminishing of its (<s>Sūrya</s>'s) splendor,
having mounted the sun on a lathe, the diminishment of his splendor — [<s>ViṣṇuPurāṇa</s>]

children.text: kṛtavān aṣṭamaṃ bhāgaṃ sa vyaśātayad avyayam /
children.translated_text: He made the eighth portion and pared away that imperishable (radiance);
that <s>Vaiṣṇava</s> radiance which was pared from the sun by <s>Viśvakarman</s> — [<s>ViṣṇuP</s>]
blazing, it fell to the earth, O best of sages.
Thus, from the <s>Manvantara</s> (cosmic era) of <s>Sūryasāvarṇi</s> onward, there is the perception of the sun's disc as circular.

children.text: tad anusāreṇa bodhāyanādibhiḥ vṛttākāratvaṃ ravimamaṇḍalasyoktam. tataḥ pūrvaṃ caturaśratvam va. tad evāsmin sūtre pratipāditam.
children.translated_text: In accordance with this, <s>Bodhāyana</s> and others have stated the circular shape of the sun's disc. Before that it was square. That very point is established in this <s>Sūtra</s>.

children.text: evaṃ "vānaprastho vaikhānaśāstrasamudācāro vaikhānasa"*{609}* iti vaikhānasasūtram anusmṛtya tṛtīyāśramadharmān bodhāyanaḥ pratipādayati. [BaudhDhS 2.6.11.14]
children.translated_text: Thus, having recalled the <s>Vaikhānasa Sūtra</s> passage 'A <s>Vānaprastha</s> (forest-dweller) who follows the practice of the <s>Vaikhānasa</s> scripture is a <s>Vaikhānasa</s>,' <s>Bodhāyana</s> expounds the <s>dharma</s>s of the third <s>āśrama</s> (stage of life). [<s>BaudhDhS</s> 2.6.11.14]

children.text: tathā āgnivaiśyasūtre "athātas sūtragaṇanāṃ vyākhyāsyāmaḥ. bodhāyanam āpastambaṃ satyāṣāṭhaṃ drāhyāyaṇam āgastyaṃ śākalyam āśvalāyanaṃ śāmbhavīyaṃ kātyāyanam iti navāni pūrvasūtrāṇi. vaikhānasaṃ śaunakīyaṃ bhāradvājam āgnivaiśyaṃ jaiminīyaṃ *{610}* vādhūlaṃ mādhyandinaṃ hiraṇyakeśīyaṃ kauṣītakam iti navāny aparasūtrāṇi. evam aṣṭādaśasūtrāṇy aṣṭādaśasūtrakārāś ca. etāni caturvedamūlāni. pūrvasūtrāṇi śārīrāṇi sāmānyāni bhavanti. uttarasūtrāṇi vaikhānasādīni viṣṇusaṃbandhīni daivikānī" ti vaikhānasasūtrasyāditvaṃ vaiṣṇavatvañ cocyate.
children.translated_text: Likewise in the <s>Āgnivaiśya Sūtra</s>: 'Now we shall expound the enumeration of the <s>Sūtra</s>s. <s>Bodhāyana</s>, <s>Āpastamba</s>, <s>Satyāṣāḍha</s>, <s>Drāhyāyaṇa</s>, <s>Āgastya</s>, <s>Śākalya</s>, <s>Āśvalāyana</s>, <s>Śāmbhavīya</s>, <s>Kātyāyana</s> — these are the nine former <s>Sūtra</s>s. <s>Vaikhānasa</s>, <s>Śaunakīya</s>, <s>Bhāradvāja</s>, <s>Āgnivaiśya</s>, <s>Jaiminīya</s>, <s>Vādhūla</s>, <s>Mādhyandina</s>, <s>Hiraṇyakeśīya</s>, <s>Kauṣītaka</s> — these are the nine latter <s>Sūtra</s>s. Thus there are eighteen <s>Sūtra</s>s and eighteen <s>Sūtra</s>-makers. These are rooted in the four <s>Veda</s>s. The former <s>Sūtra</s>s deal with bodily (rites) and are general. The latter <s>Sūtra</s>s, beginning with <s>Vaikhānasa</s>, are related to <s>Viṣṇu</s> and are divine.' Thus the primacy and <s>Vaiṣṇava</s> character of the <s>Vaikhānasa Sūtra</s> are stated.

children.text: asya sūtrasyādhikyaṃ ca "ye vaikhānasasūtreṇa saṃskṛtās dvijātaya"*{611}* ityādinā pūrvam eva pratipāditam.
children.translated_text: The superiority of this <s>Sūtra</s> has already been established earlier by the passage beginning with 'Those twice-born who are consecrated by the <s>Vaikhānasa Sūtra</s>.'

children.text: ataḥ sarvasūtrāṇām ādir idaṃ sūtram iti siddham. tataḥ sarvasūtrottamatvañ cāsyopapadyate iti nirūpito dvitīyo hetuḥ.
children.translated_text: Therefore it is established that this <s>Sūtra</s> is the origin of all <s>Sūtra</s>s. From this, its supreme status among all <s>Sūtra</s>s is also justified. Thus the second proof is established.
Thus concludes the examination of the second proof.

children.text: ! Anm. des Herausgebers: atra vādhūlasthāne mādhuryam iti hiraṇyakeśīyasthāne kauṇḍinyam iti ca pāṭhāntaram upalabhyate.
! Dieser Halbvers ist als "Purātantra" zitiert in DHN[D] 36.10.

children.translated_text: [Footnote: <s>BaudhDhS</s> reads: a <s>Vānaprastha</s> who follows the practice of the <s>Vaikhānasa</s> scripture.]
Examination of the Third Proof
The <s>Vaikhānasa Sūtra</s>'s adherence to the path of <s>Śruti</s>

children.text: athāsya śrīvaikhānasasūtrasya sūtrāntarāpekṣayā vailakṣaṇyāpādakaṃ pratyakṣaśrutimūlakatvam astīti jñāpayituṃ "sarvakarmasu śrutimārgānusāritvād" iti tṛtīyo hetur nirūpyate. tathā hi:
children.translated_text: Now, in order to make known that this <s>Śrī Vaikhānasa Sūtra</s> possesses a distinguishing quality relative to other <s>Sūtra</s>s — namely, being directly rooted in <s>Śruti</s> (revealed scripture) — the third proof is examined: 'Because in all rites it follows the path of <s>Śruti</s>.' That is as follows:
The <s>Śrauta</s> character of the procedure for pure <s>ācamana</s> (sipping)

children.text: śuddhācamanavidhau "yattrir ācāmati tena ṛcaḥ prīṇāti" ityādi śrutyanusāreṇa sūtre "ṛgvedaḥ prīṇātv" ityādinā śuddhācamanam uktam. nanu bodhāyanenāpi śuddhācamanavidhir ukta iti cet satyam. "ācamanavidhiṃ vyākhyāsyāmaḥ" ity ārabhya "gokarṇabaddhahastena trir ācamet, prathamaṃ yat pibati tena ṛgvedaṃ prīṇāti yad dvitīyaṃ tena yajurvedaṃ yat tṛtīyaṃ tena sāmavedaṃ prīṇātī"ty ācamanena ṛgvedādīnāṃ prītir bhavatīty uktam. na tu mantraḥ.
children.translated_text: In the procedure for pure <s>ācamana</s> (ritual sipping), following the <s>Śruti</s> passage 'By sipping three times, he pleases the <s>Ṛc</s>s (verses),' etc., the <s>Sūtra</s> prescribes pure <s>ācamana</s> with the formula 'May the <s>Ṛgveda</s> be pleased,' etc. Now, if one objects that <s>Bodhāyana</s> too has prescribed a procedure for pure <s>ācamana</s>, that is true: Beginning with 'We shall expound the procedure for <s>ācamana</s>,' it is stated: 'He should sip three times with a hand cupped like a cow's ear. By the first sip he pleases the <s>Ṛgveda</s>; by the second, the <s>Yajurveda</s>; by the third, he pleases the <s>Sāmaveda</s>.' Thus it is said that the <s>Ṛgveda</s> and others are pleased by <s>ācamana</s>. But the <s>mantra</s> (is not given).

children.text: śrutismṛtisūtravihitasya sandhyopāsanasya pradhānabhūtam arghyapradānādikam atraiva pratipāditam. "prātas sūryaś cetyādinācamya āpo hiṣṭhādibhis tisṛbhiḥ prokṣya
children.translated_text: The principal elements — the offering of <s>arghya</s> (water offering) and the like — of the <s>sandhyā</s>-worship (twilight devotion) prescribed by <s>Śruti</s>, <s>Smṛti</s>, and <s>Sūtra</s> are set forth in this very (text). 'In the morning, sipping water with (the formula) "The sun" etc., sprinkling with the three (verses) beginning with "<s>Āpo hiṣṭhā</s>,"

children.text: gāyatryā 'po 'bhimantrya ādityābhimukhaṃ vikṣipya pradakṣiṇaṃ karoti" ityādi.
children.translated_text: consecrating the waters with the <s>Gāyatrī</s>, casting (them) facing the sun, he performs the circumambulation,' etc.

children.text: bodhāyanenāpi sandhyāvandanavidhir uktaḥ iti cet naivam. "athātas sandhyopāsanavidhiṃ vyākhyāsyāmaḥ. tīraṃ gatvāprayato 'bhiṣiktaḥ prayato vā nābhiṣiktaḥ*{612}* prakṣālipādapāṇir*{613}* apa ācamya surabhimatyā abliṅgābhir vāruṇībhiḥ hiraṇyavarṇābhiḥ pāvamānībhiḥ vyāhṛtibhir anyaiś ca pavitrair ātmānaṃ prokṣya prayato bhavati. athāpy udāharanti." [BaudhDhS 2.4.7.1-3]
children.translated_text: If one objects that <s>Bodhāyana</s> too has prescribed a procedure for <s>sandhyā</s>-worship — this is not so. 'Now we shall expound the procedure for <s>sandhyā</s>-worship. Having gone to the bank, whether unpurified and bathed, or purified and unbathed, having washed his feet and hands, having sipped water, he becomes purified by sprinkling himself with the <s>Surabhimatī</s> (verses), the <s>Abliṅga</s> (verses), the <s>Vāruṇī</s> (verses), the <s>Hiraṇyavarṇā</s> (verses), the <s>Pāvamānī</s> (verses), the <s>Vyāhṛti</s>s, and other purifying (formulae). They also cite:' [<s>BaudhDhS</s> 2.4.7.1-3]
'Bathing by immersion in water is prescribed for all classes;
sprinkling with <s>mantra</s>s is additionally prescribed for the twice-born.' [<s>BaudhDhS</s> 2.4.7.3-2]

children.text: sarvakarmaṇāñ caivārambheṣu prāksandhyopāsanākālāc caitenaiva pavitrasamūhenātmānaṃ prokṣya prayato bhavati. athāpy udāharanti. "darbheṣv āsīno darbhān dhārayamāṇaḥ sodakapāṇinā*{615}* pratyaṅmukhaḥ sāvitrīṃ sahasrakṛtvaḥ āvartayet. prāṇāyāmaśo vā śatakṛtvaḥ. tribhiś ca prāṇāyāmaiḥ tato (tānto) brahmahṛdayena. vāruṇībhyāṃ rātrim upatiṣṭhate." ityādinā mārjanādikam uktam. pradhānabhūtam arghyapradānādikam anuktam. [BaudhDhS 2.4.7.4-9]
children.translated_text: 'At the commencement of all rites, before the time of <s>sandhyā</s>-worship, he becomes purified by sprinkling himself with this very group of purifying (formulae). They also cite: "Seated on <s>darbha</s> grass, holding <s>darbha</s> grass, with water in hand, facing west, he should repeat the <s>Sāvitrī</s> a thousand times. Or with <s>prāṇāyāma</s> (breath-control), a hundred times. And with three <s>prāṇāyāma</s>s, then (to the end) with the <s>Brahma-Hṛdaya</s> (Heart of <s>Brahmā</s>). With the <s>Vāruṇī</s> (verses) he worships the night."' Thus the <s>mārjana</s> (sprinkling) and similar (rites) are stated. But the principal element — the offering of <s>arghya</s> and the like — is not stated. [<s>BaudhDhS</s> 2.4.7.4-9]
[Footnote: <s>BaudhDhS</s> reads: <s>vānabhiṣiktaḥ</s>.]
The manner of <s>Brahmayajña</s> (Vedic recitation sacrifice) as stated in <s>Śruti</s>
The choice of <s>Soma</s> preceded by the choice of <s>Brahmā</s>

children.text: brahmayajñaḥ. talavakāropaniṣadi "tasyā vā eṣa prathamaḥ pādaḥ oṃ bhūs tatsavitur vareṇyaṃ oṃ bhuvaḥ bhargo devasya dhīmahi oṃ suvaḥ dhiyo yo naḥ pracodayāt iti pacchaḥ, oṃ bhūr bhuvas tatsavitur vareṇyaṃ bhargo devasya dhīmahi oṃ suvaḥ dhiyo yo naḥ pracodayāt ity ardhacaśaḥ, oṃ bhūrbhuvassuvas tatsavitur vareṇyaṃ bhargo devasya dhīmahi dhiyo yo naḥ pracodayāt iti samastāñ ca sāvitrīṃ japtveti yathodiṣṭaḥ, tathātra sūtre 'pi ukto 'sti.
children.translated_text: The <s>Brahmayajña</s> (worship through Vedic recitation). In the <s>Talavakāra Upaniṣad</s>: 'Of this (Gāyatrī), the first quarter is: <s>Oṃ Bhūḥ tatsavitur vareṇyaṃ</s>, <s>Oṃ Bhuvaḥ bhargo devasya dhīmahi</s>, <s>Oṃ Suvaḥ dhiyo yo naḥ pracodayāt</s> — thus quarter by quarter. <s>Oṃ Bhūr Bhuvas tatsavitur vareṇyaṃ bhargo devasya dhīmahi</s>, <s>Oṃ Suvaḥ dhiyo yo naḥ pracodayāt</s> — thus by halves. <s>Oṃ Bhūr Bhuvas Suvas tatsavitur vareṇyaṃ bhargo devasya dhīmahi dhiyo yo naḥ pracodayāt</s> — thus having recited the <s>Sāvitrī</s> in its complete form, as prescribed.' In this <s>Sūtra</s> too, it has been stated in the same manner.

children.text: āghārādiṣu sarvam api śrautavat. atra brahmavaraṇānantaraṃ somavaraṇam apy uktam asti. "somo 'smākaṃ brāhmaṇānāṃ rājā - somarājāno brāhmaṇā" iti.
children.translated_text: In the <s>Āghāra</s> (preliminary oblation) and other (rites), everything is as in the <s>Śrauta</s> (procedure). Here, after the invocation of <s>Brahmā</s>, an invocation of <s>Soma</s> is also stated. '<s>Soma</s> is the king of us <s>Brāhmaṇa</s>s — the <s>Brāhmaṇa</s>s are <s>Soma</s>-kings.'

children.text: "viṣṇuś ca vai somaś ca brahmav ādyam avadetāṃ 'ahaṃ brāhmaṇānāṃ pratiṣṭhe'ti viṣṇur abravīt 'ahaṃ pratiṣṭhe'ti somaḥ. tau prajāpatiṃ praśnam aitāṃ so 'bravīt prajāpatiḥ
children.translated_text: '<s>Viṣṇu</s> and <s>Soma</s> indeed were competing at the beginning about <s>Brahman</s>. "I am the foundation of the <s>Brāhmaṇa</s>s," said <s>Viṣṇu</s>. "I am the foundation," said <s>Soma</s>. They went to <s>Prajāpati</s> with their question. <s>Prajāpati</s> said:,

children.text: 'chandāṃsi viṣṇum adhigacchanti, nakṣatrāṇi somaṃ. tāv ubhau brahmaṇyāv'; iti so 'bravīt.
children.translated_text: "The sacred meters reach <s>Viṣṇu</s>; the constellations reach <s>Soma</s>. Both of you are devoted to <s>Brahman</s>." Thus he said.

children.text: pūjitau pūjayantau stutau stunvantau priyau priyavantau brahmaṇyau brahmavittau brāhmaṇānāṃ pratiṣṭhātārau bhavata iti yan māṃ brahmaṇā vakṣyanti yajñeṣu so 'ham iti viṣṇur abravīt. tasmād viṣṇur yajño brāhmaṇānāṃ pratiṣṭhā iti. vijñayate ca.
children.translated_text: 'Honored, you shall honor; praised, you shall praise; beloved, you shall love; devoted to <s>Brahman</s>, knowers of <s>Brahman</s>, be the foundation of the <s>Brāhmaṇa</s>s.' '<s>Viṣṇu</s> said: "That which <s>Brāhmaṇa</s>s will declare of me in the sacrifices — that is I." Therefore <s>Viṣṇu</s> is the sacrifice, the foundation of the <s>Brāhmaṇa</s>s.' Thus it is known.

children.text: "brāhmaṇo vai chandāṃsī"ty etasmāt brāhmaṇāt yan māṃ brāhmaṇā vakṣyanti nakṣatreṣu tatrāham iti so 'bravīt. tasmāt brāhmaṇānāṃ somo rājeti tasmād vijñāyate ca brāhmaṇe vā aṣṭāviṃśo nakṣatrāṇāṃ tasya vacaḥ puṇyam iti tāv ubhau brahmaṇyau brahmavittau brāhmaṇānāṃ pratiṣṭhātārau brāhmaṇeṣu pratiṣṭhitau ya evaṃ brāhmaṇapuraskṛtāni karmāṇi karoti yajñasya samṛddhyā" iti ca śrutiprasiddhatvāt.
children.translated_text: '"A <s>Brāhmaṇa</s> is indeed the sacred meters" — from this <s>Brāhmaṇa</s> (passage): "That which <s>Brāhmaṇa</s>s will declare of me among the constellations — there am I," he said. Therefore <s>Soma</s> is the king of the <s>Brāhmaṇa</s>s. Therefore it is known that the twenty-eighth of the constellations belongs to the <s>Brāhmaṇa</s>; his word is auspicious. Both of them are devoted to <s>Brahman</s>, knowers of <s>Brahman</s>, the foundation of the <s>Brāhmaṇa</s>s, established among the <s>Brāhmaṇa</s>s. He who thus performs rites preceded by the <s>Brāhmaṇa</s> — for the prosperity of the sacrifice.' Thus from the well-known <s>Śruti</s>.

children.text: evam atra śāntikapauṣṭikādiṣu pradhānakarmatvāt navagrahamakhasya pañcāgnikuṇḍavidhānam uktam. "atha grahaśāntiṃ vyākhyāsyāmaḥ. grahyāyattā lokayātrā tasmād ātmaviruddhe prāpte grahān samyak pūjayatī" ti.
children.translated_text: Thus here, since the <s>Navagraha</s>-sacrifice (nine-planet sacrifice) is the principal rite in <s>śāntika</s> (pacificatory) and <s>pauṣṭika</s> (prosperity-bringing) and other (rites), the procedure for the five fire-pits is stated. 'Now we shall expound the planetary pacification. The course of the world depends on the planets; therefore, when an adverse (planetary influence) occurs, one properly worships the planets.'
The primacy of planetary pacification

children.text: grahaśānteḥ kathaṃ prādhānyam iti ced ucyate. "udyantam astaṃyantam ādityam abhidhyāyan kurvan brāhmaṇo vidvān sakalaṃ bhadram aśnute 'sāv ādityo brahmeti brahmaiva san brahmāpy eti ya evaṃ veda" iti "ya eṣo 'ntarāditye hiraṇmayaḥ puruṣo dṛśyate" iti "yo 'sau tapann udeti" ityādi "viṣṇuśakter avasthānaṃ sadāditye karoti ca" iti "dhyeyas sadā savitṛmaṇḍalamadhyavartī" tyādibhiś ca vacanaiḥ yat pratipāditaṃ savitṛmaṇḍalamadhyavartino bhagavato nārāyaṇasya yajanaṃ tad evedam ity abhiprāyeṇa sūtrakārair asya grahayajñasya prādhānyam uktam. tathānte "anyathā mahattaro doṣo bhavatī"ty apy uktam.
children.translated_text: If one asks how the planetary pacification has primacy, it is answered: 'The <s>Brāhmaṇa</s>, the wise one, who meditates on the rising and setting sun, attains complete auspiciousness. That sun is <s>Brahman</s>; being <s>Brahman</s> itself, he goes to <s>Brahman</s> — he who knows thus.' 'He who is golden within the sun, who is seen' — 'He who rises blazing' — etc., and '<s>Viṣṇu</s>'s power establishes itself always in the sun' — and 'One should always meditate upon Him who abides in the center of the solar orb' — by such statements, the worship of the <s>Bhagavān</s> <s>Nārāyaṇa</s> who abides in the center of the solar orb is what is taught. With this intention, the <s>Sūtra</s>-makers have declared the primacy of this planetary sacrifice. Accordingly, at the end it is also stated: 'Otherwise a greater fault results.'
And <s>Bodhāyana</s> (says): 'Now we shall expound the hospitality-offerings and oblations for the planets.'
The <s>Savitṛ</s>-oblation
'The one who lacks faith, who is impure, who does not perform <s>japa</s> (recitation), who has abandoned auspicious observances —
the planets very clearly lead such a person to the abode of <s>Yama</s> (death).
Of the planets whose movements are fierce, who course on the path of constellations,
I shall declare the offerings for the purpose of pacification, according to the proper procedure.'
The <s>Śrauta</s> character of the worship of <s>Viṣṇu</s>

children.text: māsi māsy ṛtāv ṛtau candragrahe sūryagrahe viṣuve 'yane śubhāśubhe janmanakṣatre tadgrahāṇām ātithyaṃ saṃvatsarād api prayuñjānaḥ sarvān kāmān avāpnoti" iti grahaśāntikālaṃ nirūpya.
children.translated_text: 'Month by month, season by season, at a lunar eclipse, at a solar eclipse, at the equinox, at the solstice, on auspicious and inauspicious (occasions), at one's birth-constellation — performing hospitality to those planets, even for a year, one obtains all desires.' Thus, having determined the time for planetary pacification,

children.text: "grahā gāvo narendrāś ca brāhmaṇāś ca viśeṣataḥ /
children.translated_text: 'Planets, cows, kings, and especially <s>Brāhmaṇa</s>s —
when honored, they honor in return; when disrespected, they burn (the offender).'
Thus he has also shown the adverse consequence of non-performance.

children.text: tasmād eva sūtrakāraiḥ sūryacandrau vinā lokapravṛtty asambhavāt sūryapradhānatvāc ca grahāṇāṃ sarvakarmaṇām ādau grahapuraskāram uktvā tatra pañcāgnikuṇḍavidhānam upadiśya pradhāne sabhye viṣṇurūpasya savituḥ homaḥ "sabhye savitur" iti pratipāditaḥ.
children.translated_text: Therefore, since the course of the world is impossible without the sun and moon, and since the sun is foremost among the planets, the <s>Sūtra</s>-makers, having stated the worship of the planets at the beginning of all rites, and having taught therein the procedure for the five fire-pits, have established that the oblation in the main (<s>sabhya</s>) fire is for <s>Savitṛ</s> (the Sun) in his aspect as <s>Viṣṇu</s>, as declared: 'In the <s>sabhya</s> (fire), (the oblation is) for <s>Savitṛ</s>.'

children.text: evam - "nārāyaṇa paraṃ brahma" - "brahmaiva bhūtānāṃ jyeṣṭhāṃ tena ko 'rhati spardhitum" - "agnir vai devānām avamo viṣṇuḥ paramaḥ tadantareṇa sarvā anyā devatāḥ"
children.translated_text: Thus: '<s>Nārāyaṇa</s> is the Supreme <s>Brahman</s>' — '<s>Brahman</s> indeed is the eldest of beings; who is worthy of competing with him?' — '<s>Agni</s> indeed is the lowest of the gods, <s>Viṣṇu</s> the highest; between them are all the other deities.'
The superior authority that comes from being rooted in <s>Śruti</s>

children.text: ityādi śrutyanusāreṇa "tasmād gṛhe paramaṃ viṣṇuṃ pratiṣṭhāpya sāyaṃprātarhomānte 'rcayati"
children.translated_text: Following such <s>Śruti</s> passages, (the <s>Sūtra</s> declares:) 'Therefore, having installed the Supreme <s>Viṣṇu</s> in the home, one worships (Him) at the end of the morning and evening <s>homa</s> (oblation).'

children.text: iti nārāyaṇaparatvena sūtrāntareṣv anuktam ārādhanavidhim uktvā tatra "sa vā eṣa puruṣaḥ pañcadhā pañcātmā" ityādi śrutyanusāreṇa pañcamūrtividhānam apy uktam.
