and other scriptures that are contradictory [to the <s>Veda</s>], O great sage. [<s>Liṅga Purāṇa</s>]
Some are sellers of <s>tīrthas</s> (sacred sites); others are sellers of deities;
some are sellers of milk; others are sellers of ghee. [<s>Liṅga Purāṇa</s>]
Some are sellers of meat; others are sellers of liquor;
some are sellers of sons; others are sellers of wives. [<s>Liṅga Purāṇa</s>]

children.text: bhartṛvikrayiṇaḥ kecid bhaviṣyanti kalau narāḥ //" iti [LiṅgaP]
children.translated_text: Some will be sellers of husbands — [such will be] people in the <s>Kali</s> [age]." Thus. [<s>Liṅga Purāṇa</s>]

children.text: ataḥ pāñcarātoktaṃ taptacakradhāraṇaṃ*{842}* sarvasādhāraṇaṃ na bhavantīti siddham.*{843}*
children.translated_text: Therefore, it is established that the bearing of the heated discus (<s>taptacakradhāraṇa</s>) as prescribed by the <s>Pāñcarātra</s> *{842}* is not universally applicable. *{843}*

children.text: atha yad uktaṃ sarvasādhāraṇaṃ na bhavatīti tan nopapadyate - ātharvaṇe "cakraṃ bibharti vapuṣābhitaptaṃ balaṃ devānāmamitasya viṣṇoḥ. sa eti nākaṃ duritā vidhūya prayānti yadyatayo vītarāgāḥ, "caraṇaṃ pavitraṃ vitataṃ purāṇaṃ"*{844}* ityādi śrutibhiḥ sarvasādhāraṇatvena śrūyamāṇatvāt iti cet - na.
children.translated_text: Now, if it is said that the statement 'it is not universally applicable' is untenable — [because] in the <s>Ātharvaṇa</s> [<s>Veda</s>]: 'He who bears the heated discus on his body, the power of the gods, of the immeasurable <s>Viṣṇu</s> — he goes to heaven, having shaken off sins; [that abode] which ascetics free from passion approach,' and 'the foot-mark, sacred, spread wide, ancient,' *{844}* and so forth — since it is heard through such <s>Śruti</s> passages as being universally applicable — if so objected, [we say:] no.

children.text: taptacakradhāraṇe prāyaścittavidhānāt. ataḥ yathoktamārgeṇa bhāvanārūpeṇaiva cakrāṅkanaṃ na tu taptarūpeṇa. sarvasādhāraṇaśrutis tu vaikhānasetaraviṣayā*{845}*. "yasya me śriyam" ityādi śrutyavirodhena arthavyavasthāyāḥ kāryatvāt. ataḥ taptacakrāṅkanaṃ sarvasādhāraṇaṃ na bhavati.
children.translated_text: [This is so] because <s>prāyaścitta</s> (expiation) is prescribed for [unauthorized] bearing of the heated discus. Therefore, the branding with the discus (<s>cakrāṅkana</s>) is to be done through meditation (<s>bhāvanā</s>) alone, in the prescribed manner, and not in the heated [physical] form. The <s>Śruti</s> passage about universal applicability pertains to [traditions] other than the <s>Vaikhānasa</s>. *{845}* Since the determination of meaning must be made in a way that does not contradict <s>Śruti</s> passages such as 'whose [mark grants] prosperity to me' and so forth, therefore the heated discus branding is not universally applicable.

children.text: kiñ ca: "yatra śāstragatir bhinnā sarvakarmasu bhārata /
children.translated_text: Moreover: "Where the course of scripture is divided regarding all rituals, O <s>Bhārata</s>,
whether [the fire] has risen or not yet risen, as differences in the <s>homa</s> (oblation) may occur —
that [<s>Śruti</s> injunction] is weightier, O mighty-armed one, than even what is stated in all [other] scriptures."
Thus, by the statement of <s>Sumantu</s>, a settled alternative must be stated here.
!{840}! DHN[T] 624: <s>brahmān</s>.
<s>Viṣṇu</s> alone is the agent of cosmic dissolution

children.text: kiñca brahmarudrādīnām api saṃhārakartā harir eveti śrūyate. yajuṣi - hariṃ harantam anuyanti devāḥ viśvasyeśānaṃ*{846}* vṛṣabhaṃ matīnām" iti.ab hier Telugu überprüfen
children.translated_text: Moreover, it is heard [in <s>Śruti</s>] that <s>Hari</s> alone is the agent of dissolution even for <s>Brahmā</s>, <s>Rudra</s>, and the others. In the <s>Yajus</s> [<s>Veda</s>]: '<s>Hari</s>, the one who takes away — the gods follow him, the lord of the universe, the bull among intellects.' Thus.
The reason for <s>Viṣṇu</s>'s worship of <s>Rudra</s>

children.text: brahmapurāṇe: "brahmāṇam indraṃ rudrañ ca yamaṃ varuṇam eva ca /
children.translated_text: In the <s>Brahma Purāṇa</s>: "<s>Brahmā</s>, <s>Indra</s>, <s>Rudra</s>, <s>Yama</s>, and <s>Varuṇa</s> —
since He seizes and takes them away, therefore He is called <s>Hari</s> here. [<s>Brahma Purāṇa</s>]

children.text: brahmā śambhus tathaivārkaś candramāś ca śatakratuḥ /
children.translated_text: <s>Brahmā</s>, <s>Śambhu</s>, likewise <s>Arka</s> (the Sun), <s>Candramā</s> (the Moon), and <s>Śatakratu</s> (<s>Indra</s>),
these and other foremost [gods] are likewise endowed with the <s>tejas</s> (divine energy) of <s>Viṣṇu</s>. [<s>Brahma Purāṇa</s>]
At the conclusion of the cosmic activity, they are separated from [that] <s>tejas</s>,

children.text: tejasaś caiva te sarve pañcatvam upayānti ca//" iti [BrahmaP ]
children.translated_text: and all of them, [deprived] of [that] <s>tejas</s>, undergo dissolution into the five elements." Thus. [<s>Brahma Purāṇa</s>]

children.text: nanu - "hariṃ harantaṃ" iti pūrvopāttayajuṣi īśānaśabdaśravaṇāt rudra eva saṃhārakarteti śrūyate iti cet - tad asat. tatra "viśvasyeśāna," iti jaganniyāmakatvam ucyate. bis hier telugu noch überprüfentathā ca "patiṃ viśrasyātmeśvara," itivat nārāyaṇa eva atra pratipādyaḥ. "asyeśānā jagato viṣṇupatnī" sa hariḥ suvittamaḥ, "perur indrāya pinvata" "virāḍ asi", "bṛhatī śravasīndrapatnī dharmapatnī", "sa brahmā sa śivas sendraḥ", ityādi śrutayotra vibhāvanīyāḥ.
children.translated_text: Now, if it is objected that in the previously cited <s>Yajus</s> passage '<s>Hari</s>, the one who takes away,' the word <s>Īśāna</s> is heard, and therefore it is <s>Rudra</s> alone who is the agent of dissolution — that is wrong. There, in '<s>viśvasyeśāna</s>' (lord of the universe), the lordship over the world is being stated. And thus, just as in '<s>patiṃ viśvasyātmeśvara</s>' (lord of the universe, ruler of the Self), <s>Nārāyaṇa</s> alone is the one being taught here. The <s>Śruti</s> passages '<s>asyeśānā jagato viṣṇupatnī</s>' (the mistress of this world is the consort of <s>Viṣṇu</s>), 'He, <s>Hari</s>, is the most wealthy,' '<s>perur indrāya pinvata</s>,' '<s>virāḍ asi</s>' (you are the cosmic form), '<s>bṛhatī śravasī indrapatnī dharmapatnī</s>,' '<s>sa brahmā sa śivas sendraḥ</s>' (He is <s>Brahmā</s>, He is <s>Śiva</s>, He is <s>Indra</s>) — these and other <s>Śruti</s> passages should be contemplated here.
Now, in the <s>Kaurma</s> [<s>Purāṇa</s>], in the eighth chapter, in the summary of the <s>Rāmāyaṇa</s>:
"Having made a bridge across the great ocean to the gate of <s>Laṅkā</s> with hundreds of monkeys, *{847}* [<s>Kūrma Purāṇa</s> 21.44cd]
that supremely righteous lord slew <s>Rāvaṇa</s>." [<s>Kūrma Purāṇa</s> 21.45ab]
After establishing the killing of <s>Rāvaṇa</s> and other [events]:
"In the middle of the bridge, [He established] <s>Mahādeva</s>, <s>Īśāna</s>, clad in animal skin, [<s>Kūrma Purāṇa</s> 21.46cd]
<s>Rāghava</s> installed [Him] in the form of a <s>liṅga</s> and worshipped [Him];

children.text: tasya devo mahādevaḥ pārvatyā saha śaṅkaraḥ // [KūrmaP 21.47]
children.translated_text: to Him, the god <s>Mahādeva</s>, <s>Śaṅkara</s>, together with <s>Pārvatī</s>, [<s>Kūrma Purāṇa</s> 21.47]

children.text: pratyakṣam eva bhagavān dattavān varam uttamam /" [KūrmaP 21.48ab]
children.translated_text: the <s>Bhagavān</s> appeared in person and granted the supreme boon." [<s>Kūrma Purāṇa</s> 21.48ab]
!{846}! DHN[T] 702: <s>viśvasyeśāniṃ</s>.
<s>Rudra</s>'s capacity to grant boons is obtained through <s>Viṣṇu</s>'s grace

children.text: iti bhagavate rudropāsanam ucyate iti cet - satyam. rudrasya tad api bhagavadvaraprasādalabdham. evaṃ hi vārāhe prāgitihāse rudragītāsu ucyate, yathā -
children.translated_text: If it is said that worship of <s>Rudra</s> by the <s>Bhagavān</s> [<s>Rāma</s>] is spoken of [in the above passage] — true. But <s>Rudra</s>'s [capacity for] that too was obtained through the grace of the <s>Bhagavān</s> (<s>Viṣṇu</s>)'s boon. For thus it is stated in the <s>Vārāha</s> [<s>Purāṇa</s>], in the <s>Prāgitihāsa</s> (ancient history), in the <s>Rudragītās</s> (Songs of <s>Rudra</s>), as follows —
<s>Rudra</s> [speaks] to <s>Agastya</s>:

children.text: "brahmaṇāhaṃ purā sṛṣṭaḥ proktaḥ sṛja iti prajāḥ /
children.translated_text: "I was formerly created by <s>Brahmā</s> [and] told: 'Create beings!'
Not knowing my own capability, I sank into the waters, O twice-born one —" beginning thus. [<s>Vārāha Purāṇa</s>]
In the midst of the water, a certain person resembling a dark cloud, exceedingly beautiful, lotus-eyed, was seen by <s>Rudra</s>. When asked by <s>Rudra</s> 'Who are you?', his reply [was]

children.text: jalamadhye kālamedhasaṅkāśaḥ atiśobhanaḥ puṇḍarīkākṣaḥ kaścit puruṣo rudreṇa dṛṣṭaḥ kastvam iti rudreṇa pṛṣṭasya tasya prativacanam:

children.translated_text: 'I am <s>Nārāyaṇa</s>, the eternal god who reclines on the waters.
Let divine sight be yours — with that, behold me with effort.' Having thus instructed, [<s>VarāhaP</s>]

children.text: divyaṃ cakṣur bhavatu te tena māṃ paśya yatnataḥ //" iti pratipādya [VarāhaP]

children.translated_text: 'Thus addressed by him, when I look at his body,

children.text: "evam uktas tadā tena yāvat paśyāmm*{848}* ahaṃ tanum /

children.translated_text: I see [him as]
but the size of a thumb, blazing with the radiance of the sun. [<s>VarāhaP</s>]
Him alone I behold, and in his navel a lotus,

children.text: tam evāhaṃ prapaśyāmi tasya nābhau tu paṅkajam /

children.translated_text: and I see <s>Brahmā</s> there, and myself on his lap. [<s>VarāhaP</s>]

children.text: brahmāṇaṃ tatra paśyāmi hy ātmānañ ca tadaṅkataḥ // [VarāhaP]

children.translated_text: Having thus seen the great soul, I became filled with joy,

children.text: evaṃ dṛṣṭvā mahātmānaṃ tato harṣam upāgataḥ /

children.translated_text: and the desire to praise him arose in me, O tiger among twice-born.' [<s>VarāhaP</s>]

children.text: taṃ stotuṃ dvijaśārdūla matir me samajāyata //" [VarāhaP]

children.translated_text: Beginning thus, having uttered a great hymn of praise, at the end <s>Rudra</s>'s request of his desired boon before the <s>Bhagavān</s> is presented. Thus:

children.text: ity upakramya mahatstotram uktvā ante rudreṇa bhagavantaṃ pratyabhīṣṭanivedanaṃ pratipāditam. yathā:

children.translated_text: 'Thus praised, O <s>Bhagavān</s> <s>Anāda</s>, be pleased especially with your devotee,

children.text: "iti stuto me bhagavannanāde juṣasva bhaktasya viśeṣataś ca /

children.translated_text: and to one commanded to 'Create creation,' give omniscience — salutation to you, O <s>Viṣṇu</s>!' [<s>VarāhaP</s>]

children.text: sṛṣṭiṃ sṛjasveti tu coditasya sarvajñatāṃ dehi namo 'stu viṣṇo //" iti [VarāhaP]

children.translated_text: When the hymn was thus concluded,
'Choose a boon, O best of boon-seekers; may there be good fortune for you, O god of gods, O lord of <s>Umā</s>.' [<s>VarāhaP</s>]
Thus appointed by the <s>Bhagavān</s>, <s>Rudra</s> [said]
'And I was told by <s>Brahmā</s>, 'Create beings,' O Lord;

children.text: "brahmaṇā cāham uktas tu prajās sṛja iti prabho /

children.translated_text: therefore grant me threefold knowledge, O source of all beings.' Thus he prayed. [<s>VarāhaP</s>]

children.text: tatra jñānaṃ prayacchasva trividhaṃ bhūtabhāvana //" iti prārthayāmāsa. [VarāhaP]

children.translated_text: <s>Viṣṇu</s>'s destruction of <s>Rudra</s> and others in the <s>Śarabha</s> form
Then the <s>Śrī Bhagavān</s> [said]
'You are omniscient, no doubt — an eternal aggregate of knowledge.
Always worshipped by the gods, you shall forever be.' [<s>VarāhaP</s>.]

children.text: devānāñ ca sadā pūjyaḥ sarvadā tvaṃ bhaviṣyasi // [VarāhaP.]

children.translated_text: 'Thus addressed, the lord of <s>Umā</s> spoke again joyfully:
'Give me another boon, O god, one renowned among all beings. [<s>VarāhaP</s>]

children.text: anyaṃ dehi varaṃ deva prasiddhaṃ sarvajantuṣu // [VarāhaP]

children.translated_text: Having become mortal, do You Yourself worship me, O <s>Keśava</s>,

children.text: martyo bhūtvā bhavān eva māmārādhaya keśava /

children.translated_text: and carry me, O Lord of gods, and receive a boon from me, [<s>VarāhaP</s>.]

children.text: māṃ vahasya ca deveśa varaṃ matto gṛhāṇa ca // [VarāhaP.]

children.translated_text: by which I shall become more worshipped than even the most worshipped among all gods.' Thus he prayed again. [<s>VarāhaP</s>]

children.text: yenāhaṃ sarvadevānāṃ pūjyāt pūjyataro 'bhavat //" iti punaḥ tena prārthitaḥ [VarāhaP]

children.translated_text: The <s>Śrī Bhagavān</s> [replied]
: 'In the incarnations undertaken for the gods' purpose, having assumed human form,
I shall worship you indeed, and you shall be a boon-giver to me. [<s>VarāhaP</s>]

children.text: tvām evārādhayiṣyāmi tvañ ca me varado bhava // [VarāhaP]

children.translated_text: As for what you have said — 'carry me' — O god of gods, O lord of <s>Umā</s>,
I shall carry you, O god — having become a cloud, for a hundred years.' Thus he also gave a boon.

children.text: sa tvāṃ vahāmi deva tvāṃ megho bhūtvā śataṃ samāḥ //" iti varam api dadau.

children.translated_text: 'Thus <s>Hari</s>, the god, the lord of all, the creator of all,
became a boon-giver to me formerly; therefore I am chosen by the gods. [<s>VarāhaP</s>.]

children.text: varado 'bhūt purā mahyaṃ tenāhaṃ daivatair vṛtaḥ // [VarāhaP.]

children.translated_text: There is no god greater than <s>Nārāyaṇa</s> — neither has there been nor will there be.

children.text: nārāyaṇāt paro devo na bhūto na bhaviṣyati /

children.translated_text: This is the secret of the gods and of the <s>Purāṇa</s>s, O best one.' [<s>VarāhaP</s>]

children.text: etad rahasyaṃ devānāṃ purāṇānāñ ca sattama //" iti [VarāhaP]

children.translated_text: Furthermore,
In the <s>Śrīviṣṇupurāṇa</s>: 'Among gods, animals, and humans, the assumption of bodies
is Your sport, O [soul]
of all beings, characterized by activity. [<s>ViṣṇuP</s>]
The activities called divine, animal, and human proceed by their own sport,
for the benefit of the worlds — they are not caused by <s>karma</s>.' [<s>ViṣṇuP</s>]

children.text: jagatām upakārāya na sā karmanimittajā //" iti [ViṣṇuP ]

children.translated_text: Thus, even the destruction of <s>Brahmā</s>, <s>Rudra</s>, and others who came in the form of <s>Śarabha</s> by the <s>Bhagavān</s> in his <s>Nṛsiṃha</s> form is understood from the <s>Nārasiṃhapurāṇa</s> and other texts. Thus:

children.text: evaṃ nṛsiṃharūpiṇā bhagavatā śarabharūpeṇāgatānāṃ brahmarudrādīnām api saṃhārādikaṃ nārasiṃhapurāṇādiṣv avagamyate. yathā:

children.translated_text: The manner of the creation of the <s>Śarabha</s> and other matters
After the slaying of <s>Hiraṇyakaśipu</s>: in the thirty-seventh chapter,
'<s>Bṛhaspati</s> [said]
to <s>Indra</s> and the gods who were terrified of <s>Hiraṇyakaśipu</s>:
'Having gone to the northern shore of the Milk Ocean, let <s>Keśava</s> be praised there. [<s>NarasiṃhaP</s>]
<s>Viṣṇu</s>, praised by you, will be pleased in an instant.' Beginning thus, [<s>NarasiṃhaP</s>]

children.text: yuṣmābhis saṃstuto viṣṇuḥ prasanno bhavati kṣaṇāt//" ity ārabhya [NarasiṃhaP]

children.translated_text: 'I know all about your coming, O crushers of demons.
I have been praised by <s>Śaṅkara</s> too for the purpose of destroying <s>Hiraṇyaka[śipu</s>]

children.text: hiraṇyakavināśārthaṃ stuto 'haṃ śaṅkareṇa ca // ity uktvā [NarasiṃhaP]
children.translated_text: .' Having said this, [<s>NarasiṃhaP</s>]
after the slaying of <s>Hiraṇyakaśipu</s>,
'Seeing the terrifying form of <s>Nṛsiṃha</s>, lord of the world,
overpowered by wrath — gods and demons trembled.' [<s>NarasiṃhaP</s>]
Beginning thus, after the hymns are recited, the approach to <s>Brahmā</s> and other matters are presented:
'When that <s>Bhagavān</s> <s>Nṛsiṃha</s>, the Supreme Self, was enraged,
this world trembled when the Lord of gods was extremely angry. [<s>NarasiṃhaP</s>]

children.text: pravepitaṃ jagad idaṃ deveśe kupite bhṛśam // [NarasiṃhaP]

children.translated_text: There is no other refuge for the gods here besides you.

children.text: tvatto hi nānyaś śaraṇaṃ devānām iha vidyate /

children.translated_text: Destroy the fear arisen from <s>Narasiṃha</s>, O <s>Hari</s>.' [<s>NarasiṃhaP</s>]
Having spoken the prayer of <s>Rudra</s> and other matters in this manner,
'<s>Hiraṇyakaśipu</s>, the mighty demon, has been slain by him.
Who will pacify the wrath of <s>Harimedhas</s> for us? [<s>NarasiṃhaP</s>.]

children.text: ko naś śamayitā tasya kopasya harimedhasaḥ // [NarasiṃhaP.]

children.translated_text: You are my begetter, O god, and <s>Hari</s> is your begetter.

children.text: tvaṃ me janayitā deva sa te janayitā hariḥ /

children.translated_text: Who would be capable of subduing that god <s>Viṣṇu</s>? [<s>NarasiṃhaP</s>]

children.text: tasya devasya kaś śakto viṣṇor vai nigrahe bhavet // [NarasiṃhaP]

children.translated_text: He from whose fear the wind blows, from whose fear the sun shines,

children.text: yad bhayāt pavate vāyuḥ sūryas tapati yad bhayāt /

children.translated_text: from whose fear the earth bears [all]

children.text: yad bhayād dharaṇī dhatte nigrahe tasya kaḥ prabhuḥ /
children.translated_text: — who is lord enough to subdue him?
Yet a means must be found by me, by supreme <s>samādhi</s>. [<s>NarasiṃhaP</s>]

children.text: tathāpy upāyo dṛśyo me parameṇa samādhinā // [NarasiṃhaP]

children.translated_text: If that is done, there will be welfare; remaining silent is not agreeable.

children.text: kṛte tasmin bhavec chreyaḥ tūṣṇīṃ bhāvo na rocate /

children.translated_text: The buffalo is the enemy of horses, the lord of beasts [lion]
of elephants, [<s>NarasiṃhaP</s>.]
the ram of monkeys, and <s>Garuḍa</s> is known as [the enemy]

children.text: vānarāṇāṃ tathā meṣaḥ phaṇīnāṃ garuḍaḥ smṛtaḥ /
children.translated_text: of serpents,
the cat of mice, and the dog of deer, [<s>NarasiṃhaP</s>.]

children.text: mūṣakānān tu mārjāro mṛgāṇāṃ śvā prakīrtitaḥ // [NarasiṃhaP.]

children.translated_text: the owl of crows, and the <s>Śarabha</s> of lions.
Therefore we shall create a <s>Śarabha</s> for the pacification of fear.' [<s>NarasiṃhaP</s>.]
'The <s>Śarabha</s> presided over by us shall pacify <s>Nṛsiṃha</s>.'
Having spoken thus, the <s>Bhagavān</s> (<s>Brahmā</s>) created the <s>Śarabha</s>. [<s>NarasiṃhaP</s>.]

children.text: ity evam uktvā bhagavān sasarja śarabhaṃ tathā // [NarasiṃhaP.]

children.translated_text: By whose very sight the three worlds trembled.
Then the lord of <s>Bhavānī</s> (<s>Śiva</s>) chose to be in its beak. [<s>NarasiṃhaP</s>]
On its back <s>Rudra</s> placed the four-faced one (<s>Brahmā</s>),
<s>Soma</s> and <s>Sūrya</s> in its eyes, <s>Marut</s> (wind) in its two wings, [<s>NarasiṃhaP</s>]
and <s>Śiva</s> placed all the mountains in its feet.

children.text: pādeṣu bhūdharān sarvān śivas tasya nyaveśayat /

children.translated_text: Having thus created the <s>Śarabha</s>, <s>Bhava</s>, the lord of the <s>Pramatha</s>s, [<s>NarasiṃhaP</s>]
roared terrifyingly, directed at that <s>Narasiṃha</s>.' [<s>NarasiṃhaP</s>]
Having thus presented the creation of the <s>Śarabha</s> and other matters,
'Then in an instant the <s>Śarabha</s>, filling all directions with its roar,
approached <s>Viṣṇu</s>, bellowing a terrifying sound. [<s>NarasiṃhaP</s>]

children.text: abhyāśam agamad viṣṇoḥ ninadan bhairavaṃ svanam // [NarasiṃhaP]

children.translated_text: Seeing it approach, <s>Nṛsiṃha</s> in fury

children.text: tam abhyāśagataṃ dṛṣṭvā nṛsiṃhaḥ śarabhaṃ ruṣā /

children.translated_text: struck the <s>Śarabha</s> with sharp, fierce claws — he whose best weapon was his claws. [<s>NarasiṃhaP</s>]
When that <s>Raudra</s> (fearsome) <s>Śarabha</s> was slain by the destroyer of <s>Madhu</s>,
the gods and divine sages praised the Lotus-eyed One.' [<s>NarasiṃhaP</s>]
Thus the slaying of the <s>Śarabha</s> presided over by <s>Brahmā</s>, <s>Rudra</s>, and others by the <s>Bhagavān</s> is established.
In the <s>Garuḍa</s> [<s>Purāṇa</s>]
, in the ninety-eighth chapter:
'The fierce <s>Śarabha</s> that came to slay, the Man-Lion
tore apart with his claws, just as [he had done to]
<s>Hiraṇyakaśipu</s>. [<s>GaruḍaP</s>]
With arms, thighs, and head severed by <s>vajra</s>-like claws of his mouth,
the <s>Śarabha</s> fell suddenly on the back of <s>Meru</s> [at the hands of]
<s>Nṛsiṃha</s>.' [<s>GaruḍaP</s>]
In the <s>Pādma</s> [<s>Purāṇa</s>]

children.text: pādme: "tau yudhyamānau tu ciraṃ vegena balavattarau /
children.translated_text: : 'Those two gods, <s>Nṛsiṃha</s> and the <s>Śarabha</s>, fighting long with great force,
the mightier — both came to destruction. [<s>PadmaP</s>]
Then the mighty-armed <s>Nṛsiṃha</s>, of terrible roar, enraged,
with a thousand hands and arms and eyes, cut apart [the <s>Śarabha</s>'s]
limbs. [<s>PadmaP</s>]
Fallen, terrible, most fierce, lifeless — to see him came

children.text: patitaṃ bhīmam atyugraṃ gatāṃsuṃ draṣṭum āgatāḥ /

children.translated_text: sages, gods, and <s>Gandharva</s>s — where <s>Bhava</s> <s>Hara</s> (<s>Śiva</s>) lay. [<s>PadmaP</s>]

children.text: ṛṣayo devagandharvā yatra śete bhavo haraḥ // [Padma.P ]

children.translated_text: Having seen him, the celestials went to the highest [state of]

children.text: taṃ dṛṣṭvā paramaṃ jagmuḥ vismayantu divaukasaḥ /
children.translated_text: wonder,
and they recounted the wondrous deed of <s>Nṛsiṃha</s>.' [<s>PadmaP</s>]

children.text: paśaśaṃsus tathā karma nṛsiṃhasya mahādbhutam //" iti [PadmaP ]

children.translated_text: In the <s>Śrībhāgavata</s>: 'Then, swiftly seizing <s>Rudra</s> in <s>Śarabha</s>-form,
<s>Nṛsiṃha</s>

children.text: vidadāra nakhais tīkṣṇaiḥ hiraṇyakaśipuṃ yathā //" iti [BhāgavataP ]
children.translated_text: tore him apart with sharp claws, just as [he had done to] <s>Hiraṇyakaśipu</s>.' [<s>BhāgavataP</s>]
The equality of <s>Rudra</s>-worshippers with <s>Śūdra</s>s
Furthermore, in the <s>Ānuśāsanika</s> [<s>Parvan</s>]

children.text: kiñca ānuśāsanike umāmaheśvarasaṃvāde bhagavato 'ṅgabhāvena vinā rudropāsanaṃ kurvatāṃ śudratulyatvam uktam. yathā dakṣādhvare:
children.translated_text: , in the dialogue between <s>Umā</s> and <s>Maheśvara</s>, it is stated that those who worship <s>Rudra</s> without [regarding him as] a part of the <s>Bhagavān</s> are equal to <s>Śūdra</s>s. Thus, in <s>Dakṣa</s>'s sacrifice:
<s>Rudrāṇī</s>: 'I am the eldest and the most distinguished; therefore worship me well.'

children.text: rudrāṇī: ahaṃ jyeṣṭhā viśiṣṭā ca tasmāt tvaṃ māṃ supūjaya /

children.translated_text: <s>Dakṣa</s>: 'You are neither the eldest nor the most distinguished; these gods are to be worshipped by me.' [MBh]

children.text: dakṣa: na tu jyeṣṭhā viśiṣṭā tvaṃ mama pūjyā imās surāḥ*{850}* //" [MBh ]

children.translated_text: Having presented the insult to <s>Rudrāṇī</s> and the disruption of the sacrifice and other matters in this manner, a curse is pronounced against <s>Rudra</s>:

children.text: ityādinā rudrāṇīdūṣaṇam adhvarabhaṅgādikaṃ ca pratipādya rudraṃ prati śāpotsargaḥ kriyate.

children.translated_text: 'By those born of this lineage, you shall be untouchable.',
'In these lineages, no devotee of yours shall be born. [MBh]

children.text: naitad vaṃśeṣu yaḥ kaścit tvadbhakto hi janiṣyati // [MBh ]

children.translated_text: Whoever — be he a sage or a <s>Brāhmaṇa</s> — in ignorance

children.text: ajānāt tvāṃ hi yaḥ kaścit munir vā brāhmaṇo 'pi vā /

children.translated_text: lives dependent upon you, he shall be equal to a <s>Śūdra</s>, condemned. [MBh]

children.text: anujīvati cet tasmāt tulyaś śūdreṇa garhitaḥ // [MBh ]

children.translated_text: And he shall become a temple-priest, one who lives off <s>Rudra</s> and <s>Kālī</s>.' [MBh]
[Textual note:] Read: sahasrakaravannetraḥ.
Reasons for the absence of supreme single-minded devotion among <s>Bodhāyana</s> and other [<s>Sūtra</s>
adherents]
The absence of supreme single-minded devotion among <s>Kātyāyana</s> <s>Sūtra</s> adherents

Therefore, because <s>Nārāyaṇa</s> is presented by <s>Bodhāyana</s> as equal to <s>Rudra</s>, because the six indicators of purport are absent in the <s>Bodhāyana</s>, <s>Āpastamba</s>, and other <s>Sūtra</s>s, because their adherents have not been exclusively devoted to <s>Nārāyaṇa</s> alone from the time of creation, and because worship of various deities is observed [among them]

children.text: ato nārāyaṇasya rudreṇa samānatayā bodhāyanena pratipāditvāt bodhāyanāpastambādisūtreṣu ṣadvidhatātparyaliṅgābhāvāt teṣāṃ sṛṣṭikālād ārabhya nārāyaṇaikaparatvābhāvāt nānādevatopāsakatvadarśanāc ca paramaikāntitvaṃ na sambhavati. evaṃ kātyāyanasūtriṇām api:
children.translated_text: — supreme single-minded devotion (<s>paramaikāntitva</s>) is not possible for them. Likewise for the <s>Kātyāyana</s> <s>Sūtra</s> adherents too:
'With <s>Brāhma</s>, <s>Vaiṣṇava</s>, <s>Raudra</s>, <s>Sāvitra</s>, <s>Maitra</s>-<s>Varuṇa</s> [mantras]
with mantras bearing those very marks, one should worship with concentration.' [<s>Kātyāyanasūtra</s>]

children.text: talliṅgair eva mantrais tu arcayet tu samāhitaḥ //" [Kātyāyanasūtra]

children.translated_text: Because such [multi-deity worship]
is taught, there is no supreme single-minded devotion.
In the <s>Drāhyāyaṇa</s> <s>Sūtra</s>, taking refuge (<s>prapatti</s>) at the commencement of rites is prescribed with respect to <s>Rudra</s>.

children.text: drāhyāyaṇasūtre tu rudraviṣayatvena karmārambhe prapadanam uktam.

children.translated_text: Therefore, it is fitting to declare that supreme single-minded devotion (<s>paramaikāntitva</s>) belongs only to the followers of <s>Śrīmad Vaikhānasa</s>, because of their exclusive devotion to <s>Śrīman Nārāyaṇa</s> alone. Thus the ninth reason — 'because of exclusive devotion to <s>Śrīman Nārāyaṇa</s>, the sole cause of the entire universe' — is established.

children.text: ataḥ śrīmannārāyaṇaikaparatvāt paramaikāntitvaṃ śrīmadvaikhānasānām eveti pratijñā kartum ucitā. evaṃ "akhilajagadekakāraṇaśrīmannārāyaṇaikaparatvāt" iti navamahetur nirūpitaḥ.

children.translated_text: Thus ends the examination of the ninth reason.
Examination of the Tenth Reason
The <s>Vaikhānasas</s>' being the most beloved of the <s>Bhagavān</s>

children.text: athāsya śrīvaikhānasasūtrasya śīmannārāyaṇaikaparatvād tatsūtrānuṣṭhānavatām eva bhagavatpriyatamatvam upapadyata iti pratipādanāya "bhagavatpriyatamatvopapatter" iti daśamahetur nirūpyate.
children.translated_text: Now, since this <s>ŚrīVaikhānasa Sūtra</s> is exclusively devoted to <s>ŚrīNārāyaṇa</s>, it is established that those who follow that <s>Sūtra</s> alone are the most beloved of the <s>Bhagavān</s>. To demonstrate this, the tenth reason — 'because of the establishment of being the most beloved of the <s>Bhagavān</s>' — is being set forth.

children.text: chandogabrāhmaṇe: "vaikhānasā vā ṛṣaya indrasya priyā āsan"*{851}* iti. atra indraśabdaḥ paramātmapara iti pūrvam evoktam.
children.translated_text: In the <s>Chāndogya Brāhmaṇa</s>: 'The <s>Vaikhānasa</s> sages were indeed dear to <s>Indra</s>.' Here, the word '<s>Indra</s>' refers to the Supreme Self (<s>Paramātman</s>), as has already been stated earlier.

children.text: vārāhe: "aśvatthaḥ kapilā gāvaḥ tulasī vikhanās tathā* /{852}*
children.translated_text: In the <s>Vārāha</s> [Purāṇa]: 'The <s>aśvattha</s> tree, tawny cows, <s>tulasī</s>, and <s>Vikhanasa</s> —

children.text: catvāro matpriyā rājan teṣāṃ vaikhānaso varaḥ* //{853}* [VarāhaP]
children.translated_text: these four are dear to me, O king; of them, the <s>Vaikhānasa</s> is the best. [<s>VarāhaPurāṇa</s>]

children.text: yatra vaikhānasā viprā yatra santi gavāṃ gaṇāḥ /
children.translated_text: Where there are <s>Vaikhānasa brāhmaṇas</s>, where there are herds of cows,

children.text: yatra bilvāḥ palāśāś ca tatra sannihito hariḥ* //{854}*" iti [VarāhaP]
children.translated_text: where there are <s>bilva</s> and <s>palāśa</s> trees — there <s>Hari</s> is present.' [<s>VarāhaPurāṇa</s>]
In the <s>Kūrma</s> [Purāṇa]: 'Their minds fixed on Me, their life-breath gone to Me, their thoughts absorbed in Me,
with no other refuge, O king — therefore the <s>Vaikhānasas</s> are the best.' [<s>KūrmaPurāṇa</s>]

children.text: pāñcarātre pauṣkare: "viprā vaikhānasākhyā ye te bhaktās tattvam ucyate* //{856}* [PauṣkaraS 36.260cd]
children.translated_text: In the <s>Pāñcarātra</s>, in the <s>Pauṣkara</s> [Saṃhitā]: 'The <s>brāhmaṇas</s> called <s>Vaikhānasa</s> — their devotion is called the truth. [<s>PauṣkaraSaṃhitā</s> 36.260cd]
They are exclusively devoted, well-established in <s>sattva</s>, not worshipping any other deity until the end of the body;

children.text: kartavyam iti deveśaṃ saṃyajante phalaṃ vinā* //{858}* [PauṣkaraS 36.261]
children.translated_text: thinking 'this is to be done,' they worship the Lord of gods without regard for fruit. [<s>PauṣkaraSaṃhitā</s> 36.261]
And at the end of the body, they attain the state of <s>Vāsudeva</s>, O Lotus-born.' [<s>PauṣkaraSaṃhitā</s> 36.262ab]
The supremacy of those devoted to the worship of the deity

children.text: bṛhannāradīye: "devārcanaparā ye ca ye ca tatsādhakā narāḥ /
children.translated_text: In the <s>Bṛhannāradīya</s> [Purāṇa]: 'Those who are devoted to the worship of the deity, and those who are facilitators thereof,
and those who, having seen the worship, rejoice — they are indeed the best among the <s>Bhāgavatas</s> (devotees of <s>Bhagavān</s>). [<s>BṛhannāradaPurāṇa</s>]

children.text: yas tu bhogatayā viṣṇoḥ satkṛtyaṃ kurute sadā /
children.translated_text: He who always reverently performs [worship] for the enjoyment of <s>Viṣṇu</s>
becomes a supreme exclusive devotee, the best among the great <s>Bhāgavatas</s>. [<s>BṛhannāradaPurāṇa</s>]
Those who have gone to exclusive devotion to <s>Viṣṇu</s>, the <s>Bhagavān</s>, the Self-contemplator —

children.text: te vaiṣṇavā bhāgavatās santa ity api kīrtitāḥ // [BṛhannāradaP]
children.translated_text: they are called <s>Vaiṣṇavas</s>, <s>Bhāgavatas</s>, and <s>Santas</s> (holy ones). [<s>BṛhannāradaPurāṇa</s>]

children.text: !{851}! ChāndogyaBr 2.23.1; ebenfalls zitiert in DHN[D] 21.8, 41.8 und 61.13-15.
! Der erste Halbvers ist auch als "Purātantra" in DHN[D] 37.3 zitiert.

! ĀS 19.10; dieser Vers ist auch ohne Herkunftsangabe in DHN[D] 21.12-13 zitiert, ähnlich als "Varāhapurāṇa" in DHN[D] 41.10-11; vgl. KrA 36.37: aśvatthaḥ kapilā gāvaḥ tulasī vikhano dvijaḥ / haripriyās tu catvāraḥ teṣu vaikhānaso varaḥ.
! Dieser Vers ist auch in DHN[D] 42.16-17 und 48.23-24 zitiert.

! Dieser Halbvers ist auch zitiert in DHN[D] 43.2 und 118.15.

children.translated_text: Note: <s>Chāndogya Brāhmaṇa</s> 2.23.1; also cited in DHN[D] 21.8, 41.8, and 61.13-15.
The edibility of food offered to <s>Viṣṇu</s>

children.text: manmānasāś ca madbhaktā mama pūjāsu lolupāḥ /
children.translated_text: Their minds are on Me, they are My devotees, they are eager in My worship,

children.text: matkathāśravaṇe sattās te vai bhāgavatāḥ smṛtāḥ //" iti [BṛhannāradaP]
children.translated_text: they are established in hearing My stories — they are called <s>Bhāgavatas</s>.' [<s>BṛhannāradaPurāṇa</s>]
'Those who worship <s>Nārāyaṇa</s> the immaculate with devotion —
them do the gods, the hosts of deities headed by <s>Brahmā</s>, honor in return.

children.text: mayi bhaktiparo yas tu madyājī matparāyaṇaḥ /
children.translated_text: He who is devoted to Me, who sacrifices to Me, who is intent on Me,
who meditates on Me — he leads his entire family to the form of <s>Acyuta</s>.

children.text: ye 'rcayanti sadā viṣṇuṃ na te prākṛtamānuṣāḥ /
children.translated_text: Those who always worship <s>Viṣṇu</s> — they are not ordinary humans;

children.text: viṣṇulokāt samutpannās te devā nātra saṃśayaḥ // [ĀS 14.58]
children.translated_text: born from the world of <s>Viṣṇu</s>, they are gods — there is no doubt about this. [<s>ĀtreyaSaṃhitā</s> 14.58]

children.text: nāviṣṇur jayate viṣṇur nāviṣṇur viṣṇum arcayet*{861}* /
children.translated_text: A non-<s>Viṣṇu</s> is not born [as such]; <s>Viṣṇu</s> [Himself is born]; a non-<s>Viṣṇu</s> does not worship <s>Viṣṇu</s>.

children.text: rūpadvayaṃ hareḥ proktaṃ bimbam arcaka eva ca // [KrA 36.59cd]
children.translated_text: Two forms of <s>Hari</s> are declared: the image and the worshipper himself. [<s>KriyādhikāraS</s> 36.59cd]

children.text: bimbe tv āvāhanād ūrdhvaṃ sadā sannihito 'rcake / [KrA 36.60ab]
children.translated_text: In the image, from the invocation onward, He is always present; [and] in the worshipper. [<s>KriyādhikāraS</s> 36.60ab]

children.text: arcakas tu prasannātmā harir eva na saṃśayaḥ //
children.translated_text: The worshipper, of serene mind, is indeed <s>Hari</s> — there is no doubt.

children.text: kaliḥ kṛtayugas teṣāṃ kleśāś caiva sukhāvahāḥ /
children.translated_text: <s>Kali</s> [age] becomes <s>Kṛtayuga</s> for them, and afflictions become bearers of happiness —

children.text: yeṣāṃ śarīram aniśaṃ hariśuśrūṣaṇe ratam //" iti
children.translated_text: those whose bodies are constantly delighting in the service of <s>Hari</s>.'

children.text: bhāgavate: "sā vāg anantarasya*{862}* guṇān gṛṇīte karau ca tatkarmakarau manaś ca /
children.translated_text: In the <s>Bhāgavata</s>: 'That is speech which recounts the qualities of the Infinite One; those are hands which perform His work; and that is mind

children.text: smared vasantaṃ sthirajaṅgameṣu śruṇoti tatpuṇyakathās sa karṇaḥ* //{863}*
children.translated_text: which remembers Him dwelling in all things moving and unmoving; that is the ear which hears His blessed stories.

children.text: śiraś ca tasyāṅghriṣu namramāṇaṃ tam eva yaḥ paśyati taddhi cakṣuḥ /
children.translated_text: That is the head which bows at His feet; that indeed is the eye which sees Him;

children.text: aṅgāni viṣṇor atha tajjanānāṃ pādodakaṃ yāni vahanti nityam* //{864}* [BhāgavataP 10.80.4]
children.translated_text: those are the limbs which constantly bear the <s>pādodaka</s> (water from His feet) of <s>Viṣṇu</s> and of His devotees. [<s>BhāgavataPurāṇa</s> 10.80.4]

children.text: hṛdi rūpaṃ mukhe nāma naivedyam udare hareḥ /
children.translated_text: He who has the form [of <s>Hari</s>] in his heart, the name [of <s>Hari</s>] on his lips, the <s>naivedya</s> (food-offering) of <s>Hari</s> in his stomach,

children.text: pādodakañ ca nirmālyaṃ yasya mūrdhni sa vaiṣṇavaḥ //" iti [BhāgavataP ]
children.translated_text: and the <s>pādodaka</s> (foot-water) and <s>nirmālya</s> (offered flowers) on his head — he is a <s>Vaiṣṇava</s>.'

children.text: ! Dieser Halbvers ist auch als "Purātantra" in DHN[D] 39.17 zitiert; vgl. KhA 22.162ab: nāviṣṇur arcayed viṣṇuṃ nāviṣṇuḥ dhyāyate harim.
! BhāgavataP 10.80.3: sā vāg yayā tasya guṇān gṛṇīte karau ca tatkarmakarau manaś ca / smared vasantaṃ sthirajaṅgameṣu śṛṇoti tatpuṇyakathāḥ sa karṇaḥ.
! BhāgavataP: śiras tu tasyobhayaliṅgam ānamet tad eva yat paśyati tad dhi cakṣuḥ / aṅgāni viṣṇor atha tajjanānāṃ pādodakaṃ yāni bhajanti nityam.

children.translated_text: Note: Also cited in DHN[D] 60.15-16.

children.text: śrutir api: "tad asya priyam abhipātho aśyām naro yatra devayavo madanti urukramasya sa hi bandhur itthā viṣṇoḥ pade parame madhva utsaḥ" iti. asyārthaḥ: viṣṇoḥ 'priyaṃ'; tatpāthaḥ niveditam annādikam 'abhyaśyām'. 'devayavo narāḥ'; devārādhakāḥ 'yatra madanti'; yasmin niveditatīrthaprasādādike svīkṛte 'madanti'; hṛṣṭā bhavanti. yadvā: brahmādīn api na gaṇayanti. 'itthā'; itthaṃ pratidinaṃ vartamānaḥ 'urukramasya viṣṇor bandhuḥ'; jātyekavacanam. sa evātīvābhimataḥ 'parame'; sarvotkṛṣṭe 'madhve'; madhuvat bhogyatame viṣṇoḥ pade 'utsa'; utsukaḥ. yadvā utkṛṣṭaḥ.
children.translated_text: The <s>Śruti</s> also [says]: 'May I eat that which is his beloved food (<s>pātha</s>), that person, where the god-seekers delight. For he is the kinsman of <s>Urukrama</s> (<s>Viṣṇu</s>) in this way; in the supreme abode of <s>Viṣṇu</s> is the fountain of honey.' Its meaning: '<s>Viṣṇu</s>'s beloved'; that <s>pātha</s> (food) is the offered food and the like, 'may I eat.' 'God-seeking people'; worshippers of the deity, 'where they delight'; when that which is offered — <s>tīrtha</s> (holy water), <s>prasāda</s> (grace-offering), and the like — is accepted, 'they delight'; they become joyful. Or: they do not even count <s>Brahmā</s> and the others. 'Thus'; one who lives thus every day [is] 'the kinsman of <s>Urukrama</s>, <s>Viṣṇu</s>'; the singular stands for the class. He alone is supremely beloved. 'In the supreme'; the most exalted, 'in the honey'; in the most delightful, like honey, abode of <s>Viṣṇu</s>, '[he is] the fountain'; the eager one. Or: the exalted one.

children.text: śrutyantare: "viṣṇunāśitam aśnanti viṣṇunā pītaṃ pibanti viṣṇuna ghrātaṃ jighranti viṣṇunā rasitaṃ rasayanti tasmād vidvāṃso viṣṇūpahṛtaṃ bhakṣayeyuḥ" iti.
children.translated_text: In another <s>Śruti</s>: 'They eat what <s>Viṣṇu</s> has eaten; they drink what <s>Viṣṇu</s> has drunk; they smell what <s>Viṣṇu</s> has smelled; they taste what <s>Viṣṇu</s> has tasted. Therefore, the wise should eat what has been offered to <s>Viṣṇu</s>.'
In the <s>Bhāgavata</s>: 'Adorned with garlands, fragrances, garments, and ornaments that You have enjoyed,

children.text: ucchiṣṭabhojino dāsās tava māyāṃ taremahi* //{865}*" iti [BhāgavataP 11.6.46]
children.translated_text: eating Your leftovers as servants — may we cross over Your <s>māyā</s>!' [<s>BhāgavataPurāṇa</s> 11.6.46]
<s>Hārīta</s>: 'That which is given by grace, which has come to hand, which is the leftovers of <s>Viṣṇu</s>'s eating —
he who eats it under the pretext of fasting — by him it has been eaten as if by a god.'
<s>Bhṛgu</s>: 'Having made the oblation (<s>havis</s>) in four parts, one should offer the upper portions [to the deity];
with the lower one part, one should perform <s>homa</s> (fire-offering) and <s>bali</s> (offering to beings).
Whatever portion remains in the vessel is designated for the worshipper alone;

children.text: agnikāryāvaśiṣṭañ ca baliśiṣṭañ ca yad dhaviḥ /
children.translated_text: and the oblation remaining after the fire-ritual and after the <s>bali</s>-offering —

children.text: sarvaṃ tatpūjakāyaiva proktam evaṃ manīṣibhiḥ //" iti
children.translated_text: all of that is declared by the wise to be for the worshipper alone.'

children.text: yajñādhikāre bhṛgu: "ātmanaś ca caturthāṃśaṃ vaiśvadevārtham arcakaḥ /
children.translated_text: In the section on the qualification for sacrifice, <s>Bhṛgu</s> [says]: 'The worshipper, having taken a fourth part of his own [food] for the purpose of <s>Vaiśvadeva</s> (offering to all gods),
after the <s>Vaiśvadeva</s> [offering], should then feed [guests] with the remaining food. [<s>YajñādhikāraS</s>]
The remainder of the <s>bali</s> and the remainder of the <s>homa</s>, especially at the <s>Vaiśvadeva</s>,

children.text: gṛhṇīyād vaiśvadevārthaṃ bhojanārthañ ca ṛtvijaḥ //" iti [YA ]
children.translated_text: the priests should take for the purpose of <s>Vaiśvadeva</s> and for the purpose of eating.' [<s>YajñādhikāraS</s>]

children.text: kāśyapa: "sarvahaviḥ pātreṣu śiṣṭam annaṃ sarvaṃ bhagavanniveditam apūpādikañ ca pūjakā gṛhṇīyuḥ. yathā guror ucchiṣṭaṃ putraśiṣyabhṛtyānāṃ bhojyaṃ. tathā sarvasya rakṣituḥ saumyamūrte sarvavyāpino viṣṇoḥ jagadguror niveditam annādyaṃ viśvaṃ caturvarṇānāṃ bhaktimatāṃ sarveṣāṃ bhojyam, abhaktimatām abhojyam" iti.
children.translated_text: <s>Kāśyapa</s>: 'The worshippers should take all the food remaining in all the offering-vessels, all that has been offered to the <s>Bhagavān</s>, and the cakes and other [offerings]. Just as the leavings of a teacher are fit to be eaten by sons, disciples, and servants, so too the food and other things offered to <s>Viṣṇu</s> — the gentle-formed, all-pervading teacher of the world, the protector of all — are fit to be eaten by all the four <s>varṇas</s> who possess devotion, but not by those without devotion.'
In the <s>ŚrīPāñcarātra</s>, in the <s>Īśvara Saṃhitā</s>, in the chapter on complete worship:
<s>Skanda</s>: 'You have stated the prohibition of [distributing] things offered through <s>mantras</s> —
of all leaves, flowers, food, and other things, O Supreme Lord. [<s>ĪśvaraSaṃhitā</s>]

children.text: !{865}! BhāgavataP: tvayopabhuktasraggandhavāso 'laṅkāracarcitāḥ / ucchiṣṭabhojino dāsās tava māyāṃ jayema hi.
children.translated_text: Note: <s>BhāgavataPurāṇa</s> variant: 'tvayopabhuktasraggandhavāso 'laṅkāracarcitāḥ / ucchiṣṭabhojino dāsās tava māyāṃ jayema hi.'
The purpose of the <s>Arcāvatāra</s> (image-incarnation) is the sustaining of all the world

children.text: tasyedānīṃ pradānañ ca prāśanañ ca praśaṃsasi /
children.translated_text: Now you praise both the giving and the eating of those [offerings];

children.text: kim etad atra me jātas saṃśayaḥ parameśvara // [ĪśvaraS ]
children.translated_text: what is this? A doubt has arisen in me about this, O Supreme Lord. [<s>ĪśvaraSaṃhitā</s>]

children.text: īśvara:pradānaṃ prāśanaṃ putra upabhogyatvam eva ca /
children.translated_text: <s>Īśvara</s> [replied]: The giving, eating, and enjoyability [of offerings], O son,

children.text: śaive pāśupate dṛṣṭam acirād eva pāpakṛt //
children.translated_text: are seen in the <s>Śaiva</s> and <s>Pāśupata</s> [systems as producing] sin quickly.

children.text: tatpunar vaiṣṇave mārge vartate vyatyayena tu /
children.translated_text: But again, in the <s>Vaiṣṇava</s> path, it operates in the opposite manner —
giving [of <s>prasāda</s>] produces infinite fruit; eating [thereof] purifies the stomach.' [<s>ĪśvaraSaṃhitā</s>]

children.text: tatraiva devatārcane: "karṣaṃ nayati pāpāni puṇyavṛddhiṃ karoti ca /
children.translated_text: In the same [text], on the worship of the deity: 'It destroys sins, and it produces the increase of merit;

children.text: dānair dharmaiḥ tathā puṇyais tapobhiś ca na tatphalam // [ĪśvaraS ]
children.translated_text: by gifts, <s>dharmas</s>, merits, and austerities, that fruit [cannot be obtained] [<s>ĪśvaraSaṃhitā</s>]
which is obtained from the eating of [<s>prasāda</s>] by those purified by devotion to the <s>Bhagavān</s>.' [<s>ĪśvaraSaṃhitā</s>]
Elsewhere: 'A person devoted to holy company, worship of the deity, sacred stories,

children.text: sa yāti viṣṇoḥ paramaṃ padaṃ yaddehāvasāne 'cyutatulyatejāḥ //" iti
children.translated_text: and the instruction of others — he goes to the supreme abode of <s>Viṣṇu</s> at the end of the body, having splendor equal to <s>Acyuta</s>.'
Elsewhere: 'Know that those who are exclusively devoted to <s>Nārāyaṇa</s> are <s>sāttvika</s>;
and those who are <s>rājasika</s> are persons who worship various deities.
Those who are devoid of deities, external [to the Vedic fold] — they are declared to be <s>tāmasika</s>;

children.text: rajastamo 'bhibhūtānāṃ na tu mokṣaḥ kathañcana //" iti
children.translated_text: for those overwhelmed by <s>rajas</s> and <s>tamas</s>, there is no liberation whatsoever.'

children.text: purāṇāntare: "yatraiva pūjyate viṣṇur vidhinā prayatair naraiḥ /
children.translated_text: In another <s>Purāṇa</s>: 'Wherever <s>Viṣṇu</s> is worshipped with proper rites by devoted men,

children.text: na tatra hy ādhidaurgatya vyādhicaurādikaṃ bhayam //" iti
children.translated_text: there is no fear from calamity, ill fortune, disease, thieves, and the like.'
Moreover: 'Because [<s>Hari</s>] in His <s>Para</s> and <s>Vyūha</s> forms is to be enjoyed by the eternally liberated,
because His <s>Vibhava</s> (incarnation) form has as its sole object those proximate in time, [<s>ĀtreyaSaṃhitā</s> 14.14]
because His <s>Antarātman</s> (inner Self) form is to be contemplated by those purified and perfected in <s>yoga</s> —
in the <s>Arcā</s> (image) form alone is the unobstructed qualification of all. [<s>ĀtreyaSaṃhitā</s> 14.15]
Even by me, regarding the <s>Arcāvatāra</s> domain, only in outline

children.text: uktā guṇā na śakyante vaktuṃ varṣaśatair api // [Ā.S 14.16]
children.translated_text: have the qualities been stated; they cannot be told even in hundreds of years. [<s>ĀtreyaSaṃhitā</s> 14.16]
Thus, I am of five forms; for those selves who are falling downward,
I am greater and greater than the preceding, ever increasingly superior. [<s>ĀtreyaSaṃhitā</s>]
The Lord of the world becomes increasingly accessible in His accessibility.' [<s>ĀtreyaSaṃhitā</s>]

children.text: iti pratipāditarityā bhagavataḥ paratvādiṣu saulabhyābhāvāt akhilalokasamujjīvanārtham arcāvatāraḥ. tadekaparatvād vaikhānasāḥ tatpriyatamāḥ. etadṛśanārāyaṇāyaṇaikaparatvābhāvād bodhāyanasya āpastambādīnāñ na kathañcad api paramaikāntitvaṃ bhagavatpriyatamatvañ ca sambhavati.
children.translated_text: As thus established, since there is no accessibility in the <s>Bhagavān</s>'s transcendence and other [higher forms], the <s>Arcāvatāra</s> (image-incarnation) is for the purpose of sustaining all the world. Since the <s>Vaikhānasas</s> are exclusively devoted to that [<s>Arcā</s> form] alone, they are the most beloved of Him. Because <s>Baudhāyana</s>, <s>Āpastamba</s>, and the others do not possess such exclusive devotion to <s>Nārāyaṇa</s> alone, their being supreme exclusive devotees and being most beloved of the <s>Bhagavān</s> is in no way possible.

children.text: evaṃ ca vaikhānasānām eva paramaikāntitvaṃ bhagavatpriyatamatvañ copapadyate iti sarvaṃ samañjasam iti daśamo hetur nirūpitam.
children.translated_text: Thus it is established that the <s>Vaikhānasas</s> alone possess supreme exclusive devotion and are the most beloved of the <s>Bhagavān</s> — all is consistent. Thus the tenth reason has been established.
Thus ends the establishment of the tenth reason.

children.text: iti śrīramaṇaveṅkaṭācaleśvarapādāravindasaparyāniratasya sarvatantrasvatantrasya śrīnivāsamakhivedāntadeśikasya kṛtiṣu śrīvaikhānasasūtratātparyacintāmaṇau daśavidhahatunirūpaṇam upodghātabhāgaḥ samāptaḥ.
children.translated_text: Thus, in the works of <s>Śrīnivāsamakhi Vedāntadeśika</s>, who is constantly engaged in the worship of the lotus feet of <s>ŚrīRamaṇa Veṅkaṭācaleśvara</s> and who is independent in all systems of knowledge (<s>sarvatantrasvatantra</s>), the section called <s>Daśavidhāhetunirūpaṇa</s> (Establishment of the Ten Reasons) in the <s>ŚrīVaikhānasasūtratātparyacintāmaṇi</s> (Wish-Fulfilling Jewel of the Purport of the Śrī Vaikhānasa Sūtra), the <s>Upodghāta</s> (introductory) portion, is concluded.
Note: <s>ĀtreyaSaṃhitā</s> reading: 'having been directed by the teacher, Me formerly.'
